jobs.title: Electro-Optical Systems Engineer II
jobs.description:
**About CFD Research:** Since its inception in 1987, CFD Research has delivered innovative technology solutions within the Aerospace & Defense, Biomedical & Life Sciences, Intelligence & Sensing, and Energy & Materials industries. CFD Research has earned multiple national awards for successful application and commercialization of innovative component/system technology prototypes, multi-physics simulation software, multi-disciplinary analyses, and expert support services. Based in Huntsville, Alabama where laboratory facilities and headquarters are located, CFD Research also has office and laboratory facilities in Dayton, Ohio, prototyping test and evaluation facilities in Hollywood, Alabama, and office facilities in Fort Walton Beach, Florida. CFD Research is an ISO9001:AS9100D registered company and is appraised at CMMI Level II for Services. **CFD Research is a 100% ESOP (employee-owned company) recognized in Inc. Magazine's Inc5000 as a top growing company for four of the last five years. Learn more at** **www.cfd-research.com**

CFD Research is seeking an Electro-Optical Systems Engineer II to join our Advanced Optics Branch. This role bridges hardware, software, and electronics to develop and deliver EO/IR sensor systems for defense programs – spanning bench integration, sensor calibration, and field test. The right candidate thrives in a technically diverse environment with minimal requirements and takes ownership across the full sensor development lifecycle.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Integrate EO/IR sensor assemblies across mechanical, electrical, optical, and software domains, from component-level assembly through system-level integration and test.
* Develop and execute test plans for sensor systems, including the design and fabrication of custom hardware fixtures to support integration, characterization, and performance evaluation.
* Support field test events, including hardware setup, real-time system monitoring, anomaly reporting, and post-test data processing.
* Collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams to establish technical direction, prioritize development activities, and drive solutions to complex integration challenges.
* Engage directly with customers and end users to understand operational needs, translate them into technical requirements, and guide technology development toward practical solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline
* 3+ years of experience in systems integration, hardware test, or a related engineering role
* Hands-on experience integrating hardware assemblies involving mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces
* Background in embedded systems engineering, with experience integrating software, electronics, and optical sensing technologies.
* Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills; ability to isolate failures across multiple domains
* ***Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen and possess the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.***

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with EO/IR sensor systems, optical assembly, or camera-based systems
* Familiarity with OpenCV, PyTorch, or similar computer vision and ML frameworks
* Experience with C++ in an engineering or embedded context
* Background in EMI, thermal, or vibration testing and instrumentation
* Exposure to CAD tools (SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent) for fixture design or hardware documentation
* Experience with GD&T and precision assembly processes
* Active Secret security clearance is preferred, but not required.

**Location:** **This role is based in the Huntsville, AL****area****,** **and is 100% onsite.**

**Benefits:** CFD Research offers competitive salaries and excellent employee benefits, including an employer matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). CFD Research offers our Full-Time, permanent employee-owners a highly competitive insurance package, including medical, vision, and dental insurance. Additionally, we offer company paid leave, compensation time, parental leave, long-term and short-term disability, accidental death and dismemberment, and life insurance. Part-Time and Temporary employee-owners may receive partial or reduced benefits and leave time based on their employment status level. Performance appraisals occur twice a year and annual pay increases are based upon corporate goals, personal development, performance, and outstanding achievements. In addition, group and individual bonuses are awarded for exceptional performance.

***CFD Research is an EO employer - Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories***

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you a Senior Automation Engineer seeking an exciting new opportunity? Would you like to split time between office-based design work and hands-on troubleshooting on production floors or in development environments?

**Why join us?**  
Did you know that every time you take a flight, drive somewhere, or switch on a light, there's a chance Doncasters played a part in making that happen?

We are a specialist manufacturer of complex precision cast components for aerospace engines and industrial gas turbines, supporting leading OEM programs.  
  
We excel in turning metals into motion, working in alloys and manufacturing complex product designs to offer an unparalleled range of solutions for high performance and specialist applications.  
  
We employ more than 3,000 people across 14 core manufacturing facilities globally, providing the scale and expertise required to serve leading aerospace engine and IGT OEMs.

At Doncasters, we believe in doing things the right way. That means acting with integrity, delivering with commitment, and working as one team to achieve more, together. Whether you're developing precision-engineered components, running world-class manufacturing operations, or supporting our people and processes, your role is part of something much bigger.

Join us and contribute to a legacy built on performance, precision, and the values that drive us forward - excellence, commitment, integrity, and teamwork.

**What we can offer you:**

* An interesting and varied field to work in
* An environment where you can learn and grow through constant development opportunities
* PTO
* Competitive 401K
* Competitive medical insurance

**The Role**
  
The Senior Automation Engineer designs, develops, and maintains automated systems—whether industrial machinery or software processes—to improve efficiency, reduce human error, and streamline operations.

**Interested?**

If you have any of the below skills, we would love to talk to you about your next career move:

* Bachelor's degree in automation engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science, or related fields.
* Certifications such as CAP, CCST, UiPath RPA, ISTQB, or PLC platform certifications enhance credibility.
* 1–5+ years of experience depending on seniority, often in manufacturing, robotics, software QA, or DevOps roles.
* Industrial automation: PLCs, SCADA, HMI, sensors, actuators, robotics systems.
* Software automation: CI/CD pipelines, test automation frameworks, cloud platforms, infrastructure-as-code tools.
* Asset & Process Monitoring tools: i.e. Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Logic Monitor.

**Equal opportunities**

Doncasters is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability- physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodations to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact careers@doncasters.com.

* Simulation, bench validation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing of custom electronics and firmware.

* Integration of custom electronics and sensor payloads onto UAV platforms, flight-controller/autopilot stacks, and edge-compute hardware.
* Planning and execution of field data collection campaigns and flight tests.
* Calibration, debugging, and troubleshooting of hardware, firmware, and sensors in the lab and in the field.
* Characterization of system performance and analysis of multi-sensor datasets.

Candidates with multidisciplinary or overlapping technical expertise are encouraged to apply.

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.

jobs.description:
**Job Details**
===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **JPL Communications and Instruments Division** perform scientific investigations, advanced technology research, engineering developments and system implementations encompassing space telecommunications, tracking and active remote sensing using electromagnetic waves.

The **Flight Communications and Tracking Section** provides cost-effective space communications systems, software defined radios, high power RF amplifiers, and power supplies that support primary telecom subsystems and major radar and radiometer science payloads. The section also provides Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) flight equipment, radiometric science instruments, high stability frequency standards and clocks and seismometers for NASA/JPL missions. In addition to flight hardware expertise, the section specializes in collection of and processing of worldwide, fixed site, GNSS data that is processed into clock, atmospheric, and ionospheric GNSS correction metrics. The section also develops high stability frequency references and clocks for flight and ground applications.

The Flight Communications & Tracking Section at JPL is looking for a highly motivated and experienced **Flight Telecom Systems Engineer III** to join their Communication System Engineering and Operations Group. As a member of this Group, you will have an opportunity to be involved in all phases of product development from early concept and mission formulation, low technology readiness specification and prototyping to engineering and flight model development and implementation, functional and environmental testing, and flight operations support. In this role, you will perform complex and wide-ranging engineering tasks across the telecom discipline and its interfaces, exercising increasing independence across the product lifecycle.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

* Provide telecom system engineering support on flight telecom subsystems for deep-space, Earth-orbiting, and lunar/Mars relay missions. Generate telecom component and subsystem requirements with flow-down, and verify multifunctional telecom requirements for consistency across interfacing subsystems.
* Conduct system-level link analyses using statistically derived link parameters. Independently evaluate telecom components, algorithms, systems, and end-to-end performance, identifying improvements and risks.
* Apply advanced principles to interpret complex telecom and tracking data and test results. Research subsystem data to inform architecture and risk decisions, partnering with project personnel on risk mitigation plans.
* Lead infusion of new technology into flight telecom products, documenting requirements, progress, and test results. Develop critical technical models for improved multifunctional telecom products.
* Partner with engineers and project personnel on cross-discipline trade studies and analyses of alternatives. Provide telecom support to Team X concurrent design and to mission and concept proposal teams, including formal proposal writing and review.

* Draft or update telecom functional description documents, comm behavior manager documents, and design control documents such as ICDs, requirements, test reports, and design description documents.
* Create detailed test plans, procedures, and reports aligned with V&V objectives. Develop critical V&V plans and verify requirements. Support key spacecraft-level ATLO tests: subsystem functional, ground-station compatibility, and environmental testing.
* Collaborate with ground station providers: DSN, NSN, ESTRACK, and commercial providers (e.g., KSAT).
* Support HRCR and CoFR reviews for telecom flight deliveries. Lead disposition of complex, significant-impact ECRs through CCB concurrence and approval, and draft waivers as needed.
* Support the product manager on risks, performance error budgets, trade studies, design integration, and delivery schedules. Present technical status and results at management, project, and design reviews.
* Serve as a real-time telecom operations engineer across all mission phases (launch, cruise, critical events, extended operations), monitoring subsystem health, performance, and link status.

jobs.description:
At Meta, we're building and operating one of the world's most dynamic and fast-paced networks, powering our global data centers and supporting cutting-edge technologies like AI, Generative AI, Recommendation engines, and the Metaverse. Our network infrastructure teams are responsible for developing, deploying, and operating this complex system, covering the entire network lifecycle from hardware development to operation. FBOSS is a software team in the Network Infrastructure group that powers the network devices Meta runs. FBOSS stands for Facebook Open Switching System - a software stack running on network switches across Meta's global network. We work on some of the most critical infrastructure challenges at Meta, including the networking switch platforms behind our AI clusters for large language models, recommendation systems, and the metaverse. This role is part of our FBOSS Platform SW team which works across every stage of a network switch: defining new switch requirements, hardware/software design, software development, bringing up current Linux kernels on our switch platforms, and supporting them in operation.Why this role, and why now:Our switching platforms have historically operated in facilities where physical access and the surrounding network are tightly controlled. We are now extending these platforms into environments that do not offer those guarantees - including backbone and other less-trusted deployment settings - where the platform itself has to carry security properties it previously inherited from its surroundings. This role exists to close that gap across platform, operating system, and data plane security.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded Systems Security Responsibilities:**

* Own systems design spanning hardware and software, with security treated as a first-class design input rather than a late-stage review
* Operating system security: OS hardening, attestation, image signing and update integrity, credential and key management, privilege and isolation boundaries
* Platform security: secure boot, hardware root of trust, firmware and BMC integrity, signed and verifiable update paths, physical port and console exposure, tamper considerations
* Develop and maintain Linux drivers and board support for custom switch designs, and work with vendors to ensure compliance with our specifications, including security requirements
* Own workstreams focused on hardware bring-up and lead the cross-functional effort to complete engineering validation of new switches
* Work closely with the hardware team to review and influence switch design, ensuring sound software-hardware integration and that security-relevant hardware capabilities are present and usable
* Contribute to BMC software design and structure, including its integrity and trust properties
* Improve platform resilience and operational health, including self-healing and auto-triage approaches for the fleet
* Assess our switching platforms against a threat model that assumes an untrusted physical and network environment, and identify where we are actually exposed
* Work on protecting the data and control planes over links that traverse untrusted environments
* Partner with the kernel team on driver integration and kernel upgrades across switch designs, including timely handling of security fixes
* Partner with security engineering teams to understand applicable requirements, map the stakeholders behind them, and reason through trade-offs - distinguishing must-haves from should-haves and making a defensible case where an exception is warranted

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of software development experience in networking, distributed systems, or a related technical domain, or PhD with 2+ years of experience in a relevant technical area
* Experience working on systems software in a large-scale C++ code base
* Experience in one or more of: operating systems, Linux, RTOS, containers, or developer-infrastructure tooling
* Knowledge of software development processes such as CI/CD and testing frameworks
* Hands-on experience with operating system or software-supply-chain security - for example OS hardening, image signing, secure update paths, key and credential management, or privilege and isolation boundaries
* Ability to reason about the security implications of running a system in an untrusted environment
* Experience with source control, bug tracking, and design documentation
* Experience developing, debugging, and shipping software on large code bases spanning platforms and tools

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with supply-chain integrity for firmware and software artifacts
* Demonstrated success working collaboratively across large cross-functional teams
* Experience working with security engineering or compliance stakeholders to negotiate requirements and exceptions
* Experience hardening or securing embedded or networking platforms deployed outside a controlled facility

Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people — move around the planet. We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.

Flight Software links together the mechanical, avionics, algorithmic, and embedded worlds to actually make the airplane fly. As a Build Software Engineer on the Platform Engineering team, you are a software engineer who is passionate about build systems and making the developer experience meaningfully better. You will design and maintain the systems that build, test and deploy the entire flight software suite—this includes developing custom Rust command line tools.

As a Build Software Engineer, you will be part of the Platform Engineering team. The Platform Engineering team drives the productivity of Reliable’s flight software developers by providing the build infrastructure, developer tooling, continuous integration pipelines, hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testbed integration, and cloud-based simulation deployments necessary to develop, test, and certify our autonomous aircraft software. You will help develop and maintain essential tools that enable developers at Reliable Robotics to deliver software products that are safe, successful, and meet certification requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain and evolve our CMake-based build system to ensure all software builds supporting flight are fast, reliable, and repeatable across on-premise and cloud environments.

* Refactor C++ code to be build-system-ready, untangling dependencies, modularizing targets, and improving compile and link times.
* Develop internal CLI tools and build orchestration tooling using Rust to streamline developer workflows.
* Partner across Flight Software, Embedded, Simulation, and IT/DevOps teams to ensure our build and CI pipelines support hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testbeds, cloud simulations, and certification requirements.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working with C++, with the ability to refactor C++ codebases to be build-system-ready
* 2+ years of professional experience refactoring and maintaining a modern C++ build system (CMake and similar systems such as Ninja or Bazel)
* Some experience with Rust (or strong interest in writing internal CLI and build tooling in Rust)

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

**Job Description:**

Microchip Data Center Solutions (DCS) Group vision is to connect, manage and secure the world's information by delivering innovative solutions for storage, memory & computer connectivity and end-point solutions aligned to market transitions. Our mission is to be the preferred partner for storage, memory, connectivity and end-point storage solutions for the world's data centers including AI infrastructure. Microchip, being one of the major suppliers of SAS/SATA Expanders and SAS/SATA/NVMe Storage controllers, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced firmware development engineer, who will be joining a team of professionals in developing software and Real-Time Firmware solutions for state-of-art System-on-Chip (SoC) devices with embedded processors.

The successful applicant will report to the Manager of Firmware Engineering and will collaborate with cross-geo teams to design, develop, debug and support a wide variety of storage controllers and expanders. As a Senior Engineer II, you will join the Storage Firmware Development team, which builds world-class, high-performance SAS/SATA storage controller products for server OEMs and data centers.

**Responsibilities**

You will take part in every stage of firmware development, from design and development through validation for the storage controller product (IOC/ROC).

Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Build firmware for storage controllers that runs on embedded multi-core microprocessors (MIPS, ARM) and provides SAS and SATA IO controller functions.
* Develop firmware and driver code, including the Linux and Windows drivers that interact with the controller firmware. Build the unit test framework, run the unit tests, and automate them using the test automation infrastructure.
* Work with the OS driver, BMC/software management application and ASIC teams to define firmware interfaces optimized for performance and ease of use.
* Program in C and assembly on a custom RTOS, Linux and ThreadX. Use the Green Hills and GNU toolchains and EJTAG debuggers.
* Take part in requirement analysis. Author detailed firmware and driver design documents, including analysis of design options and selection of the most appropriate design, data structures and algorithms. Maintain existing design documents and provide input to end-user documentation.
* Triage functional and performance issues reported by internal and external customers and lead the resolution across functional areas. Use SAS and PCIe analyzers, logic analyzers and probes to diagnose hardware-firmware interactions.

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Electronics Engineering; Master's degree preferred
* 7.5 - 10 years of experience
* Must demonstrate strong embedded C skills. Knowledge of any assembly language is a plus.
* Must have embedded firmware development experience in domains such as direct-attached storage, storage controllers, SAS, SATA, FC or iSCSI products, including hands-on experience with storage protocols such as SAS, SATA, FC or iSCSI, and multi-core environments on embedded CPUs such as MIPS or ARM.
* Must have knowledge of RTOS constructs: processes, threads, scheduling, synchronization mechanisms, events and memory management.
* Must have experience with hardware and software debugging tools such as EJTAG debuggers and GDB. Hands-on experience with PCIe, SAS analyzers, Green Hills or GNU toolchain is a plus.
* Exposure to storage performance analysis and tuning skills. Hands-on experience with performance tuning tools on different operating systems is a plus.
* Exposure to storage security features (encryption, hash algorithms, SMS 2.0, Calpitra/RoT) and out of band management (BMC/MCTP/PLDM/SPDM) are an added advantage.
* Exposure to SSD and flash technology is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to conceive, design, implement, document and release complex firmware systems through commercial release.
* Highly motivated, able to set and achieve goals without supervision.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good presentation skills, with the ability to present technical ideas to customers and to principal engineers.
* Capable of working with customers and technology partners on architecture development.

No Travel

Feeling, Hearing, Other, Seeing, Talking, Works Alone, Works Around Others

**Physical Requirements:**

10% standing, 10% walking, 80% sitting

We offer a total comp

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Anyware Robotics is seeking a Robotics Mechatronics Engineer with expertise in electronics to join our team.

### **About Anyware Robotics**

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

### **Description**

Location: Onsite, Fremont

Department: Hardware Team

Employment Type: Full-time

Reports To: Sanchit

**About Anyware**

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

**The Role**

Anyware Robotics is seeking a Robotics Mechatronics Engineer with expertise in electronics to join our team.

As a Mechatronics Engineer, you will work with a team of innovative engineers from various high-tech industries to prototype robotic systems. You will have the opportunity to apply your expertise in electrical, electronics, embedded, and communication sub-systems to design, prototype, test, and deliver features for our advanced generation of robots. You will also work on troubleshooting and integrating sensors, actuators, and control systems to help shape our robotic technology.

**What You’ll Do**

* Collaborate with a team of like-minded innovators to prototype robotic systems.
* Design, assemble, and test custom PCBAs, inclusive of prototyping, integration with the robot, and debugging as per requirements.
* Work on selection and integration of AC–DC converters, DC–DC converters, suitable motors, and motor drives following technical requirements of the robot.
* Design schematics for control architecture involving PLC. Further, implement the same in robots through integration of hardware and development of firmware.
* Work with PLC or microcontrollers for quick proof-of-concept testing.
* Dive into the world of sensors, actuators, and control systems to develop and troubleshoot our robots.
* Investigate and troubleshoot issues in the robot. Develop solutions as well as documentation to reduce potential failures in future.
* Share your knowledge and skills with your teammates, fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and growth.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Enthusiastic about robotics.
* Currently pursuing or having a degree in fields such as Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent.
* Experience in robotics competition (BattleBot, FRC, etc.), vehicle competition (F-SAE, Baja, etc.), or any technical competition.
* Understanding of digital and analog signals as well as common communication protocols such as UART, I2C, CAN, RS232, etc.
* Solid understanding of electrical circuits, including the ability to read and interpret circuit diagrams, schematics, and wiring drawings.
* Hands-on experience with standard assembly and diagnostic tools, including power tools, hand tools, power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Hands-on experience wiring electromechanical modules in accordance with circuit diagrams and established wiring standards.
* Highly motivated teammate with excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic start-up environment as part of a small team.
* Work on a full-time schedule at our office in Fremont.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience of working with PLCs or microcontrollers.
* Experience of designing PCBAs in either Altium, KiCad, Autodesk Eagle, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with Python or C++.
* Familiarity with robotics software frameworks such as ROS/ROS2.

If you are a motivated and talented engineer looking to gain practical experience in the field of robotics, we would love to hear from you. Join us and contribute to the development of cutting-edge robotic technology with your skills and enthusiasm. This is an exciting opportunity to work on innovative projects and make a real impact on the future of robotics.

**Why Anyware**

* An A+ Team: Anyware is built by a top-tier team. Collectively, our team has won six Best Paper Awards and Finalists, including the ICRA 2025 Best Paper Award and ICRA 2024 Best Paper Award.
* An A+ Robot: Our robot Pixmo has won multiple awards, including a RBR50 and Best Innovation Awards at both ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026, North America’s largest logistics automation exhibitions. Notably, this is the first time in history that a company has won this prestigious award back-to-back.
* Real Impact: You will contribute directly to deploying the core manipulation intelligence that powers every Pixmo deployment. Your work does not stop at a demo. It ships into real customer sites and solves real problems at scale.
* Fast Growth: You will sharpen your skills with strong ownership and real responsibility. The team size is doubling every year, creating plenty of room for talent to step in and shine.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The expected salary range for this role is from $90,000–$120,000 USD depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits include daily meals, per diem, PTO, sick leave, and unlimited snacks and beverages in the office.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Anyware is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume, portfolio, and any relevant materials through the Anyware Career platform. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in joining our team.

#### **Salary**

$90,000 - $120,000 per year

jobs.title: Firmware Principal Engineer – System Development
jobs.description:
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Firmware Principal Systems Development Engineer**

Join us as a Senior Principal System Development Engineer on our Network HW Engineering team in Santa Clara, CA or Austin, TX to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.

**What you’ll achieve**
-----------------------

As a **Firmware Principal Systems Development Engineer,** you will be part of the end-to-end development of next-generation Network L10 switches and L11 rack-level solutions for hyperscale, cloud, and AI infrastructure. Working in a fast-paced environment where innovation, technical leadership, and execution excellence are highly valued, you will drive product strategy, architecture, and delivery from concept through production. You will collaborate across hardware, firmware, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to develop scalable, high-performance networking solutions while ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer requirements, and technology roadmaps.

**You will:**

* Lead the FW/Diag end-to-end development of Network L10 switch platforms and L11 rack-level solutions, driving product architecture, qualification, production readiness, and sustaining activities
* Provide technical leadership for system integration across hardware, firmware, software, cabling, optics, power, thermal, and rack infrastructure to deliver scalable, high-performance networking solutions
* Own, develop, and review Diags, ONIE, BMC, BIOS, and platform management specifications, ensuring alignment with product requirements, quality standards, and supportability objectives
* Define and drive validation, test, and integration strategies for system software and hardware components, resolving complex cross-functional issues throughout the product lifecycle
* Partner with engineering teams, ODMs, suppliers, manufacturing, and business stakeholders to manage risks, influence technology roadmaps, accelerate time-to-market, and deliver successful networking products

**Take the first step towards your dream career**
-------------------------------------------------

**Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Essential Requirements**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of experience developing **Diags, ONIE, BMC, BIOS/UEFI,** and platform firmware for networking switch products, including 100G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T Ethernet platforms
* Strong expertise in embedded software and firmware development, including operating systems, device drivers, platform management, networking protocols, and system-level software architecture
* Deep knowledge of platform security technologies and secure development practices, including PFR, RoT/eROT, Secure Boot, code signing, threat modelling, and SDL methodologies
* Proven ability to architect, develop, debug, and optimize complex, scalable software solutions, while providing technical leadership and mentoring across cross-functional engineering teams
* Expert-level experience with UEFI/EDK II architecture, Broadcom SDKs, PHY drivers, and networking switch platforms, with a strong understanding of system integration, platform bring-up, and deployment within enterprise and hyperscale environments

**Desirable Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* Ability to lead, motivate and direct a workgroup; capability to influence others to achieve results

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. * Develop and maintain new and existing software applications.

* Experience with developing multi-threaded software used for one of the following real-time applications: flight critical, safety, medical, or mission critical software.

* Understanding of how their embedded software will fit into a larger software system.
* Ability to document, capture, and present software architectural components in modeling or diagramming tools.
* Experience with software running on Real-Time Operating systems such as: VxWorks, Integrity, and/or Real Time Embedded Linux.

* Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, and the ability to interface with all levels of employees and management.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. Our Engineering and Sciences (E&S) organization pushes the boundaries of innovation, redefines engineering capabilities, and advances the state of various sciences. Our team provides the skills and innovative technologies needed to develop, design, produce, and sustain optimized product lines across the sector while delivering a decisive advantage to the warfighter. Come be a part of our mission!

Our team is looking for a **Principal Systems Engineer** to support the U.S. Navy’s EA-18G Growler Block I and Growler Block II Programs through software integration testing and systems engineering of the EA-18G’s Airborne Electronic Attack subsystems. The ideal candidate will have a strong systems engineering background, experience with electronic attack systems, and expertise in software requirements, including developing and executing test plans to verify requirements.

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across software integration, verification, and systems engineering activities. This role will lead test planning and execution, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, mentor junior engineers, drive issue resolution, and serve as a technical interface with customers and program stakeholders. The position requires an individual who is motivated by complex systems, enjoys leading teams, and is passionate about delivering mission-critical capabilities.

The successful candidate will work with a multidisciplinary team supporting complex electronic warfare systems at the Naval Air Warfare Center, Point Mugu, and the Northrop Grumman Camarillo, CA office.

* Lead software integration, regression, and verification testing for electronic warfare systems.

* Develop, review, and approve complex test procedures used to verify software and system requirements.
* Lead technical discussions and coordinate task execution across systems engineering, software, hardware, test, and program teams.
* Analyze system designs and lead participation in subsystem requirements development, allocation, traceability, and verification.
* Serve as a technical point of contact for assigned systems engineering and test activities.
* Lead identification, investigation, and resolution of software and system problems, including developing and evaluating technical solutions.
* Provide technical direction and guidance to less-experienced engineers.
* Plan and prioritize work within an Agile team while balancing schedule, technical performance, and program objectives.
* Track technical risks, dependencies, issues, and action items through closure.
* Collaborate with customers, internal Northrop Grumman sites, suppliers, and other technical disciplines.

* Present technical status, risks, test results, and recommendations to program leadership and customer stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement of engineering, test, and verification processes.

* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM-related field with 5 or more years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree in a STEM-related field with 3 or more years of relevant experience.
* Experience developing embedded software tests.
* Experience with Airborne Electronic Attack systems.
* Experience with requirements management databases, such as DOORS.
* Experience developing software test plans and leading or directing testing activities.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Experience leading technical reviews, resolving complex engineering issues, and communicating results to customers or program leadership.
* Familiarity with the Atlassian software development and collaboration toolset, including Jira and Confluence.
* U.S. citizen.
* Active U.S. Secret clearance.
* Ability to work onsite full time.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in electronic warfare.
* Experience leading systems engineering or software verification teams.
* Project or technical program management experience.
* Experience planning and managing integrated test activities.
* Knowledge of U.S. Navy electronic warfare systems.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineer.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Quantum Control, Quantum AI
jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience designing embedded software, firmware, or device drivers.
* Experience developing kernel drivers for hardware devices (e.g., NICs, PCIe devices, or hardware accelerators).
* Experience reading and interpreting hardware schematics, datasheets, and register maps.
* Experience with C, Linux kernel internals (memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization primitives), DMA engines, and cache coherency.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with embedded real-time CPUs, real-time Linux patches (PREEMPT\_RT), or bare-metal development.
* Experience with PCIe device drivers, enumeration, and bus controllers.
* Experience with Yocto or Buildroot for creating custom Linux distributions.
* Experience with hardware description languages (Verilog or VHDL) and FPGA constraints.
* Experience with userspace I/O frameworks (e.g., DPDK, SPDK, or VFIO) for high-performance applications.
* Experience writing Linux subsystem drivers (e.g., V4L2, ALSA, or IIO).

**About the job**
-----------------

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop low-level software for electronics that control and readout our future quantum computers. You will collaborate with electrical engineers and FPGA/ASIC designers to bring custom hardware to life, ensuring drivers exploit full performance capabilities for scaled quantum processors.

In this role, you will develop firmware and drivers delivered with Quantum's control and readout electronics. You will contribute to hardware-software co-verification, collaborating with architects and digital designers to understand functional requirements, design verification plans, and drive their execution. Additionally, you will participate in system architecture discussions and contribute to software system requirements.

Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner with the hardware team during pre-silicon and post-silicon phases to perform board bring-up, verify register maps, and validate hardware behavior against specifications.
* Integrate drivers into the broader software stack, including RTOS (if applicable), userspace libraries, and HALs.
* Diagnose complex system-level issues using JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and kernel debugging tools (ftrace, kgdb, crash).
* Provide feedback to hardware designers on register interfaces and interrupt mechanisms to improve software programmability in future hardware revisions.

jobs.title: Principal Firmware Engineer - AI System/OpenBMC
jobs.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

  
  

Platform management firmware is essential to the reliability, serviceability, and manageability of hyperscale AI servers. This Principal-level role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry.
* **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams.
* **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements.
* **Bring-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system-integration domains.
* **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale.
* **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred.
* **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C++ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT.
* **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows.
* **Communication:** Able to lead cross-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives.

Compensation: $214,000 to $290,000

The Platform IoT team runs the device cloud that keeps Motive devices connected. We own the full path between devices and the cloud, including provisioning and identity, messaging, firmware updates and certificates, configuration delivery, data ingestion, and monitoring. Our platform supports more than 1 million connected devices across North America and Europe.

As a Software Engineer on the team, you'll build and monitor the services behind these systems and own projects end-to-end—from design and well-tested code to safe deployment and production operations. jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft’s over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.

As Microsoft’s cloud business continues to grow, the ability to deploy new offerings and HW infrastructure on time, in high volume, with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the SCHIE team is instrumental in defining and delivering measures of success for hardware design, qualification, fleet support, scale, and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware.

Azure Memory and Storage Center of Excellence (AMS CoE) is part of the SCHIE organization focusing on memory and storage devices going into the cloud hardware servers. AMS provides memory and storage solutions to Azure and drives memory and storage suppliers to deliver high quality products that meet our requirements. AMS CoE also leads Azure Fault Prediction and Detection (AFPD), the platform that predicts, detects and repairs hardware failures across the Azure fleet.

We are looking for a **Cloud Principal Hardware Engineer** to scale AFPD across hardware components in the Azure fleet and to lead hands-on hardware resiliency for the platform.

The opportunity:

Every hour a server sits unhealthy is an hour of lost customer capacity. AFPD turns hardware, firmware and OS telemetry into early detection and prediction of failures, moves customer workloads off failing nodes, and sends a targeted repair for the part that failed. Repair outcomes and supplier failure analysis then improve the next rule or model.

You will be working on incorporating into the platform components such as storage, memory, power supply, CPU, GPU, NIC, HBA/FPGA, cables and the rest of the server, and you will be the subject matter expert the team relies on when a failure needs to be prevented. Across millions of nodes, each improvement means fewer VM interruptions for customers and faster return of online capacity.

Why this role:

Your impact shows up in fleet availability and customer uptime, quarter over quarter. You will set the hardware direction for a platform that influences production infrastructure at a scale, and you will work directly with Azure engineering, component teams and leading hardware suppliers.

#SCHIE #azurehwjobs

 **Responsibilities**

* Lead failure analysis across server components: characterize failure modes from fleet telemetry and logs and confirm root cause with repair results and supplier failure analysis.

* Define the signals, thresholds, targeted diagnostics and repair recipes, and work with component teams for the root cause analysis.

* Improve isolation accuracy so each repair address the source of failures: improve efficacy of the detection and repair services.

* Partner with software engineers and data scientists on detection rules and prediction models; set precision targets and validation gates before a rule or model takes action on production nodes.

* Use AI agents and machine learning to automate failure analysis, live-site triage and supplier RCA follow-up, and to shorten the time from a new failure signature to a detection rule.

* Lead root cause and corrective actions with server components, including firmware fixes, and feed the learnings back into the platform.

* Lead as the senior hardware escalation point for live-site incidents, from triage through root cause to fleet-wide mitigation.

* Make new server generations and AI/GPU platforms platform-ready before they reach production, with detection, isolation and repair coverage at launch.

* Track and improve metrics & mentor engineers across the team.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

  + Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Quilifications:

* Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience

* OR Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience

* OR equivalent experience

* 6+ years of hands-on failure analysis, debug or reliability engineering for server or datacenter hardware, covering two or more server component types

* 3+ years leading root cause analysis and corrective actions with hardware suppliers, OEMs or ODMs

Navigation Solutions delivers advanced military GPS and Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) capabilities supporting weapon systems, ground platforms, airborne assets, maritime systems, and space applications. The Production Transition Engineer leads engineering activities that transition GPS receivers, simulators, and PNT subsystems from development into stable, repeatable production.

This role focuses on the development of special test equipment (STE), hardware and software integration, production test readiness, and electromagnetic interference/electromagnetic compatibility (EMI/EMC) testing. The engineer collaborates with systems engineering, hardware, software, firmware, manufacturing, quality, and program management teams to ensure products meet performance, reliability, manufacturability, and delivery requirements.

* Analyze production test data to identify failure trends, improve first-pass yield, reduce test cycle time, and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Prepare and release test procedures, equipment specifications, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and production handoff documentation.
* Coordinate with suppliers, external laboratories, customers, and test organizations to resolve integration and qualification issues.

* Proficiency in test automation and data analysis using tools such as Python, NI Teststand, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or comparable platforms.
* Ability to interpret schematics, interface specifications, engineering drawings, and system requirements.
* Experience with RF and electronic instrumentation, such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes, and network analyzers.
* Knowledge of system test automation execution and experience in isolating issues in both software and hardware.
* Working knowledge of EMI/EMC test methods, troubleshooting techniques, and applicable standards.
* Strong root-cause analysis, technical documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS operates a fleet of servers at the Edge, powering various workloads at cloud scale. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service.  
  
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of Edge servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.  
  
What You Will Do  
You will own programs where the critical path runs through silicon, firmware, and software teams simultaneously. You will translate ambiguity into structure: turning a fleet telemetry signal into a corrective action plan with quantified failure rates, a customer requirement into a new platform milestone with EVT/DVT/PVT gates, or a manufacturing escape into a design change with updated validation criteria. You will drive decisions on program trade-offs — adjusting scope when qualification gates slip, balancing deployment speed against fleet risk, and determining when to accept interim mitigations instead of holding for root-cause fixes. When a large scale of servers depend on your program landing on time, you are the one ensuring hardware readiness, qualification completeness, and operational handoff happen without gaps.  
  
Why You Will Love It  
Your programs launch the servers that power various services and applications at the Edge. You will see your decisions reflected in fleet reliability metrics within weeks of deployment. The team is small and high-trust — you own programs end to end from concept through production, with direct access to leadership and engineering alike.  
  
The Ideal Candidate  
You have deep technical intuition across hardware and software — enough to challenge engineering decisions, not just track them. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing structure to programs where requirements, timelines, and dependencies are still forming. You align priorities across teams in different organizations, and you escalate with data, not noise. You actively mentor and develop others — TPMs and engineers alike. You contribute to hiring, promotion assessments, and raising the bar for program management practices in your organization.

Strategy & Mechanisms  
  

* Define program strategy, objectives, and success criteria; influence resource allocation and priority decisions across engineering workstreams to align with organizational goals
* Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data-driven decisions and early risk detection
* Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity

Execution & Coordination

* Manage ODM partnerships: track EVT/DVT/PVT builds, manufacturing readiness gates, Bill of Materials (BOM) management in PLM systems, and quality checkpoints
* Identify blockers early, escalate dependencies before they impact critical path, and facilitate technical trade-off decisions across engineering workstreams.
* Communicate program status to leadership with clear reporting on milestone progress, risk posture, and mitigation plans.

  
Risk & Quality  
  

* Challenge technical workstreams to surface risks early; quantify impact to schedule and reliability (annualized failure rate targets, availability SLAs) with proposed mitigations
* Drive root cause analysis of fleet-wide hardware failures and ensure corrective actions flow back into qualification criteria and design requirements
* Define acceptance criteria, coordinate qualification testing at server and rack levels, and manage go/no-go decisions for mission-critical workloads

  
Transition  
  

* Conduct knowledge transfer and document lessons learned; ensure operational readiness including automation, monitoring, and runbook completeness for production handoff

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Additive Manufacturing Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------

Hadrian is building an additive manufacturing capability that runs as part of an autonomous factory, not as a room full of printers. The hard problem is not any single machine, material, or line of code. It is making all of them behave as one system. Systems engineering is the glue that holds that system together, and this role owns the glue.

The Senior Director leads three engineering functions, materials and process engineering, hardware engineering, and software engineering, and is accountable for the digital backbone that binds them to each other and to applications engineering: the architecture, interfaces, and data that connect Hadrian’s Opus platform to cutting-edge additive manufacturing equipment, add automation where it makes sense, fuse sensor data into the part record, and turn a collection of parts into a full, integrated digital manufacturing system built around additive.

The measure of success is not three strong teams. It is one manufacturing system that a customer part flows through, from design intent to qualified hardware, with every decision and every data point captured along the way.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Architect the system.** Define and control the end-to-end architecture for additive at Hadrian: requirements, interfaces, data model, and acceptance criteria that hold across multiple equipment platforms, modalities, and sites. Treat the factory as the product.
* **Build the digital backbone.** Connect additive equipment, peripherals, and inspection assets to Opus with the same discipline a semiconductor fab applies to connecting tools to the host: standardized state models, telemetry, event streams, and data contracts, with security and configuration control built in.
* **Fuse the sensors.** Bring in-situ monitoring, machine telemetry, environmental data, and downstream inspection into one correlated record per part, then move from monitoring to data-driven release and, where it is justified, closed-loop control.
* **Automate where it pays.** Lead automation across additive cells (material and powder handling, build changeover, part removal and depowdering, post-processing flow, robotics, controls, and safety) with a written case for each: safety, repeatability, and data capture first; labor second. Never automate an unstable process.
* **Lead the three functions as one.** Set standards, priorities, and cadence for materials and process, hardware, and software engineering. Resolve conflicts between them at the architecture level, not the escalation level.
* **Own the applications engineering interface.** With the Head of Applications Engineering, define what a production-ready hand-off looks like, publish the process capability and design-rule data applications engineers build to, and close the loop from floor results back into design guidance.
* **Industrialize the equipment.** Through the hardware engineering leader, own factory and site acceptance, commissioning, reliability (preventive maintenance, spares, MTBF/MTTR), and configuration-controlled modification and upgrade of additive systems, and lead the technical relationships with equipment partners that unlock deeper integration. The machine-level depth lives in that team; the standards and the outcomes live here.
* **Design for the factory.** Partner with Factory Development and Factory Automation on cell and site design: material flow, capacity, simulation, utilities, and the path to lights-out operation for additive.
* **Build quality in.** Make the system itself the evidence: traceability, data integrity, and process control that stand up to AS9100 audits and customer qualification without a separate paper trail.
* **Be the additive voice in Hadrian’s platform.** Carry additive requirements into Core Engineering and the Opus roadmap, and bring platform capability back to the floor.
* **Hire, develop, and retain.** Build a leadership bench under you, set a high technical bar, and make Hadrian the place the best additive systems engineers in the country want to work.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a physical science; an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 12+ years in advanced manufacturing, with real depth in at least three of these six domains: factory design and industrial automation; semiconductor or other high-reliability capital-equipment engineering; manufacturing software and data systems; materials science and process engineering; quality systems in regulated industries; sensing, process monitoring, and sensor fusion.
* 5+ years leading engineering teams, including leading through managers and building at least one function from the ground up.
* Production experience with metal laser powde

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and mechanically inclined **Automation Engineering Technician II** to support custom automated equipment in a precision manufacturing environment.

This position is ideal for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting complex machinery, working with small and delicate mechanical components, and solving challenging equipment problems independently.

The successful candidate will possess strong mechanical and electromechanical troubleshooting abilities, excellent attention to detail, and the curiosity and patience needed to diagnose unfamiliar equipment issues.

This role involves maintaining, repairing, and improving automated production equipment while collaborating with engineering and manufacturing teams to minimize downtime and maintain consistent production quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently troubleshoot, diagnose, repair, and maintain automated manufacturing and assembly equipment.
* Perform preventive maintenance and corrective repairs to maximize equipment uptime and production efficiency.
* Work with small, delicate, and precision-machined components requiring careful handling, assembly, disassembly, and adjustment.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and electromechanical equipment failures.
* Set up, adjust, and maintain precision tooling, automated machinery, robotic equipment, and associated components.
* Investigate unfamiliar equipment problems using logical troubleshooting techniques, technical curiosity, and persistence.
* Support engineering teams with the installation, testing, modification, and implementation of automated manufacturing systems.
* Assist with troubleshooting and maintaining PLC-controlled equipment, robotic systems, sensors, and machine vision systems.
* Support equipment involving precision forming, winding, coiling, or similar mechanical processes.
* Assist with the fabrication, modification, and installation of tooling and fixtures.
* Collaborate with production personnel to prioritize maintenance requests and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor and respond to equipment service requests through email and internal communication systems.
* Maintain accurate preventive maintenance records, equipment documentation, and work instructions.
* Identify opportunities to improve machine reliability, efficiency, safety, and overall production performance.
* Communicate professionally with machine operators, engineers, and other internal stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree, technical certification, or post-secondary training in electronics, robotics, electromechanical technology, industrial maintenance, or a related technical discipline; **or at least 3 years of relevant hands-on technical experience.**
* Experience troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining manufacturing equipment in an industrial or production environment.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and demonstrated ability to diagnose equipment problems independently.
* Experience working with small precision components, delicate hardware, or equipment requiring detailed assembly and disassembly.
* Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and electromechanical systems.
* Ability to interpret equipment problems, investigate root causes, and implement effective repairs with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail, patience, and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with production personnel and engineering teams.
* Comfortable working directly on the manufacturing floor in a hands-on technical capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in high-volume, precision, or automated manufacturing environments.
* Background in automotive manufacturing, industrial automation, precision assembly, or similar technical industries.
* Experience with precision coiling equipment, coiler heads, winding machinery, or related mechanical systems.
* Familiarity with laser cutting, laser welding, or laser-based manufacturing equipment.
* Experience troubleshooting PLC-controlled machinery, robotic systems, or machine vision equipment.
* Knowledge of precision tooling, fixtures, machining tolerances, and small-part manufacturing processes.
* Experience modifying, fabricating, or repairing tooling and equipment components.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams for managing service requests, communicating with colleagues, and coordinating maintenance activities.
* Experience supporting continuous improvement initiatives and equipment reliability projects.

**What Makes a Successful Candidate?**

We are particularly interested in technicians who demonstrate the following qualities:

* **Independent Problem-Solving:** Can investigate and resolve mechanical or equipment failures without relying on constant direction.
* **Mechanical Curiosity:** Enjoys understanding how machinery works and figuring out solutions to unfamiliar technical challenges.
* **Precision and Patience:** Comfortable working with small, delicate components that require careful handling and attention to detail.
* **Hands-On Technical Ability:** Willing and able to disassemble, inspect, repair, adjust, and reassemble complex equipment.
* **Professional Communication:** Understands the importance of responding promptly to equipment service requests and maintaining positive working relationships with production teams.
* **Adaptability:** Can apply troubleshooting experience from different industries or equipment types to new manufacturing challenges.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Occasional bending, stooping, and squatting.
* Ability to frequently lift or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment with varying noise levels and required personal protective equipment.

jobs.description:
**ELECTRICAL ENGINEER (INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION)**

Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits.

As an Electrical Automation Engineer at Freeform, you will contribute significantly to electrical system design, development, and integration efforts for our advanced metal 3D printing factories, with a specific focus on automation design. Your ownership will include but is not limited to automation system architecture, sensor and actuator selection, electrical schematic capture, cabinet layout and build, and wire and cable harness design. You will use a first principles approach to solving problems and tackling new areas within electrical engineering that you may not have directly worked on before. The ideal candidate is capable of running projects from cradle to grave and can work effectively with other engineering disciplines.

You'll be building the electrical backbone of machines that combine high-power lasers, high-speed galvanometer scanning, precision motion, and inert-gas processing of reactive metal powders, all instrumented with high-speed sensing and data acquisition that feeds our real-time controls. While you won't own every one of these subsystems, you will work side by side with the different engineers who do, and you'll get hands-on exposure to FPGA-based hardware, optomechanical assemblies, and complex electromechanical systems that most automation roles never touch.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, deploy, and maintain industrial automation hardware supporting the core functionalities of Freeform's systems, including but not limited to drives, sensors, PLCs, power distribution systems, networking, actuators, safety interlocks.
* Own electrical schematics and layouts for industrial automation boxes and cabinets.
* Own all wiring harness design and fabrication, as well as cable management from end-to-end.
* Develop safety interlock circuits and mechanisms.
* Collaborate with mechanical and software teams to ensure consistency across all disciplines involving industrial controls.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or similar engineering discipline.
* 2+ years of professional experience designing industrial automation equipment
* Experience developing systems with safety and reliability requirements.
* Well-versed in electrical engineering fundamentals and comfortable taking a first-principles approach to solving problems

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* 5+ years of professional experience in electrical engineering.
* Familiarity with industrial automation technologies, robotics, spacecraft avionics, or similar high-performance electromechanical system
* Experience with sensors and industrial networking.

To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, software, hardware, manufacturing and operations at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the *hard work* is in front of us.
  
  
NEO is our flagship - a general purpose robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it, we're shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back - because it is.
