jobs.title: SCMS Systems Engineer II SOF Baumholder
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Systems Engineer II (Journeyman) provides engineering, integration, installation, and lifecycle support for Special Operations Forces (SOF) C5ISR systems and infrastructure. The successful candidate will support the design, modernization, deployment, and sustainment of enterprise and tactical communications systems, network infrastructure, physical security systems, and audiovisual collaboration environments supporting mission-critical operations. This position requires a hands-on engineer capable of independently executing technical responsibilities across all phases of the system lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture development, network design, system integration, testing, deployment, and customer support. The engineer will work closely with government stakeholders, installation personnel, and cross-functional engineering teams to support military construction (MILCON), technology refresh, and modernization initiatives, including the Baumholder Network Infrastructure and System Integration effort.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Conduct site surveys and technical assessments of facilities, infrastructure, platforms, and existing communications systems.
* Analyze operational requirements, physical constraints, cybersecurity requirements, and mission needs to develop engineering solutions.
* Develop and maintain network, communications, and security system architectures supporting SOF missions.
* Support preliminary design reviews (PDRs), critical design reviews (CDRs), and other engineering reviews.
* Identify technical risks, develop mitigation strategies, and recommend design improvements to enhance system performance and interoperability.
* Integrate emerging technologies and capabilities into existing SOF C5ISR architectures.

**Network Infrastructure & Communications**

* Design, integrate, and support:
* + Enterprise LAN/WAN environments
  + Tactical communications systems
  + Secure network infrastructure
  + Routing and switching solutions
  + Voice, video, and collaboration systems
  + Secure pathways and cross-domain connectivity solutions
* Support MILCON planning and implementation activities for new facilities and infrastructure modernization efforts.
* Develop equipment lists, material requirements, and technical documentation supporting system deployment activities.

**Security and Facility Systems**

* Design and integrate physical security and facility support systems, including:
* + Access Control Systems (ACS)
  + Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV)
  + Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS)
  + Electronic Security Systems (ESS)
* Ensure systems are compliant with DoD, USSOCOM, and applicable security requirements.

**Integration, Installation & Field Support**

* Support hardware fabrication, system assembly, integration, installation, and checkout activities.
* Coordinate system deployment activities with government personnel, contractors, and installation stakeholders.
* Support long-lead material planning, procurement coordination, and logistics activities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting and operational support during installation, testing, and sustainment activities.

**Testing & Evaluation**

* Develop and execute:
* + Test strategies
  + Test plans
  + Verification and validation procedures
  + System acceptance testing
  + Operational test and evaluation (OT&E)
* Support interoperability, cybersecurity, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and performance testing activities.
* Document test results and provide recommendations for corrective actions and system improvements.

**Documentation & Technical Leadership**

* Develop and maintain engineering artifacts, technical reports, drawings, diagrams, and implementation documentation.
* Support the development of DoD and USSOCOM technical, programmatic, and lifecycle documentation.
* Participate in technical meetings, program reviews, audits, and customer briefings.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior personnel as required.

  
Requirements:

**Minimum Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.

**Experience**

* 3 to 10 years of progressively responsible experience in systems engineering, network engineering, communications engineering, or C5ISR system support.
* Experience supporting DoD, USSOCOM, or military communications environments.
* Experience with system integration, installation, and troubleshooting in operational environments.

**Security Clearance**

* U.S. Citizenship and TS Clearance with SCI Eligibility Required.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Special Operations Forces (SOF) programs.
* Experience with MILCON projects and facility infrastructure design.
* Experience designing and implementing secure enterprise network architectures.
* Experience with audiovisual and video teleconferencing systems.
* Experience with physical security systems, including ACS, CCTV, IDS, and ESS.
* Familiarity with DoD Architecture Framework (DoDAF) concepts and engineering processes.
* Experience working in deployed or overseas operational environments.
* Knowledge of Risk Management Framework (RMF) and DoD cybersecurity requirements.

**Preferred Certifications**

One or more of the following certifications is highly desirable:

* Ability to travel up to 30% as required.

jobs.description:

===============================

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, and enhancement of complex software systems supporting mission-critical applications. This role requires extensive software engineering experience, strong technical leadership, and the ability to oversee development teams while ensuring software solutions meet demanding performance, functional, and operational requirements.

jobs.title: NWS Lead Frontend Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field. Also requires 5+ years of job-related experience, or a Master's degree plus 3 years of job-related experience. Agile experience preferred.

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:** Department of Defense Secret security clearance obtainable within reasonable time based on requirements. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES:**

As the NWS Lead Frontend Embedded Software Engineer for General Dynamics Mission Systems, you will provide technical leadership for a frontend or backend software team supporting a complex, distributed tactical system. You will work across software, systems, hardware, test, and configuration-management disciplines to mature the product, improve development practices, and deliver scalable capabilities.

This role requires an engineer who can lead technical execution while remaining hands-on with architecture, implementation, reviews, planning, and mentoring. The selected candidate will help guide the team’s transition toward memory-safe and type-safe technologies, including **Go** for new development and **JavaScript** for existing applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for a software team, providing technical direction, mentoring, code reviews, and implementation support.
* Break down features into well-defined, testable tasks aligned with product and subsystem design boundaries.
* Partner with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, program leadership, systems engineering, and SC&I to plan work, manage priorities, and align with coding and development standards.
* Support Agile execution, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical estimation, retrospectives, and delivery tracking.
* Develop, review, and maintain technical artifacts, including test plans, user manuals, administrator manuals, design documentation, and software-development documentation.
* Support financial and program-planning activities, including COCOMO estimates, Basis of Estimate (BOE) inputs, and Software Bill of Materials (SW BOM) development.
* Conduct and oversee code reviews, ensuring changes meet quality, security, maintainability, testability, and Definition-of-Done expectations.
* Assess and improve team maturity, code maturity, codebase size and stabilization trends, development efficiency, and scalability across a distributed environment supporting 3,000+ endpoints.
* Help mature CI/CD and DevSecOps capabilities, including automated unit testing, code-quality analysis, configuration management, and repeatable production builds.
* Establish, maintain, or support test beds on SWFPAC.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and architectural concerns early; communicate options, tradeoffs, and recommendations to leadership.
* Mentor existing technical leadership and individual contributors, helping build sustainable team capability and knowledge transfer.

**Frontend Lead Focus Areas**

The Frontend Lead will additionally support:

* Frontend architecture, legacy application knowledge, software licensing awareness, and full-system/subsystem interface understanding.
* Feature decomposition and planning based on encapsulation of product functions and subsystem design.
* Frontend development standards, component design, usability considerations, and integration with backend services.
* Product Owner responsibilities for an Agile team, including backlog prioritization, acceptance criteria, stakeholder coordination, and workforce oversight.
* Knowledge-management and training plans to help engineers develop lead-level capability and confirm understanding of assigned work.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

We encourage you to apply if you have experience with:

* Leading, or serving as the deputy/backup lead for, delivery of a mature tactical, mission, or strategic software system.
* Software architecture, technical planning, feature decomposition, and system-level design.
* Frontend and/or backend development in distributed, multi-component systems.
* Go, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java, C/C++, or other memory-safe/type-safe programming languages.
* Database design, data modeling, SQL, and backend-service development.
* Object-oriented software design and modern software-design principles.
* Data Distribution Service (DDS), middleware integration, and RTI DDS.
* Embedded software development, FreeRTOS, TCP/IP, and firmware-adjacent interfaces.
* Linux development or administration.
* Docker, Kubernetes, containerization, virtualization, and deployment automation.
* CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, static analysis, production builds, and configuration management.
* Git, GitLab, source-control workflows, and merge/review practices.
* Software requirements decomposition; preliminary and critical design; implementation and unit testing; and requirements-based testing.
* Factory, hardware, or integration-test environments.
* Agile delivery, Product Owner responsibilities, or SAFe Agile Product Owner/Product Manager practices.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Autonomy Systems Engineering, Vehicle Control
jobs.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn't just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, vehicle platform, safety, infrastructure, and operations to build the safety case for our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas and to shape the vehicle platform that comes next.

  

**Mission Summary:**

The vehicle control interface is where Motional's autonomy software interfaces with the vehicle platform: steering, braking, and propulsion commands go out, and actuator state, faults, and vehicle interventions come back. Gaps in requirements or test coverage at this boundary show up as issues on the road.

As a Senior Systems Engineer embedded with our vehicle control software team, you will own the verification and validation strategy for the vehicle interface software on our current fleet, act as the systems reviewer for changes going into releases, and contribute to the control interface requirements for our next-generation platform.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build and own the verification and validation plan for the vehicle interface control software: catalog existing tests across unit, integration, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and test track; map them to requirements; and close coverage gaps.
* Establish an impact analysis process so every software change ships with the right regression tests identified and tracked.
* Review and approve changes to vehicle interface and fault handling logic as the systems engineering representative, defining the evidence needed for release.
* Analyze fleet and test data to characterize vehicle behavior (braking, traction and stability interventions, torque response) and turn findings into requirements and test cases.
* Draft and review control interface requirements for the next-generation platform alongside the principal engineer, and prepare technical material for discussions with Hyundai Motor Group.
* Support safety analyses on the vehicle control path and make sure the resulting requirements are testable.
* Build automated analysis and dashboards (Python, SQL) that give fast feedback on vehicle interface performance.
* Support root cause analysis of vehicle interface issues from testing and operations.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.
* 5+ years of engineering experience on safety-critical systems, including hands-on work bringing up or integrating a vehicle platform for an ADAS or automated driving system (vehicle interface, actuation, drive-by-wire control, or platform testing).
* End-to-end systems engineering experience: requirements, analysis, and verification and validation, including building test plans and tracking requirement-to-test coverage.
* Software or hardware test development experience.
* Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.
* Python or similar, and SQL, for analyzing test and fleet data; ability to read C++.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; effective working day to day with a software development team.
* In-vehicle networking tools and signal definition with CAN
  

**Bonus points(not required):**

* Automotive functional safety or SOTIF experience (ISO 26262, ISO 21448) applied to control software.
* Hardware-in-the-loop test development.
* Requirements management and traceability tools (Jama, DOORS, Polarion, or similar).
* Experience working directly with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier on vehicle interfaces.
  

**Physical Demands:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

  

**Travel Requirements (up to 20%)**:

Expected to travel to our Las Vegas test site and to Pittsburgh for vehicle testing and integration, roughly 1-2 weeks each quarter, with occasional international travel as needed for the business.

  

**Working Environment:**

The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**
---------------

Today, AI is something you rent. Alpaca is building the full stack of hardware, software, models, and applications together to make it something you own.

We are developing a new computer architecture that breaks the economics keeping frontier models trapped in datacenters. On top of that, we’re building a platform of models, applications, and services that give that hardware meaning.

Personal AI is moving from the datacenter to the desk, and we are driving that change.

Our team is based in Cambridge, MA.

**About the role:**
-------------------

We want to make powerful AI as accessible as the personal computer. To do that, we need to turn our technology into a well designed physical product that people can put on their desks, plug in, and use every day.

We are looking for an electrical engineer who can take an idea and turn it into reality. You’ll take a high ownership over a large amount of work: schematic capture, layout, routing, validation, characterization, and high-level work across teams to develop the hardware that brings our AI platform into people's homes and businesses.

This is a role for someone who loves electronics, hacking, and building things. The kind of people that grew up watching Linus Tech Tips, rooting their phone, and playing around with Luckypatcher. You should be excited about designing a PCB, figuring out thermals and power delivery, and making a product that can change the world. You'll own the process of rapidly prototyping, testing, and iterating on our hardware until it's ready to manufacture.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* **Own the hardware stack:** Design, assemble, and iterate on complete computer systems, from component selection to working prototypes.
* **Develop electronics:** Schematic capture, layout, routing, power delivery, wiring, and custom electronics for our products.
* **Engineer a system:** Integrate compute, memory, storage, networking, firmware, and operating systems into reliable hardware.
* **Prepare for production:** Refine designs for cost, reliability, manufacturability, and eventual large-scale assembly. If you’re willing, you may be able to go to Shenzhen.

**Who we’re looking for:**
--------------------------

* **Passion for electronics:** You care about performance, cost, reliability, and can balance engineering tradeoffs to build a great product. You spend your free time on tech youtube and hacking with random electronics.
* **Electrical engineering fundamentals:** Experience with circuit design, schematic capture, PCB design (layout + routing), soldering, and electronics prototyping. You must be well-versed in either KiCad, Altium, or Allegro.
* **Computer systems knowledge:** Strong understanding of PC hardware, storage, networking, and hardware/software integration.
* **Hands-on prototyping:** Comfortable assembling, testing, debugging, and modifying hardware, from individual circuits to complete computers.
* **Software skills:** Experience with Python, C/C++, Linux scripting, or low-level systems programming for hardware bring-up and automation.
* **Independence:** You can take an ambiguous idea, figure out how to make it real, and build it with minimal direction.

**How to apply:**
-----------------

Send us your resume and examples of projects you've designed or built, along with a short note about why Alpaca interests you.

More than credentials, we want to see what you've made, researched, designed, or shipped.

If the role sounds like you but your background is unconventional, apply anyway.

Compensation Range: $140K - $170K

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Autonomy Systems Engineering, Vehicle Platform & Control Interfaces
jobs.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn't just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, vehicle platform, safety, infrastructure, and operations to build the safety case for our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas and to shape the vehicle platform that comes next.

  

**Mission Summary:**

Motional is defining its next-generation robotaxi platform together with Hyundai Motor Group. The requirements we deliver over the coming year will set how the autonomy software commands and monitors the vehicle: steering, braking, propulsion, redundant command paths, and behavior under faults. These decisions are hard to change once the vehicle is designed, and getting them right early is one of the highest-leverage things we can do for the program.

As Principal Engineer, you will own Motional's vehicle control and interface requirements for this platform and be our lead systems engineering voice with Hyundai Motor Group's vehicle engineers. We are looking for someone who has done this before: brought up a new vehicle platform for an automated driving or ADAS system, lived with the consequences of early interface decisions, and knows what to ask for the second time around. You will draw on that experience and on what we learned deploying our current fleet, drive the key architecture trade-offs to a decision, and carry the requirements through to verification on prototype vehicles.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Own the vehicle control and interface requirements for Motional's next-generation platform, from first draft through release and verification.
* Lead technical engagement with Hyundai Motor Group's vehicle engineering teams, including in-person workshops in Korea, and drive open questions to closure.
* Lead trade studies on control interface architecture (for example, torque and steering angle commands versus acceleration or trajectory-level interfaces) and bring stakeholders to a decision backed by data.
* Turn lessons learned from our current fleet into clear, verifiable requirements on the vehicle platform and on the signals it reports back to the autonomy system.
* Work with Safety and the vehicle platform team on the functional safety concept for the control path: redundancy, fault handling, degraded operation, and arbitration with base-vehicle safety functions.
* Partner with Sourcing on the vehicle interface controller supplier: requirements, acceptance criteria, and schedule risk.
* Maintain the system description, interface definitions, traceability, and verification strategy for the vehicle interface subsystem.
* Set technical direction and mentor systems engineers working on vehicle control.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.
* 10+ years of engineering experience, including at least one full vehicle platform bring-up for an ADAS or automated driving system: defining the interface to a new vehicle, working through prototype builds with the automaker or supplier, and taking the platform to validated operation.
* Hands-on experience with vehicle motion control or drive-by-wire systems (propulsion, braking, steering), and with writing and negotiating interface requirements with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier.
* Working knowledge of automotive functional safety (ISO 26262) applied to vehicle control: safety goals, ASIL allocation, fault handling, and degraded modes.
* Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; effective at driving decisions across organizations and cultures.
* Ability to read C++ control software; Python or similar for data analysis.
* Experience leading cross-team technical work and mentoring engineers.
  

**Bonus points(not required):**

* Experience bringing up more than one vehicle platform, or platforms from more than one automaker.
* Familiarity with automotive E/E architectures and in-vehicle networking (CAN, Automotive Ethernet).
* Supplier management experience (statements of work, sample acceptance, joint testing).
* Hardware-in-the-loop or test track development for vehicle control systems.
* Korean language proficiency.
  

**Physical Demands:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

  

**Travel Requirements (greater than 20%)**:

Expected to travel to Korea for engineering workshops and to our Las Vegas, Pittsburgh and Boston sites as needed for the business.

  

**Working Environment:**

The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

**What a day looks like at AIRONX Technologies**
------------------------------------------------

You start your morning reviewing I/O maps and device configs for a new automated cell. By mid-day, you’re refining PLC ladder logic and structured text, testing safety interlocks for light curtains and e‑stops, and polishing HMI/SCADA screens so operators have clear status, diagnostics, and recovery paths. In the afternoon, you’re on the floor sequencing an industrial robot, integrating a vision camera for part presence and measurement, and validating system behavior during machine debug. When it’s go‑time, you support runoff, installation, startup, and commissioning at the customer site—staying hands-on until production launch and acceptance are achieved.

### **Impact you’ll make**

* Author, test, and troubleshoot PLC programs (ladder logic and structured text) for automated machinery.
* Build intuitive HMI/SCADA experiences covering controls, status, alarms, diagnostics, and fault recovery.
* Implement machine safety: configure safety PLCs and fail‑safe logic for light curtains, emergency stops, gates, scanners, and interlocks.
* Program and integrate industrial robots, including sequencing, interlocks, tooling interfaces, and recovery routines.
* Diagnose and resolve electrical/controls issues across PLCs, HMIs, robots, sensors, networks, drives, servos, and safety devices.
* Deploy and fine‑tune vision/inspection systems for inspection, measurement, positioning, presence/absence, and robot guidance.
* Own I/O mapping, device configuration, software validation, machine debug, and system testing.
* See projects through: equipment runoff, field installation, startup, commissioning, production launch, and customer acceptance.
* Interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, and technical specs accurately.
* Maintain complete backups and documentation for PLC, HMI, robot, and vision software and controls.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with mechanical, electrical, robotics, project, manufacturing, vendor, and customer teams.

### **What you bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Controls/Automation/Mechatronics/Computer Engineering (or related); equivalent relevant experience considered.
* Background in controls engineering, machine building, systems integration, industrial automation, or automated manufacturing.
* Hands‑on experience with PLC programming and HMI development.
* Strong troubleshooting across electrical systems, software, and machine‑level issues.
* Fluency in reading electrical schematics and applying industrial control and machine‑safety principles.
* Comfort working in integration, startup, and commissioning environments.

### **Bonus points**

### **Where and how you’ll work**

* Travel to customer manufacturing sites for installation, startup, commissioning, and launch support as needed.

jobs.description:
**What We Do**

Spartan Light Metal Products is a family-owned leader in aluminum manufacturing with more than 60 years of experience. We manufacture highly engineered components used in electric and fuel-powered vehicles for leading automakers, including General Motors, Ford, Toyota, and Honda. Our success is built on talented people and a culture grounded in our values, servant leadership, collaboration, safety, and quality.

**WHY SPARTAN?**

**More Than a Paycheck.**

At Spartan, your total rewards go beyond your salary. We want our employees to have opportunities to **earn more, be recognized, grow, and build their future.**

**EARN MORE**

* Short Term Incentive Plan — earning potential of up to 10% of your annual salary
* Additional incentive opportunities, where applicable

**BE RECOGNIZED**

* Rewards & Recognition
* Spartan Achievement Awards
* Service Awards recognizing employee milestones and contributions

**GROW**

* Mentorship and development opportunities
* Tuition reimbursement
* Opportunities to learn new skills and grow your career within Spartan

**BUILD YOUR FUTURE**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Company-provided life insurance
* HSA employer match for eligible employees
* 401(k) with company match

**Come build your future with Spartan.**

**GENERAL SUMMARY**

The Controls Engineer provides technical expertise, development and support of the controls, automation and industrial networking systems for our manufacturing equipment. This role contributes to the attainment of Spartan’s operational goals/objectives by improved manufacturing efficiency, quality and cost.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES**

1. Apply engineering knowledge and expertise in providing on-going support for the plant floor related to:

* system controls/PLC’s and their related hardware,
* robot/robotic systems - Fanuc based,
* automated inspection equipment (2D & 3D vision and laser)
* software and equipment, including proper use,
* troubleshooting, problem solving, continuous improvement and training.

2. Maintain involvement and alignment with plant maintenance and engineering teams. Provide guidance to any new equipment, tooling or modifications to existing equipment or tooling that require controls input to ensure all consistency in standards and methods.

3. Utilizing engineering expertise, lead and/or support the Spartan team during new machine design/development and concepts. Carry forward lessons learned and Spartan Standards.

4. Implement standard engineering practices in problem solving and projects. Provide detailed documentation upon project completion along with recommended updates to Spartan Equipment Standards.

5. Provide equipment and system control solutions to achieve Spartan’s manufacturing objectives, which includes the design and engineering of PLC/robot control and modifications for a wide variety of manufacturing production equipment.

6. Lead the design and development of Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems for production and operations support equipment.

7. Provide concept oversight to electrical assembly activities such as panel fabrication and component wiring.

8. Support field installation and mechanical/electrical integration of automation equipment, including mounting modules and devices (sensors, valves, drives, junction boxes, panels), coordinating and/or assisting with conduit/cable-tray layout and routing, pulling/terminating/labeling conductors, and performing point-to-point verification during equipment builds, retrofits and launches.

9. Produce and update electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and other industrial CAD drawings/schematics.

10. Wire and integrate new automation devices in legacy or undocumented systems by safely tracing circuits, verifying power/control signals, validating I/O operation, and creating as-built documentation for verified terminations and wiring paths.

11. Maintains updated knowledge of latest technology in robotics, controls, sensors and vision systems. Works with component and equipment suppliers to test and trial new technology that has potential to improve manufacturing operations and provide a competitive advantage.

12. Systems integration of 3rd party equipment and peripherals.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical field
* 3-5 years controls engineering experience
* 5-10 years maintenance experience
* Working proficiency in one primary platform: Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley) PLC/HMI development and support using Studio 5000 / RSLogix **and FactoryTalk**, **and** FANUC robot programming, integration, and troubleshooting (TP programming).

**Preferred:** High volume automotive with automated machining and assembly equipment experience.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Autonomy Systems Engineering, Vehicle Control
jobs.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn't just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, vehicle platform, safety, infrastructure, and operations to build the safety case for our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas and to shape the vehicle platform that comes next.

  

**Mission Summary:**

The vehicle control interface is where Motional's autonomy software interfaces with the vehicle platform: steering, braking, and propulsion commands go out, and actuator state, faults, and vehicle interventions come back. Gaps in requirements or test coverage at this boundary show up as issues on the road.

As a Senior Systems Engineer embedded with our vehicle control software team, you will own the verification and validation strategy for the vehicle interface software on our current fleet, act as the systems reviewer for changes going into releases, and contribute to the control interface requirements for our next-generation platform.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build and own the verification and validation plan for the vehicle interface control software: catalog existing tests across unit, integration, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and test track; map them to requirements; and close coverage gaps.
* Establish an impact analysis process so every software change ships with the right regression tests identified and tracked.
* Review and approve changes to vehicle interface and fault handling logic as the systems engineering representative, defining the evidence needed for release.
* Analyze fleet and test data to characterize vehicle behavior (braking, traction and stability interventions, torque response) and turn findings into requirements and test cases.
* Draft and review control interface requirements for the next-generation platform alongside the principal engineer, and prepare technical material for discussions with Hyundai Motor Group.
* Support safety analyses on the vehicle control path and make sure the resulting requirements are testable.
* Build automated analysis and dashboards (Python, SQL) that give fast feedback on vehicle interface performance.
* Support root cause analysis of vehicle interface issues from testing and operations.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.
* 5+ years of engineering experience on safety-critical systems, including hands-on work bringing up or integrating a vehicle platform for an ADAS or automated driving system (vehicle interface, actuation, drive-by-wire control, or platform testing).
* End-to-end systems engineering experience: requirements, analysis, and verification and validation, including building test plans and tracking requirement-to-test coverage.
* Software or hardware test development experience.
* Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.
* Python or similar, and SQL, for analyzing test and fleet data; ability to read C++.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; effective working day to day with a software development team.
* In-vehicle networking tools and signal definition with CAN
  

**Bonus points(not required):**

* Automotive functional safety or SOTIF experience (ISO 26262, ISO 21448) applied to control software.
* Hardware-in-the-loop test development.
* Requirements management and traceability tools (Jama, DOORS, Polarion, or similar).
* Experience working directly with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier on vehicle interfaces.
  

**Physical Demands:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

  

**Travel Requirements (up to 20%)**:

Expected to travel to our Las Vegas test site and to Pittsburgh for vehicle testing and integration, roughly 1-2 weeks each quarter, with occasional international travel as needed for the business.

  

**Working Environment:**

The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

*Motional AD LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified applicants. Motional is defining its next-generation robotaxi platform together with Hyundai Motor Group. As Principal Engineer, you will own Motional's vehicle control and interface requirements for this platform and be our lead systems engineering voice with Hyundai Motor Group's vehicle engineers. We are looking for someone who has done this before: brought up a new vehicle platform for an automated driving or ADAS system, lived with the consequences of early interface decisions, and knows what to ask for the second time around. You will draw on that experience and on what we learned deploying our current fleet, drive the key architecture trade-offs to a decision, and carry the requirements through to verification on prototype vehicles.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Own the vehicle control and interface requirements for Motional's next-generation platform, from first draft through release and verification.
* Lead technical engagement with Hyundai Motor Group's vehicle engineering teams, including in-person workshops in Korea, and drive open questions to closure.
* Lead trade studies on control interface architecture (for example, torque and steering angle commands versus acceleration or trajectory-level interfaces) and bring stakeholders to a decision backed by data.
* Turn lessons learned from our current fleet into clear, verifiable requirements on the vehicle platform and on the signals it reports back to the autonomy system.

* Maintain the system description, interface definitions, traceability, and verification strategy for the vehicle interface subsystem.
* Set technical direction and mentor systems engineers working on vehicle control.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.
* 10+ years of engineering experience, including at least one full vehicle platform bring-up for an ADAS or automated driving system: defining the interface to a new vehicle, working through prototype builds with the automaker or supplier, and taking the platform to validated operation.
* Hands-on experience with vehicle motion control or drive-by-wire systems (propulsion, braking, steering), and with writing and negotiating interface requirements with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier.
* Working knowledge of automotive functional safety (ISO 26262) applied to vehicle control: safety goals, ASIL allocation, fault handling, and degraded modes.
* Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; effective at driving decisions across organizations and cultures.
* Ability to read C++ control software; Python or similar for data analysis.
* Experience leading cross-team technical work and mentoring engineers.
  

**Bonus points(not required):**

* Experience bringing up more than one vehicle platform, or platforms from more than one automaker.
* Familiarity with automotive E/E architectures and in-vehicle networking (CAN, Automotive Ethernet).
* Supplier management experience (statements of work, sample acceptance, joint testing).
* Hardware-in-the-loop or test track development for vehicle control systems.
* Korean language proficiency.
  

**Physical Demands:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

  

**Travel Requirements (greater than 20%)**:

Expected to travel to Korea for engineering workshops and to our Las Vegas, Pittsburgh and Boston sites as needed for the business.

In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print‑and‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities.

**Seeking candidates who are shift flexible.**

What You’ll Do

* Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety.
* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.
* Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed.
* Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client.
* Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems.
* Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation.
* Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies.
* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.
* Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents.
* Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability.
* Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams.
* Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members.
* Perform other job-related duties as needed or assigned.

What You’ll Need

* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered.
* Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming.
* 2+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA-based monitoring and control systems.
* Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
* Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight.
* Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming.
* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

You should be proficient in:

* PLC Programming

Machines & technologies you'll use:

* SCADA

* Allen-Bradley PLC

jobs.title: Enterprise Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Enterprise Automation Engineering drives efficiency across Datadog through systems automation and integrations, AI agents and MCP development. The team is increasingly embedded in cross-functional initiatives across People, Finance, GTM, Legal, Recruiting, and Technical Solutions — translating ambiguous business problems into scoped, buildable solutions and owning delivery end-to-end.

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you design and build the technical solutions that power Datadog's internal systems. You work closely with BSAs and business stakeholders to take well-scoped requirements and ship production-grade integrations, automations, agents, and internal apps. You will also actively shape how AI and agentic tooling gets embedded into Datadog's internal workflows.

*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Build and ship:** Architect, build, and maintain production-grade integrations, automations, agents, and internal apps across Datadog's core business systems — Workday, Greenhouse, NetSuite, Salesforce, and more
* **Lead technical design:** Define data flows, error handling, scalability requirements, and architectural decisions for multi-system workflows
* **Own the AI/agent layer:** Design and develop agentic workflows, MCP servers, and LLM-integrated solutions that extend what the team can deliver
* **Set platform standards:** Define and enforce what production-ready means for internal systems — governance, observability, reliability, and maintainability; help the organization move from vibe-coded prototypes to scalable platforms
* **Advise on build vs. buy:** Evaluate tools and platforms and make recommendations on when to build custom vs. configure existing
* **Ensure compliance:** Collaborate with Security, Privacy, and Compliance to ensure solutions adhere to Datadog's standards — GDPR, SOX, SOC 2, FedRAMP

### **Who You Are:**

* Demonstrated experience building with AI/agentic tools — not just evaluating them; you've shipped something with an LLM, an agent framework, or an MCP and can speak to the tradeoffs
* Strong judgment on build vs. buy, custom vs. configuration
* Able to communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders — you can explain why a design choice matters without losing the room
* Experience working autonomously on a small, high-ownership team at a high-growth company

#### **Senior Business Systems Engineer**

* 5+ years administrating and integrating business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Zendesk, Salesforce or Workday) or in a similar role
* 4+ years leading medium to large sized cross-functional projects across Finance, HR, and Sales
* 3+ years designing and building multi-system integrations using middleware (e.g., Workato, Boomi, Mulesoft, Zapier)

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

WHAT WE'RE DOING  
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS) provides surface, air and undersea applications for U.S. military and international customers. The same expertise we provide to military customers is being applied to increase capabilities of U.S. and international civilian agencies. Our vision for RMS is to set performance standards for our customers worldwide, every day with the best people, best systems, and best services.

WHO WE ARE  
In this position, the EMI/EMC Systems Engineer will lead the Electromagnetic Environmental Effects activities and provide EMI design support across multiple programs. They will be performing scientific research, evaluate test plans/procedures, process test data, and perform analyses concerning Electromagnetic Environmental Effects.

THE WORK  
Responsibilities include:  

* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to mitigate interference signals and define EMI/EMC requirements to meet product performance standards
* Establishing metrics and identifying opportunities to optimize and or automate EMI engineering efforts.
* Support EMI/EMC design and compliance regarding grounding, shielding, transmission lines, filter design, and other EMI related aspects
* Foster a collaborative environment by mentoring and leading teammates, sharing knowledge, and facilitating their technical growth
* Draft, review, and modify EMI documentation (Including EMI test plans, test reports, control plans, verification procedures, and integration/analysis reports)
* Perform RF Co-site analyses and documentation
* Support and troubleshoot testing in the EMI lab

WHO YOU ARE  
You understand how the many different pieces of a system work together. Our products involve hundreds of people, processes, and systems, and you’ll need to figure out how the ones that are relevant to your analysis fit together.  
  
Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications. For positions that perform IT responsibilities, use E646, Systems Engr-IT.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education, with 7 or more years of professional experience
* EMI design, RF or DC Power supply design experience
* Experience with Military Standards
* Experience performing EMI, RF or Power Supply related analysis
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret DoD Security clearance
* Candidates must be willing to travel up to 10% time

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to support multiple projects in a dynamic environment
* EMI test and analysis experience
* Experience with lab hardware such as a spectrum analyzer, signal generator, LNA, PA, attenuator, coupler
* Interest in EMI design in the areas of grounding, filtering and shielding as it relates to the control of EMI
* Strong working knowledge of MIL-STD-461F/G, MIL-STD-464C/D

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $85300.00 - $158300.00

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Control Systems Engineer - (197810)

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?  
  
Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'  
  
Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.  
  
HDR is looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to serve in a project leadership role in support of our national Control Systems practice which includes full-service capabilities. Our practice provides assessment, planning, design, automation programming/configuration, testing & commissioning, and maintenance for control systems in multiple industries.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

The primary role of this position is to lead the planning, design, and implementation of automated industrial control systems in coordination with clients and multidiscipline teams to develop solutions for construction and implementation in multiple market sectors including food & beverage; oil & gas; logistics, manufacturing; mining; general industrial; transportation; and water/wastewater.

This position involves exercising judgment in evaluation and selection of equipment and system components and coordinating closely with multidiscipline design teams through all stages of design including schematic, design development, and construction documents. They will be responsible for creating biddable and technically accurate construction documents including drawings and specifications, as well as conducting reviews of documents for areas of conflict with all disciplines. They will also be involved in coordination during construction phase activities including the review of shop drawings and construction observation.

Primary responsibilities and duties include:

* Travel to client facilities to participate in field activities to assess and document the current state of installed control systems.

  

* Participate in and lead design review and planning meetings with the client.

  

* Lead the development of preliminary engineering reports and studies focused on recommending and developing solutions for improvements to client control systems.

  

* Serve as Engineer of Record in responsible charge for the development of biddable and technically accurate control system construction documents.

  

* Coordinate with project manager and section manager to update workplans for control systems staff assigned to your project, and to track budget and schedule performance for the control systems team.

  

* Interface with Electrical, Process, and Cybersecurity specialists to fully coordinate design requirements for network, power, control, and instrumentation.

  

* Participate in joint scoping and proposal development working with clients and marketing staff.

  

* Participate in the planning and specification of applied technology solutions including instrumentation and control, advanced automation and control, artificial intelligence, networking, data management & analytics, augmented reality, and vision control.
* Lead the selection and specification of facility and process instrumentation, control panels, and network equipment.

  

* Lead the development of biddable and technically accurate control system construction documents including P&IDs, process flow diagrams, network architecture diagrams, control panel layouts and wiring diagrams, installation details, loop drawings, and technical specifications.

  

* Provide Quality Control (QC) reviews of control system designs.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, revengOS
jobs.description:
**About Raglan**

Raglan builds vehicles for today’s and tomorrow’s fight. We engineer mission-critical systems for defense, government, and commercial applications, bringing a warfighter’s perspective to modernizing tactical platforms and developing new capabilities.

Our work spans propulsion, software-defined vehicles, and modular exportable power systems—from open-architecture vehicle control software to hybrid platforms. We work closely with operators, program teams, and engineering partners to turn real-world requirements into systems built for demanding missions.

Based in Wilmington, North Carolina, Raglan is a Veteran-Owned Small Business. We’re looking for people ready to take ownership of the hardest mission-critical mobility challenges.

**The mission**

Join Raglan's on-site engineering team in Wilmington, North Carolina, to build new and modernize existing military ground vehicle control systems with revengOS, helping deliver dependable mobility for the warfighter. You'll develop, integrate, and validate controls for vehicle subsystems, from bench testing through calibration on the dyno and in the vehicle. You'll own well-defined features and subsystem pieces end to end, working alongside senior engineers who set the overall control strategy. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning software, hardware, and vehicle integration.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and test control software in MATLAB/Simulink and embedded C/C++ on automotive-grade microcontrollers.
* Implement and refine subsystem controls for diesel and hybrid platforms, such as fueling, torque management, transmission shifting, and power-distribution protection.
* Capture and decode CAN/LIN traffic, scope traces, and wiring to help reverse engineer OEM controller behavior.
* Maintain and extend DBC databases and implement controller communication within the vehicle CAN architecture.
* Integrate and calibrate embedded controller platforms such as OpenECU, Emtron, ECOTRON, STW, MoTeC, TTControl, MotoHawk, Life Racing, New Eagle, and Bosch.
* Run validation on a four-wheel chassis dynamometer and in real operating conditions, logging data and resolving differences between modeled and measured behavior.
* Support wiring harness build and integration for controllers, sensors, and actuators, and troubleshoot hardware, firmware, and vehicle-level faults.

**What you bring**

* A solid understanding of engine and drivetrain operation, including combustion, fueling, torque, and shift mechanics.
* Experience developing controls in MATLAB/Simulink and embedded software in C/C++ on microcontrollers.
* Working CAN skills, including protocol decoding and DBC editing with CAN tools such as Vector CANalyzer, PCAN, or similar.
* Hands-on experience testing, calibrating, or validating controls on a dyno, test bench, or vehicle.
* Comfort working hands-on with vehicles, wiring, and test equipment, and debugging across software and hardware.
* Ability to own assigned features from development through validation, with guidance on overall direction.

**Nice to have**

* Reverse engineering OEM controllers or building aftermarket or standalone control solutions.
* Hybrid / electric vehicle development: torque management, battery management, charging, or export power.
* Transmission control and calibration, including multi-clutch or automatic shift control.
* ABS, traction control, or body and power-distribution control experience.
* Production embedded development involving timing, interrupts, peripherals, or driver-level code.
* Wiring harness design from schematic through build.
* Formula SAE / Baja SAE, motorsport, defense, or other durability-critical vehicle experience.

Don't check every box? If you've done the core of this work, apply anyway.

**Pay & Benefits**

**Base salary:** $135,000–$165,000 (North Carolina)

This is the base salary range we in good faith expect to pay for this role. Where you land depends on your skills and experience, which we assess through the interview process.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 20 days of vacation, plus all federal holidays
* Parental leave
* Professional development support: training, certifications, and conferences

**Export control and security clearance.** This position requires access to classified information and to technical data and items controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Applicants must be U.S. citizens and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required for clearance eligibility.

**Equal opportunity.** Raglan is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other status protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview, contact careers@raglan.com.

Raglan participates in E-Verify.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
135,000 - 165,000 USD per year(Wilmington, NC)

Our American-made products, which include non-residential indoor and outdoor lighting, print graphics, digital graphics, refrigerated and custom displays, create value for customer brands and enhance the consumer experience. jobs.description:
### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

You will join Panthalassa's Compute Infrastructure team, a small platform engineering team that builds and operates shared infrastructure as internal products. The team owns a Kubernetes-based compute platform on GKE (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions runners, Terraform modules) and is bringing our on-premises HPC clusters under the same model: a managed HPC platform that CFD engineers consume through a documented golden path rather than through ad-hoc requests to an administrator. Your work will directly support our mission to deliver abundant renewable energy and affordable green fuels.

You will own that HPC platform end to end: Linux, Slurm, storage, interconnects, provisioning, and scientific software. Your initial scope is our primary CFD cluster, with the expectation that you grow into ownership of our second cluster and define how both are operated under the same configuration management and operational standards as the rest of our infrastructure.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership and room to shape how our computing infrastructure grows. You will work closely with CFD engineers on production workloads and performance, and with an on-site datacenter technician who carries out physical hardware work. We are looking for someone who follows problems through to resolution, communicates clearly, and builds systems that others can operate confidently and that engineers can consume without needing to understand how they work underneath.

The services running on these clusters, including scheduling, software environments, storage, and license servers, are products with users. You will treat them that way: measure how they are used, reduce friction, and iterate.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

### **Responsibilities**

#### **Platform**

* Contribute to defining the HPC platform as a product: its service catalog, service levels, and roadmap, in partnership with CFD engineering leads, and prioritize work by user impact.
* Build the golden path for running simulations: standard job templates, submission tooling, software environment conventions, and documentation that lets a new CFD engineer go from zero to a correctly placed production job without a ticket.
* Replace manual, ticket-driven operations with self-service wherever practical: account and project onboarding, storage allocation, module requests, license visibility, and job diagnostics.
* Instrument platform usage and health (utilization, queue wait, job failure modes, storage growth) and use it to drive capacity planning and roadmap decisions.
* Contribute to shared team tooling and conventions so HPC and cloud compute are operated the same way.
* Design future HPC capacity and workflows with the GKE platform in mind: burst, hybrid scheduling, shared identity, and shared artifact and container registries.

#### **Platform operations**

* Automate cluster configuration with Ansible and Git so system state is reproducible, reviewable, and applied through CI. Manual changes to cluster state are the exception, not the norm.
* Own the day-to-day operation, configuration, and reliability of our HPC clusters, including compute and head nodes, storage, and interconnects.
* Plan and bring up new compute capacity: specify hardware, define rack and network layouts, and provision and validate nodes after installation.
* Administer Slurm end to end, including partitions, QoS, accounting, scheduling policy, and job troubleshooting for CFD engineers.
* Build and maintain scientific software environments, including Environment Modules or Lmod, MPI stacks, and compiler toolchains tuned for our interconnects.
* Manage diskless provisioning with Warewulf, including PXE and UEFI boot, node images, kernel and driver pinning, and firmware lifecycle.
* Operate Omni-Path and InfiniBand fabrics, including subnet management, link health, topology validation, and MPI performance verification.
* Manage BMC and IPMI access, firmware updates, and remote diagnosis of memory, NIC, and storage faults. Coordinate hardware suppliers and RMAs.
* Work with our on-site datacenter technician on hardware installations, drive and DIMM swaps, cabling, and network changes, providing clear diagnoses and precise instructions.
* Administer shared simulation storage, including ZFS pools, NFS exports, scrub and snapshot schedules, capacity planning, and backup coverage.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Autonomy Systems Engineering, Vehicle Control
jobs.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn't just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, vehicle platform, safety, infrastructure, and operations to build the safety case for our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas and to shape the vehicle platform that comes next.

  

**Mission Summary:**

The vehicle control interface is where Motional's autonomy software interfaces with the vehicle platform: steering, braking, and propulsion commands go out, and actuator state, faults, and vehicle interventions come back. Gaps in requirements or test coverage at this boundary show up as issues on the road.

As a Senior Systems Engineer embedded with our vehicle control software team, you will own the verification and validation strategy for the vehicle interface software on our current fleet, act as the systems reviewer for changes going into releases, and contribute to the control interface requirements for our next-generation platform.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build and own the verification and validation plan for the vehicle interface control software: catalog existing tests across unit, integration, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and test track; map them to requirements; and close coverage gaps.
* Establish an impact analysis process so every software change ships with the right regression tests identified and tracked.
* Review and approve changes to vehicle interface and fault handling logic as the systems engineering representative, defining the evidence needed for release.
* Analyze fleet and test data to characterize vehicle behavior (braking, traction and stability interventions, torque response) and turn findings into requirements and test cases.
* Draft and review control interface requirements for the next-generation platform alongside the principal engineer, and prepare technical material for discussions with Hyundai Motor Group.
* Support safety analyses on the vehicle control path and make sure the resulting requirements are testable.
* Build automated analysis and dashboards (Python, SQL) that give fast feedback on vehicle interface performance.
* Support root cause analysis of vehicle interface issues from testing and operations.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.
* 5+ years of engineering experience on safety-critical systems, including hands-on work bringing up or integrating a vehicle platform for an ADAS or automated driving system (vehicle interface, actuation, drive-by-wire control, or platform testing).
* End-to-end systems engineering experience: requirements, analysis, and verification and validation, including building test plans and tracking requirement-to-test coverage.
* Software or hardware test development experience.
* Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.
* Python or similar, and SQL, for analyzing test and fleet data; ability to read C++.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; effective working day to day with a software development team.
* In-vehicle networking tools and signal definition with CAN
  

**Bonus points(not required):**

* Automotive functional safety or SOTIF experience (ISO 26262, ISO 21448) applied to control software.
* Hardware-in-the-loop test development.
* Requirements management and traceability tools (Jama, DOORS, Polarion, or similar).
* Experience working directly with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier on vehicle interfaces.

We are looking for someone who has done this before: brought up a new vehicle platform for an automated driving or ADAS system, lived with the consequences of early interface decisions, and knows what to ask for the second time around. You will draw on that experience and on what we learned deploying our current fleet, drive the key architecture trade-offs to a decision, and carry the requirements through to verification on prototype vehicles.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Own the vehicle control and interface requirements for Motional's next-generation platform, from first draft through release and verification.
* Lead technical engagement with Hyundai Motor Group's vehicle engineering teams, including in-person workshops in Korea, and drive open questions to closure.
* Lead trade studies on control interface architecture (for example, torque and steering angle commands versus acceleration or trajectory-level interfaces) and bring stakeholders to a decision backed by data.
* Turn lessons learned from our current fleet into clear, verifiable requirements on the vehicle platform and on the signals it reports back to the autonomy system.
* Work with Safety and the vehicle platform team on the functional safety concept for the control path: redundancy, fault handling, degraded operation, and arbitration with base-vehicle safety functions.
* Partner with Sourcing on the vehicle interface controller supplier: requirements, acceptance criteria, and schedule risk.
* Maintain the system description, interface definitions, traceability, and verification strategy for the vehicle interface subsystem.
* Set technical direction and mentor systems engineers working on vehicle control.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.
* 10+ years of engineering experience, including at least one full vehicle platform bring-up for an ADAS or automated driving system: defining the interface to a new vehicle, working through prototype builds with the automaker or supplier, and taking the platform to validated operation.
* Hands-on experience with vehicle motion control or drive-by-wire systems (propulsion, braking, steering), and with writing and negotiating interface requirements with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier.
* Working knowledge of automotive functional safety (ISO 26262) applied to vehicle control: safety goals, ASIL allocation, fault handling, and degraded modes.
* Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; effective at driving decisions across organizations and cultures.
* Ability to read C++ control software; Python or similar for data analysis.
* Experience leading cross-team technical work and mentoring engineers.
  

**Bonus points(not required):**

* Experience bringing up more than one vehicle platform, or platforms from more than one automaker.
* Familiarity with automotive E/E architectures and in-vehicle networking (CAN, Automotive Ethernet).
* Supplier management experience (statements of work, sample acceptance, joint testing).
