jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, EMC Test and Design
jobs.description:
Overview:

Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career.

At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day.

Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role.

Responsibilities:

* Plan, set up, execute, troubleshoot, and document EMC compliance and pre-compliance tests, including radiated and conducted emissions, ESD, EFT/burst, surge, and conducted and radiated RF immunity. This hands-on laboratory work will represent the primary focus of the role.
* Perform selected wireless OTA and radio-performance evaluations, verify test configurations and repeatability, analyze results, and support troubleshooting of connected products using internal RF test capabilities.
* Support EMC engineering throughout the product development lifecycle, with emphasis on test planning, sample and configuration readiness, verification execution, results analysis, and evaluation of product changes.
* Develop clear EMC test plans, procedures, setup records, test logs, engineering analyses, and test reports that provide accurate, traceable, and reusable technical evidence.
* Analyze EMC failures by identifying noise sources, coupling paths, and susceptible circuits; work with design teams to develop, prototype, and verify practical mitigations.
* Work with product development teams to design and improve electronic circuits, interfaces, grounding, shielding, filtering, transient protection, and PCB implementations for EMC, ESD, EFT, surge, RF, and signal-integrity robustness.
* Participate in electrical, PCB, mechanical, cable, and system design reviews; identify EMC risks early and recommend practical design improvements before hardware is released.
* Use circuit and electromagnetic simulation where appropriate to evaluate EMC filters, protection circuits, PCB structures, coupling paths, signal/power integrity, and design alternatives before physical testing.
* Interpret applicable IEC, CISPR, FCC, and product-specific EMC requirements and translate them into actionable design and verification requirements.
* Collaborate with the EMC laboratory technical manager, technician, RF engineering, product compliance, quality, and external laboratories to efficiently complete verification and certification activities.
* Help build organizational EMC capability through mentoring, design guidance, reference designs, technical training, and documented best practices.

Qualifications:

### **Required Skills and Abilities**

* Demonstrated experience designing or evaluating electronic hardware for EMC robustness, including grounding, filtering, shielding, interface protection, component selection, and PCB implementation.
* Substantial hands-on experience independently setting up and performing EMC emissions and immunity testing, pre-compliance testing, hardware troubleshooting, and compliance verification.
* Strong understanding of EMC fundamentals, noise sources, coupling mechanisms, susceptibility, and practical mitigation techniques.
* Ability to read and review electrical schematics and PCB layouts and work effectively with product design teams on design improvements.
* Demonstrated proficiency operating common electronic and EMC test instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers or EMI receivers, signal generators, probes, transient generators, RF immunity systems, and associated automation software.
* Ability to develop test plans, technical reports, design guidance, and clear engineering documentation.
* Strong analytical problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; able to independently manage complex technical assignments.
* Minimal travel required (less than 10%), including occasional support at external laboratories.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience with global EMC standards and product certification, including IEC, CISPR, FCC, or related commercial-product requirements.
* Experience with circuit, PCB, SI/PI, or electromagnetic simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, HFSS, SPICE, CST, or COMSOL.
* Experience with Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, or similar schematic and PCB design environments.
* Experience with wireless products, intentional radiators, RF/OTA testing, antennas, cellular, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or sub-GHz technologies.
* Experience working in semi-anechoic, fully anechoic, OTA, or shielded test environments.
* Experience with intrinsically safe or other regulated electronic safety products is a plus; iNARTE EMC certification or equivalent professional development is also a plus.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline required, preferably from an ABET-accredited program; a relevant advanced degree is preferred.
* Experience must include significant hands-on EMC test setup, execution, troubleshooting, and documentation responsibility, together with practical electronic design or design-review experience.

This position may be filled at multiple engineering career levels based on experience, education, technical depth, and demonstrated impact:

* Staff Engineer III: Minimum 3 years of relevant engineering experience.
* Senior Staff Engineer: Minimum 5 years of relevant engineering experience.
* Principal Engineer I: Minimum 7 years of relevant engineering experience.
* Master’s degree may substitute for up to 2 years of relevant experience.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer (Manufacturing Equipment Design)
jobs.description:
### **Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Design Engineer to support the development and manufacturing of custom industrial equipment and automated processing systems. This individual will be responsible for developing electrical designs, identifying appropriate hardware, and ensuring equipment meets applicable safety and performance requirements.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in industrial electrical engineering, control panel development, and power distribution, along with the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering and manufacturing disciplines.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop detailed electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and panel configurations for custom-built industrial machinery and automated equipment.
* Engineer electrical power and control systems for various industrial applications, including motor-driven equipment, heating systems, power conversion equipment, and associated components.
* Evaluate and specify electrical hardware, ensuring proper sizing, compatibility, and functionality.
* Generate comprehensive material lists and technical documentation to support equipment production.
* Determine appropriate electrical enclosure specifications based on operating conditions and environmental exposure.
* Incorporate applicable electrical codes, industry standards, and equipment safety requirements into engineering designs.
* Provide technical assistance to manufacturing and electrical assembly personnel throughout equipment fabrication and testing.
* Participate in equipment validation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to establish system interfaces, control requirements, and standardized documentation practices.
* Provide occasional onsite technical support during equipment installation and startup.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical discipline.
* Minimum of three years of professional experience developing electrical systems for industrial machinery, automation equipment, or control panel applications.
* Experience utilizing electrical design software such as AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or comparable engineering platforms.
* Understanding of industrial electrical codes and safety regulations, including NEC, NFPA 79, and UL 508A.
* Ability to interpret electrical drawings, develop technical specifications, and support equipment integration.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional communication skills.

### **Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with industrial power conversion equipment, DC power systems, motor controls, variable frequency drives, or servo-driven applications.
* Exposure to PLC-based automation platforms, particularly Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley.
* Previous involvement in custom equipment manufacturing, system integration, or industrial automation projects.
* Experience supporting equipment testing, field commissioning, or installation activities.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

We offer a competitive compensation package and a comprehensive benefits program, including:

* Competitive base salary commensurate with experience.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching contributions.
* Paid vacation and personal time off

The ideal candidate will interact with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. end users, platform integration teams & Agile software teams) to define and maintain system configurations, to include software integration labs (SIL) and deployable mission management systems as required by each program.

* Present technical status, issues, and recommendations in formal and informal reviews.
* Contribute to proposal, planning, and execution activities aligned to program milestones.
* Support compliance with customer, regulatory, and security requirements.

* Execute system integration, validation, and technical baselines across concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance, and disposal.
* Lead or support design reviews, peer reviews, and technical interchanges.
* Produce and maintain system engineering artifacts including requirements traceability, risk registers, and verification evidence.
* Ensure system designs align with security and government compliance requirements.
* Ability to obtain a US Secret security clearance

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
* 9+ years of experience in systems engineering methods across full lifecycle activities.
* 9+ years of experience with requirements management, risk management, and system integration and verification practices.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Bachelor of Science in a STEM discipline preferred; Engineering preferred, Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science acceptable.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional engineering teams.
* Model-based systems engineering (MBSE) familiarity.
* Experience with multi-domain mission systems and secure architectures.
* Experience supporting government or defense technical reviews.
* Experience balancing technical, schedule, and cost constraints across system-level decisions.
* Ability to collaborate across software, hardware, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and program teams.
* Role scope expectation: Manages large, complex project initiatives of substantial importance with minimal oversight.
* Collaboration expectation: Communicates across organizational boundaries to explain and influence changes to technical practices and approaches.

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Imagine yourself…**

* Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
* Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
* Contributing to a brighter, more sustainable future.

It’s possible with a role at Kipp & Zonen, where you’ll have the chance to shape the future of your career—and the future of our planet.

Kipp & Zonen, a Veralto company, provides class-leading instruments for measuring solar radiation and atmospheric properties in Meteorology, Climatology, Hydrology, Industry, Renewable Energy, Agriculture and Public Health.

Kipp & Zonen is the specialist in the measurement of solar and sky radiation, from the ultraviolet to the far infrared. We offer a complete range of high-quality instrumentation and accessories, from reliable cost-effective products to the best performance available. Our pyranometers, for example, are used in meteorological networks around the world.

Furthermore, our expertise and close links with the scientific community have led to high-end solutions for the measurement of atmospheric properties such as stratospheric Ozone, UV Spectra and evapo-transpiration.

Our mission is to satisfy the fundamental need to monitor atmospheric properties related to climate change, classical meteorology, agriculture, renewable energy and the available water budget.

**The opportunity:**

* **Champion** hardware bring-up at system level: analyze schematics, review component selections, validate hardware-software interfaces, and define integration strategies for sensors, ADCs, communications interfaces, memory, power systems, and peripherals. * **Solve** hard problems: lead cross-functional investigations of system, production, and field failures, and debug complex hardware-software issues with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers. Deliver clear root causes and lasting corrective actions.

* **Own** release readiness end to end: define release criteria, test evidence standards, risk documentation, and gate reviews, and set documentation standards for architecture, debugging, test procedures, and release decisions.
* **Influence** hardware, systems, manufacturing, quality, and support teams by turning complex technical findings into clear recommendations and negotiating trade-offs, and mentor firmware and cross-functional engineers through design and code reviews.
* **Contribute** to embedded Linux-based services, diagnostics, and platform software where applicable, evaluating technologies such as Yocto to improve scalability and maintainability.

* **Bachelor’s or master’s degree** in computer engineering, software engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related STEM field; a less directly related degree is acceptable when accompanied by a demonstrated track record of leading production firmware development at increasing scope and complexity.
* **10**+ years of experience developing embedded firmware for commercial products across a variety of MCU families and architectures, with demonstrated progression in technical responsibility, product ownership, and cross-functional influence. Proven track record of leading the design and delivery of production-quality embedded firmware for new products — from initial bring-up through production release.
* **Sound knowledge of C,** complemented by working knowledge of C++, and specialized depth in hardware-level, bare-metal firmware development, including system-level debugging, performance analysis, and optimization on resource-constrained MCU platforms, with the ability to work independently, evaluate solutions beyond the firmware itself, and recommend the best approach without routine guidance.

jobs.title: Intermediate Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Intermediate Electrical Engineer**

**McCoy Global**

**THIS JOB IS FOR YOU**

**IF YOU** ACT LIKE AN OWNER AND OWN YOUR ACTIONS;

**IF YOU** EMBRACE CHALLENGE AND LEAD CHANGE;

**IF YOU** EVOLVE, ADAPT AND CELEBRATE SUCCESS;

**IF YOU** APPROACH ALL INTERACTIONS POSTIVELY, COURAGEOULSY AND HONESTLY;

**IF YOU** HAVE YOUR TEAMS BACK;

**IF YOU** ARE THE BEST AT EVERYTHING YOU DO!

**What We Need:**

Are you passionate about creating innovative technology that performs in some of the world's toughest operating environments? We are seeking an **Intermediate Electrical Engineer** to help design, develop, and test embedded systems that power our industrial sensor and control products.

In this role, you'll work across the entire product development lifecycle, contributing from concept and prototyping through validation, testing, and production release. You'll apply your expertise in embedded hardware and firmware development to build reliable, high-performing solutions that enable our customers to operate safely and efficiently.

As part of a collaborative engineering team, you'll develop software for microcontrollers and microprocessors, contribute to electronic circuit design, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and help bring new products to market. If you're a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and working on products that make a real impact in industrial environments, we'd like to hear from you.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems development.

**What you’ll do:**

* Hands-on experience programming microcontrollers and microprocessors across common architectures.
* Solid programming skills in C and C++ for embedded applications.
* Working knowledge of common hardware interfaces and peripherals (timers, analog I/O, serial communication buses).
* Practical experience with firmware update and bootloader implementation for devices deployed in the field.
* Working knowledge of electronic circuit design, including power and signal basics.
* Applies low-power design considerations to battery operated devices.
* Uses standard lab and debugging equipment to independently troubleshoot hardware and software issues.
* Demonstrated experience with wireless or wired communication technologies.
* Applies product testing and compliance requirements to designs.
* Works with cross functional teams and contributes to project planning and code reviews.

**Who Are We?**

Over a century ago, blacksmith Henry McCoy established the Edmonton Auto Spring Works in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Back in 1914, the name McCoy meant a commitment to quality; and that, along with a desire to continually innovate, is what we stand for today.

**KEEPING AHEAD OF THE CURVE**

Always ahead of the curve, we’ve evolved from auto springs, axle manufacturing, trucking, and trailers, to hydraulic power tongs, advanced engineering for wellbore integrity, data acquisition for harsh environments, and cloud-based automated Smart technology solutions. Our evolution has been relentless – just the way we love it.

**LEADING CHANGE**

All along the way, we have aggressively embraced change to support our customers at every turn, anticipating their needs and delivering highly customized solutions. It is no surprise that our company today bears little resemblance to the blacksmith shop of 1914.

**AN UNWAVERING FOCUS**

Yet it is also no surprise that our spirit remains fundamentally unchanged: our focus on quality and customization ensures the products and services we provide live up to our promises, so you can live up to yours.

**When you work at McCoy, you work with:**

* A great teamwork environment that challenges your ability while having fun.
* A voice to help us continuously improve our processes and teams.
* A chance to help us deliver innovative solutions to our customers provide energy to the world.
* An opportunity to grow within our company as we succeed in growing our customers.
* An organization that recognizes and cares about its employee’s well-being.

**So, what can McCoy offer you?**

* We offer competitive time-off
* 4 wellness days PER YEAR plus your birthday off!
* 3 weeks of vacation accrued throughout the year
* We match your 401K
* Matching Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Work with a company that CARES

**We are 1-McCoy and We want YOU!**

**Job Title:** Senior Electrical Engineer, Sustaining

**Department:** Hardware Engineering

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Location:** Houston, TX (on-site)

**Travel:** 10%

**Who We Are**

Persona is building humanoid robots for the most demanding environments in heavy industry — shipyards, steel mills, fabrication facilities, and offshore platforms — performing welding, grinding, maintenance, inspection, and material-handling work that is dangerous, physically demanding, and increasingly difficult to staff.

We are backed by leading strategic and financial investors and engaged with global industrial leaders across Korea, Japan, the United States, and Singapore. Korea is the center of gravity for our early commercial strategy, anchored by relationships with the world’s leading shipbuilders and steelmakers. Our work spans both the robot platform itself and the systems, partners, and playbooks required to deploy it at scale.

**Why Join Persona?**

* We offer competitive compensation, a performance-based bonus, 100% employer covered medical benefits for most healthcare plans, early-stage equity, competitive PTO, and company-wide paid winter break between December 24th and January 2nd.
* You’ll shape technology that’s redefining the possibilities of robotics and human interaction.
* Work alongside passionate teammates who value creativity, and continuous learning.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Sustaining Electrical Engineer to own the electronics we already have deployed on our robots. As we scale production, this role ensures our deployed and in-production designs stay healthy, easy to build, and flexible enough to meet new customer needs.

You will sit between our product-focused design engineers and our manufacturing and field operations teams. When a board fails on the line, a robot misbehaves in the field, or a customer application needs something added or done differently, you are the person who troubleshoots it, finds the root cause, and drives the fix — whether that’s a rework, a component change, a design modification, or a documentation update.

This is not a forward-looking design role. It’s a role for an experienced, hands-on engineer who thrives on variety, can juggle many inputs at once, and has the people skills to work across manufacturing, field ops, firmware, and design teams. Expect broad scope and lots of different problems: you’ll often be the filter and the bridge that closes the gap between manufacturing and operations.

If you’ve supported products through their lifecycle and enjoy making shipped hardware work better at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own deployed electrical designs across the robot — PCBAs, harnesses, and rigid-flex assemblies for actuators, sensors, perception, compute, and power — keeping them reliable, manufacturable, and supportable through their lifecycle.
* Serve as the primary electrical interface to manufacturing and field operations: triage incoming issues, prioritize across many inputs, and act as the filter between production, ops, and the product design team.
* Troubleshoot and root-cause failures on the production line and in the field, from board-level faults to full-robot system issues, using schematics, firmware knowledge, and lab tools (scope, logic analyzer, DMM).
* Develop and implement fixes: reworks, component substitutions, ECOs, and targeted design modifications to existing boards.
* Adapt existing designs for new or varied customer applications when something needs to be added or done differently.
* Support the battery and battery management system (BMS) in the field and in production, including diagnostics and corrective actions.
* Partner with manufacturing and EMS partners on yield, DFM/DFA/DFT improvements, test coverage, and production ramp.
* Design and improve test fixtures and test procedures for production and failure analysis, including test software where needed.
* Own documentation for sustained designs: failure analysis reports, ECOs, troubleshooting guides, work instructions, and revision control of schematics and BOMs.
* Work across sustaining and product design teams to feed field and manufacturing learnings back into future designs.
* Collaborate with firmware and software teams to diagnose issues that span hardware and code.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* 8+ years of industry experience supporting production electronics, with project or program-level ownership later in your career.
* Very hands-on: strong lab fluency with scope, logic analyzer, and DMM; you trust your measurements and can debug at both the board and system level.
* Proven track record troubleshooting, root-causing, and fixing issues in deployed or in-production hardware.
* Experience working directly with manufacturing, EMS partners, and field operations teams.
* Ability to read and modify schematics and layouts in a modern ECAD tool (KiCAD, Altium, Cadence Allegro).
* Solid fundamentals across mixed-signal systems: power conversion, analog sensing, and embedded digital communication (CAN-FD, EtherCAT, SPI, I2C, USB, Ethernet, RS485).
* A juggler: comfortable managing many simultaneous issues from many stakeholders and prioritizing what matters most.
* Strong communication and people skills; you can translate between design engineers, technicians, and operations staff.
* Disciplined documentation habits: ECOs, failure analysis reports, and revision control.

**Bonus Skills:**

* Prior experience in a sustaining engineering role.
* Product lifecycle experience: supporting designs from launch through end-of-life, including obsolescence and component substitutions.
* Test engineering experience, including designing test fixtures and writing test software.
* Software development experience (Python, embedded C) for diagnostics, test automation, or firmware support.
* Experience with battery systems and battery manag

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

**About the job**
-----------------

A line of code can be many things - an amazing feature, a beautiful UI, a transformative algorithm. The faster this line of code reaches millions of users, the sooner it impacts their lives. As a Software Engineer, Tools and Infrastructure, you will be at the heart of Google’s engineering process building software that empowers engineering teams to develop and deliver high quality products quickly. We are focused on solving the hardest, most interesting challenges of developing software at scale without sacrificing stability, quality, velocity or code health.  
  
We ensure Google's success by partnering with engineering teams and developing scalable tools and infrastructure that help engineers develop, test, debug and release software quickly. We impact thousands of Googlers and billions of users by increasing the pace of product development and ensuring our products are thoroughly tested. We are advocates for code health, testability, maintainability and best practices for development and testing.  
  
Having access to all of Google's platforms and vast compute resources provides a unique opportunity to grow as an engineer. We typically work in small, nimble teams that collaborate on common problems across products and focus areas. As a result, the exposure to this broad set of problems provides technical challenges as well as accelerated career growth.

We are a multidisciplinary team working to build Fuchsia, a modern, open source operating system and adjacent open source projects like Pigweed. Pigweed is an open source collection of embedded-targeted libraries we call modules. These modules are building blocks and infrastructure that enable faster and more reliable development on small-footprint MMU-less 32-bit microcontrollers.

Fuchsia is a modern, open source operating system that is simple, secure, updatable, and performant. It’s a general purpose OS, designed to power an ecosystem of hardware and software, and provides core operating system functions like system resource management, a driver framework, and software abstractions.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS operates the world's largest fleet of GPU-accelerated servers powering AI/ML workloads at cloud scale. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service.  
  
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (hardware) to drive end-to-end delivery of GPU-accelerated servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.  
  
What You Will Do  
You will own programs where the critical path runs through silicon, firmware, and software teams simultaneously. You will translate ambiguity into structure: turning a fleet telemetry signal into a corrective action plan with quantified failure rates, a customer requirement into a new platform milestone with EVT/DVT/PVT gates, or a manufacturing escape into a design change with updated validation criteria. You will drive decisions on program trade-offs — adjusting scope when qualification gates slip, balancing deployment speed against fleet risk, and determining when to accept interim mitigations instead of holding for root-cause fixes. When a large scale of GPU servers depend on your program landing on time, you are the one ensuring hardware readiness, qualification completeness, and operational handoff happen without gaps.  
  
Why You Will Love It  
The world's most advanced frontier models are trained on the platforms you help build. Your programs launch the GPU servers that power the largest AI/ML workloads on the planet. You will see your decisions reflected in fleet reliability metrics within weeks of deployment. The team is small and high-trust — you own programs end to end from concept through production, with direct access to leadership and engineering alike.  
  
The Ideal Candidate  
You have deep technical intuition across hardware and software — enough to challenge engineering decisions, not just track them. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing structure to programs where requirements, timelines, and dependencies are still forming. You align priorities across teams in different organizations, and you escalate with data, not noise. You actively mentor and develop others — TPMs and engineers alike. You contribute to hiring, promotion assessments, and raising the bar for program management practices in your organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Strategy & Mechanisms  
  

* Define program strategy, objectives, and success criteria; influence resource allocation and priority decisions across engineering workstreams to align with organizational goals
* Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data-driven decisions and early risk detection
* Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity

  
Requirements & Planning  
  

* Facilitate requirements gathering with internal customers; develop Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) covering server specs, rack configurations, PCIe topology, power/cooling topology, and SKU definitions
* Build program timelines aligned to different phases (Program Initiation, Design, Qualification, Pilot, Post-launch) with critical path analysis, risk identification with new & unique changes to the hardware, and milestone tracking for the program.
* Drive Program Initiation reviews: scope definition, preliminary annualized failure rate predictions, resource planning, supply chain long-lead identification, and RFP (Request for Proposal) issuance to ODMs

  
Execution & Coordination  
  

* Drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, firmware (BIOS, BMC, CPLD), software, and operations teams through design reviews, manufacturing readiness and production readiness for fleet deployment.
* Manage ODM partnerships: track EVT/DVT/PVT builds, manufacturing readiness gates, Bill of Materials (BOM) management in PLM systems, and quality checkpoints
* Identify blockers early, escalate dependencies before they impact critical path, and facilitate technical trade-off decisions across engineering workstreams.
* Communicate program status to leadership with clear reporting on milestone progress, risk posture, and mitigation plans.

  
Risk & Quality  
  

* Challenge technical workstreams to surface risks early; quantify impact to schedule and reliability (annualized failure rate targets, availability SLAs) with proposed mitigations
* Drive root cause analysis of fleet-wide hardware failures and ensure corrective actions flow back into qualification criteria and design requirements
* Define acceptance criteria, coordinate qualification testing at server and rack levels, and manage go/no-go decisions for mission-critical AI/ML workloads

  
Transition  
  

* Conduct knowledge transfer and document lessons learned; ensure operational readiness including automation, monitoring, and runbook completeness for production handoff

You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you triage a fleet reliability issue with operations data, drive alignment on corrective actions, and update executive stakeholders on program risk posture. jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

What You'll Do

The Automation Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, maintainability, recoverability, and long-term performance of industrial automation and control systems supporting manufacturing operations. The position serves as the technical reliability owner for the facility's PLCs, HMIs, industrial computers, robots, servo systems, VFDs, machine sensors, vision systems, safety controls, industrial networks, remote I/O, automated material-handling systems, and associated electrical/control infrastructure. The role supports automated equipment across sheet metal fabrication, CNC machining, copper/aluminum bus bar manufacturing, pipe/tube fabrication, robotic welding, chemical pretreatment, powder coating/painting, assembly, testing, and material handling. The engineer works closely with Maintenance, Equipment Performance & Reliability Engineering, Automation & Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, IT/OT, EHS, equipment OEMs, and system integrators to systematically eliminate automation-related production losses.

* Serve as the technical owner for automation and controls reliability across manufacturing equipment. Develop and execute automation reliability strategies.
* Monitor the health and performance of PLC, HMI, robotic, motion-control, industrial-network, and machine-control systems.
* Identify recurring automation failures and eliminate their root causes.
* Reduce controls-related unplanned downtime.
* Improve automation-system MTBF and MTTR.
* Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies for automation systems.
* Establish backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery standards.
* Manage automation hardware/software lifecycle and obsolescence risk.
* Provide advanced technical support for complex automation failures.
* Develop standardized controls-reliability practices across the facility.

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or related technical discipline.
* Min of 5 years experience of industrial automation, controls, electrical or manufacturing engineering.
* Strong PLC troubleshooting experience required
* Industrial robotics experience strongly preferred

Why Join Us?

Company Statement: Graham Packaging is a people, planet and values-based company and a leader in sustainable packaging manufacturing. From the kitchen to the laundry room, Graham Packaging is part of your everyday life. For employees at Graham, our Blue Culture is part of their everyday lives, too. In other words, Blue is how we do things here. At Graham, we are united by a clear vision. We know our part and help those around us know theirs, encouraging one another to continuously improve. We create a safe, challenging environment to innovate by supporting creative ideas and new ways of thinking. We take the initiative to cultivate our individual growth and help others do the same, while keeping ourselves and one another accountable. And we actively promote cooperation, collaboration, integrity and respect across regions and teams to foster an engaged, diverse and connected workforce. We value our employees, and a Blue Culture allows for the most rewarding employee experience as part of the Graham family. Blue is how we feel about what we do—together—to create a better tomorrow. Working at Graham means you lead constructively with clear goals, use diverse thinking to drive excellence, accountability, innovation, as well as demonstrating collaboration, embracing learning, and taking action for continuous improvement and growth. Overview:

The Plant Controls Engineer is responsible for performing technical and project engineering duties to improve plant manufacturing performance, reduce costs, improve methods, and assist in machine maintenance and reliability.

Focus includes development & improvement of plant automation & control systems. The primary job function of a Plant Controls Engineer may include:

* Communicate and review operational performance of production equipment, and develop solutions to improve productivity.
* Develops automation and control system solutions to improve operational performance. Solutions may include, but not limited to PLC & HMI enhancements, vision systems, and robotic work cells.
* Continually reviews the status of plant electrical systems and offers value added upgrade solutions where applicable.
* Supports Operations with focus on producing quality product by monitoring quality levels and adjust the manufacturing processes.
* Reads and interprets drawings, blueprints, schematics and electrical code specifications to determine layout of industrial electrical equipment installations.
* Develop & submit capital & expense projects to support plant operations.
* Installs, examines, replaces or repairs electrical wiring, receptacles, switch boxes, conduits, feeders, fiber optic and cable assemblies, lighting fixtures and/or other electrical components.
* Tests electrical and electronic equipment and components to resolve issues.
* Maintains, repairs, installs and tests switchgear, transformers, switchboard meters, regulators and reactors.
* Maintains, repairs, tests and installs electrical motors, generators, alternators, industrial storage batteries and hydraulic and pneumatic electrical control systems.
* Troubleshoots, maintains and repairs industrial, electrical and electronic control systems and other related devices.
* Conducts preventive maintenance programs and keeps accurate maintenance records.

Qualifications:

* Associates Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar fields.
* A minimum of 5+ years programming experience
* Plant Controls Engineers are required to interact with other managers, employees, vendors, and customers.

Prior experience with the following technical areas:

* PLC & HMI programming. Beckhoff, RSLogix5000/500/5 preferred.
* Plant SCADA systems.
* Prior experience with industrial control networks; Ethernet 1/P, Control Net, DeviceNET, DH+, Remote 110
* MS Office; Strong knowledge of MS-Excel, some VB preferred.
* AutoCAD / AutoCADLT / equivalent drafting and understanding electrical, pneumatic and process flow prints.
* Ability to design and troubleshoot electrical and pneumatic systems.

Plant Controls Engineers are required to interact with other managers, employees, vendors, and customers. Therefore, the following skills and proficiencies are also essential requirements of the position:

* Ability to maintain regular, predictable, and punctual attendance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers.
* Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service.
* Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions
* Communicates effectively: conveys facts and information clearly both verbally and orally.
* Collaborates well with others: proactively contributes to group objectives; volunteers to help others.

This includes the leadership of the migration and lifecycle system process, maintenance recommendation and oversight of installed base equipment, co-ordination of concepts with production.  
  
**Why work for Clean Harbors?**

* Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!
* Competitive pay and benefits
* Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Group 401-K retirement savings with company matching
* Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career
* Generous paid time off, company paid training and tuition reimbursement
* Positive and safe work environments

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead safety, environmental compliance, and management of change (MOC) activities for all automation and control system modifications.
* Own the reliability, availability, and performance of DCS, PLC, SIS, HMI, historian, virtualization, servers, workstations, and process control network infrastructure across assigned sites.
* Monitor system health, execute preventive maintenance strategies, and resolve issues proactively to minimize downtime and operational risk.

* Maintain secure OT infrastructure, including backups, disaster recovery, remote access, patch management, network administration, and cybersecurity compliance.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, including P&IDs, loop drawings, control narratives, logic records, I/O databases, network diagrams, and system architecture documents.
* Lead root cause analyses and continuous improvement initiatives to improve reliability, safety, and operational performance.
* Support capital projects, outages, turnarounds, FAT/SAT testing, commissioning, startup, and contractor/vendor management activities.
* Drive standardization, best practices, performance metrics, dashboards, and configuration quality across all supported facilities.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, regional support, and on-call assistance as required.

**Control Systems and Technical Scope**

* ABB 800xA and/or INFI 90/Symphony (Essential) with hands-on experience in configuration, diagnostics, lifecycle management, system administration, and architecture design.
* Emerson DeltaV and Rockwell Automation (Highly Desired) including DeltaV, ControlLogix, Studio 5000, FactoryTalk, communications infrastructure, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support.
* SCADA, HMI, and Historian Platforms including AVEVA/Wonderware, Canary Historian, and related industrial data management systems.
* Industrial Networks and Communications including TCP/IP, OPC, Modbus, Profibus, FOUNDATION Fieldbus, EtherNet/IP, wireless technologies, and secure remote access solutions.
* Control System Infrastructure and Cybersecurity including process control networks, servers, workstations, managed switches, domain services, virtualization platforms (VMware), system backups, disaster recovery, and OT cybersecurity best practices.
* Process Control and Functional Safety including alarm management, DCS interlocks, SIS lifecycle management, loop tuning, sequence control, basic and advanced process control, and process optimization initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Mandatory ABB experience combined with either Emerson DeltaV or Rockwell Automation experience, with preference given to candidates who possess ABB plus DeltaV expertise, or ABB plus Rockwell ControlLogix / FactoryTalk expertise.
* ABB, Emerson, or Rockwell automation training, certifications, and experience with industrial networking standards, virtualization platforms, and control system infrastructure.
* Experience supporting SIS lifecycle management, functional safety programs, alarm management, OT cybersecurity initiatives, and recognized standards such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST, and CISA guidance.

**Travel and Work Location Expectations**

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you!

We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA's pursuits in deep space exploration.

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Systems Engineer, ATCS** to join our JETS II contract team at **NASA Johnson Space Center in Houston, TX**.

**If selected you will:**

* Review system architectures, hardware requirements, designs, assembly procedures, test plans, procedures and data of ATCS for Commercial vehicles and US Deorbit Vehicle (USDV) modules to ensure approaches are sound, component/material selection is appropriate for the intended usage, and suitable for the proposed application.
* Review nonconformances and anomaly resolution reports.
* Conduct independent reviews of mission data and certification products
* Review and provide input to system and sub-system level requirements and other Gateway Program USDV documents.
* Provide recommendations for program acceptance of requirements verification, testing, and hazards.
* Review and evaluate qualification test reports and resolution of anomalies identified in certification of the ATCS system for the spacecraft.
* Assess any potential impacts to design modifications which would lead into a delta qualification effort.
* Review the Phase III hazard reports and associated verification products.
* Review many of the certification products prior to the future test flights for the spacecraft including Qualification Reports, Verification Events, Verification Completion Notices, Final Verification Review, etc
* Investigate technology development opportunities and perform infusion planning.
* Perform and review system level analyses that will influence the overall design and performance.
* Review and provide input to system and sub-system level requirements and other Commercial Crew Office (CCO) program documents.
* Develop ATCS requirements verification plan
* Investigate technology development opportunities and perform infusion planning.
* Develop analysis package presentations.
* Manage heat load vs. heat rejection matrix.
* Develop integrated module/TCS schematics
* Maintain the TCS Concept of Operations (ConOps).
* Provide written and oral statuses in the form of presentations or reports and represent the Thermal Systems Manager at program and engineer.
* Interface with international partners and providers for integrated solutions of ATCS
* Review commercial providers hardware development activities and advise Thermal ATCS System Manager on any areas of concern
* Travel as required in support of technical reviews, testing and exchanges.
* Prepare console support products, review flight products changes, and support system operations through console support
* Additional duties as required

**Qualifications:**

This position has been posted at multiple levels. Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised.

* Experience in the design, assembly, testing, certification, and operation of space ATCS systems and components, which may include but not be limited to pumps and valves, coolant loops, cold plates, heat exchangers, sublimators, radiators, and heat exchangers during pre-launch, flight, and post-landing phases.
* Experience coordinating space ATCS systems requirements verification and validation between multiple organizations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and theability to coordinate support from a wide range of technicaldisciplines.
* Basic knowledge of commonly-used concepts, practices, and procedures in the field, such as mechanical system design, engineering drawings and sketches, material selection, testing, andoffice software

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiar with JSC organizations, processes, and procedures.
* The ability to coordinate support from a wide range of technical disciplines.
* Familiarity with the Engineering Life Cycle process.

**Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Positive work-life balance
* 100% Employer paid insurance including: Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, short-term disability, and long-term disability
* 11 paid holidays annually
* Generous PTO

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.

KLA is seeking a highly motivated Software AI Engineer to develop next-generation artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions supporting semiconductor process control, inspection, and metrology systems. **Preferred Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and two years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 4 years

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services (IdMS)
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it! Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it. Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production — managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software.
  
  
Description
  
  
Join Apple's Identity Management Services (IdMS) team as a Software Engineer and be part of building the next generation of innovative, high-scale software applications. We are looking for a passionate and driven engineer with experience in developing and deploying large-scale, high-demand systems.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 2+ years of hands-on experience in application development.
* 2+ years in Core Java, JEE, and multi-threaded programming and object-oriented design principles.
* 1+ years experience in APIs and HTTP(S) and RESTful architectures.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related engineer degree.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Skilled in designing and developing distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Experience building mobile-responsive web applications, with a focus on cross-browser compatibility.
* Well-versed in software engineering best practices, including design patterns and enterprise architecture.
* Experience in ReactJS, TypeScript, and web development toolchains including Webpack and Jest.
* Experience in data-driven web development, with solid knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.
* Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, concurrent programming, and implementation of efficient data structures.

Description:

**Job Summary:** The Electrical Engineer II is a hands-on role responsible for building, wiring, testing, and troubleshooting electrical systems and components for manufacturing operations. **Responsibilities:**

* Build, wire, and assemble electrical systems, panels, and harnesses from schematics and drawings.
* Perform hands-on testing and troubleshooting of electrical and electromechanical systems and components.

* Solder, rework, and assemble electronic components and boards.

* Update schematics and wiring diagrams using CAD software to reflect as-built conditions.
* Support production by resolving electrical issues on the floor.
* Work with mechanical engineers, technicians, and production teams to integrate electrical and mechanical subsystems.
* Follow safe work practices when working with high-power electronics and motion control systems.
* Comply with industry standards, codes, and regulations.
* Document test results and work instructions.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2-4 years of hands-on electrical experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience building, testing, and troubleshooting electrical hardware.
* Experience with soldering and electronic assembly.
* Exposure to high-power electronics and electromechanical motion control systems and their safe practices.
* Experience integrating mechanical and electrical subsystems preferred.

**Skills & Abilities:**

* Practical skills in wiring, assembly, testing, and repair of electrical systems.
* Skilled use of test and measurement equipment and hand tools.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics and wiring diagrams.
* Working knowledge of CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks Electrical).
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work as part of a team with moderate supervision.
* Familiarity with industry standards and codes (e.g., NEC, IEC).

**Work Environment:**

* Frequent hands-on work at a lab bench and on the production floor.
* Periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for documentation.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds with or without assistance.
* Adhere to strict safety standards and regulatory requirements.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman is currently seeking a leader to fill a **Manufacturing Systems Engineering Manager 2** supporting the Sentinel program. This position is located in **Roy, Utah**. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s Engineering & Manufacturing Development (EMD) contract to replace the aging Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) System and associated infrastructure.

**This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.**

**What you will get to do:**

Northrop Grumman is seeking a Manufacturing Systems Engineering Manager 2 to lead our Production Operations team through the development & build of various elements and sub-elements, specifically the On Board Test Equipment (OBTE) subsystems and the Booster subsystems of the overall missile system, for our Sentinel system for our Air Force customer. You will act as the C0-M100 (Corporate Manufacturing Management System) driving force, in accordance with CHB M110, shaping how we will manufacture and deploy product from early concept through rate production.

This position requires a comprehensive understanding of design and production, program management skills, proven strategic planning and business execution capabilities, as well as ability to work collaboratively across multiple disciplines. The position will be a key leadership role interfacing with Sentinel leadership staff, both within our SDS division and with our Supplier and Sister NG partners, located across the country, in establishing & executing to the baseline program plans. In addition, the candidate should be able to interact and influence higher level management and communicate effectively with both oral and written presentations.

The Production Manager will provide operational focus (cost, quality, and schedule) for the element level manufacturing effort. The Production Manager is responsible for the overall operational performance for the lifecycle of the program starting with engineering & development, ensuring successful standup and production readiness of our supplier teammates and partners, positioning for future production needs. The Production Manager will act as the first level Production & Manufacturing Operations leader with accountability to the program and functional leadership team. The Production Manager will have responsibility to ensure all operations aspects of the program from material procurement to finished product delivery are properly planned and executed in accordance with the Program Execution Plan. This includes establishing needs and driving delivery of Engineering products and support as required to support the program schedule. You will provide leadership to a cross functional team that may include Manufacturing Engineers (MEs), Industrial Engineers (IEs), Operations Project Managers (OPMs), Tooling, and Supplier Support. You will own manufacturing planning, readiness, risk identification, and Design for Manufacturing & Assembly (DFMA) activities aligned with the Corporate Manufacturing Management System and SAE AS6500, ensuring Sentinel meets its quality, schedule, and cost commitments.

**Position responsibilities include:**

* Serve as the Production Operations lead at the IPT level within Sentinel’s Flight Systems for assigned work scope.
* Lead the design, implementation, and maturation of the integrated manufacturing system for Sentinel during EMD:
  + Define how we will build Sentinel OBTE & Booster hardware at scale.
  + Drive execution on the system to prove out processes, tooling, data, and workflows.
  + Identify and close gaps required for a smooth transition into Production.
* Develop and maintain the cross functional manufacturing plan for Sentinel, including:
  + Manufacturing requirements development and technical planning.
  + Manufacturing system design, integration, verification, and validation.
  + Evaluation of cost, schedule, span time, and implementation/program risk impacts
* Drive compliance with the Corporate Manufacturing Management System and SAE AS6500, including:
  + Tailoring manufacturing management requirements for Sentinel.
  + Leading and/or supporting required documentation and reviews as part of the Business Acquisition Process (BAP) and major program milestones/technical reviews.
* Own Manufacturing Readiness Assessments (MRA) and Manufacturing Readiness Levels (MRL) for critical/key Sentinel parts and products:
  + Identify manufacturing risks, opportunities, and mitigation actions.
  + Ensure manufacturing risks and maturation plans are visible in the program risk register and to Sentinel leadership.
* Lead Design for Manufacturing & Assembly (DFMA) and producibility analysis for Sentinel:
  + Integrate DFMA across Systems Engineering, Design Engineering, Global Supply Chain, suppliers, and operations.
  + Incorporate lessons learned and best practices from prior programs to improve cost, schedule, and quality.
  + As CAM, develop and manage budgets, resource planning, schedules, and performance standards for assigned production

jobs.description:
Overview:

The semiconductor industry is experiencing one of the largest periods of growth and transformation in its history, and Tool Install design sits at the center of it. At SSOE, we design systems that connect some of the world's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment to the facilities that power tomorrow's technologies. From tool hookups and utility systems to subfab design, cleanroom modifications, and equipment integration, our work directly impacts the production of next-generation chips used in AI, data centers, autonomous vehicles, consumer electronics, and advanced computing. Recognized as one of the industry's leading semiconductor design firms, SSOE combines deep technical expertise with a culture built on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Here, you'll work alongside some of the brightest minds in engineering, leverage cutting-edge digital and AI-enabled tools, and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology. If you're looking for meaningful work, technical challenges, and a place where your ideas matter, you'll find it at SSOE.

As an **Electrical Engineer** at SSOE, you'll work alongside experienced engineers, project managers, and multidisciplinary design teams to develop electrical designs for tool installations, power distribution, cleanroom environments, and facility upgrades that enable next-generation technology manufacturing. In this role, you will be involved in electrical calculations, focusing on low to medium voltage environments. The ideal candidate possesses experience with distribution panel loading, short circuit analysis, voltage drop calculations, conduit and conductor sizing, and cable tray fills. You will have access to industry-leading tools, collaborative leadership, and a firm culture consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work. Join us in shaping innovative design-build projects with a relentless commitment to quality, efficiency, and collaborative excellence.

AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities:

* Generate comprehensive technical project plans, specifications, drawings, and models aligned with both industry standards, client requirements, and electrical engineering best practices.
* Develop detailed electrical drawings and technical documentation that support areas such as process equipment installation design packages, tool hookup design, subfab rack and lateral design, and cleanroom and facility modification support.
* Determine conduit and conductor sizing, meticulously accounting for current loads and environmental variables.
* Assess cable tray fills methodically to guarantee proper cable management, organization, and future scalability.
* Perform detailed short circuit calculations to accurately determine fault currents, select appropriate protective devices, and ensure system safety.
* Perform precise voltage drop calculations to ensure electrical system stability and compliance with industry standards.
* Ensure all electrical designs rigorously comply with and exceed local, state, and national electrical codes and regulations to guarantee safety and quality.
* Apply established design techniques and exercises discernment in adapting and modifying design concepts as needed. Uphold quality control by adhering to company and team design and CAD standards.
* Will work with Sr. Engineers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders on specific assigned objectives, complex features, and aid in deriving possible solutions to unusual problems.
* Foster collaboration, communication, strategy, and support within your team, multidisciplinary groups (Mechanical, Structural, Process/Chemical, Architectural, etc.), and inter-company teams to optimize efficiency, quality, and resource allocation.
* Conduct field verifications and site walks to identify, validate, resolve, and integrate solutions into design packages. Resolve design issues on-site during construction if necessary.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited institution, qualifying candidate for professional engineering licensure in Arizona.
* Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE/EIT) exam, with a focus on electrical engineering principles, is highly desired.
* Demonstrated proficiency in AutoCAD for electrical design drafting is required. Experience with other tools such as Revit, ETAP, SKM Power Tools, and/or EasyPower is a plus.
* Knowledge of electrical codes and standards (e.g., National Electric Code, NFPA, etc.).
* Ability to clearly communicate technical information and design concepts to project managers, contractors, and cross-disciplinary teams.
* Salary Range: $68,000 - $98,000/year depending on location, education, experience, and any certifications that are directly related to the position.

Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. SSOE doesn't just hire talent, we invest in it. If you're passionate about innovation, career progression, and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward-thinking team.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an entry level Mechatronics Engineer to support the design, integration, testing, and maintenance of automation and control systems for custom laboratory equipment and robotic platforms at Novex. Recent graduates, Engineer-in-Training (EIT) candidates, and applicants with relevant technical training or equivalent practical experience are encouraged to apply.

This role combines mechanical design, electrical and controls integration, programming, and hands-on prototyping. Projects include instrumenting experimental setups, connecting sensors to PLCs and data acquisition systems, developing operator interfaces, and supporting automated liquid and material handling.

Working with our R&D team, you will contribute to projects from initial design through assembly, testing, and commissioning. You will also help maintain existing robotic platforms and develop custom equipment for future research needs. The position is based at our facility in Bellingham, WA, and suits someone who learns quickly, follows through on assigned work, and adapts as experimental requirements evolve.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* **Work on meaningful scientific and engineering challenges.** Develop automation for experimental systems used in chemical and materials research. See how equipment design and control decisions affect the quality and reliability of laboratory work.
* **Put advanced equipment to work.** Work with laboratory automation and robotic platforms from Chemspeed, Hamilton, Sirius Automation, ABB, and FESTO, alongside analytical instruments and custom experimental equipment.
* **Keep learning and growing.** Build skills in controls, robotics, mechanical design, and prototyping through practical projects, technical guidance, and training. Take on increasing responsibility as your capabilities develop.
* **Enjoy flexibility and professional development.** Benefit from flexible work arrangements that accommodate laboratory and project needs, along with opportunities to develop your technical skills and advance your career.
* **Make an impact in a growing team.** Contribute ideas and help turn experimental requirements into working hardware. Projects offer varied assignments across equipment development, integration, and improvement.
* **Live and work between the mountains and the sea.** Bellingham, Washington, offers access to skiing at Mount Baker, sailing in the San Juan Islands, and hiking through Pacific Northwest forests, with Seattle and Vancouver, BC, within reach.

**Our in-house capabilities**
-----------------------------

Our Innovation Center brings process development, advanced characterization, and pilot testing together, including:

* **Automation and robotics:** Chemspeed SWING and FLEX, Hamilton VANTAGE, Sirius Automation systems, and ABB and FESTO robotic platforms for liquid, material, and sample handling.
* **Instrumentation and controls:** Sensors, process monitoring, data acquisition, and controls integration for custom laboratory and pilot equipment.
* **Mechanical design and prototyping:** CAD, 3D printing, fabrication, and assembly of fixtures, tooling, and prototype components.
* **Laboratory and pilot equipment:** Reactors, thermal equipment, electrochemical systems, and experimental test rigs.

**What you will do**
--------------------

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager – AI/ML Hardware Engineering, Edge & AI/ML Accelerator Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS operates the world's largest fleet of GPU-accelerated servers powering AI/ML workloads at cloud scale. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service.  
  
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (hardware) to drive end-to-end delivery of GPU-accelerated servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.  
  
What You Will Do  
You will own programs where the critical path runs through silicon, firmware, and software teams simultaneously. You will translate ambiguity into structure: turning a fleet telemetry signal into a corrective action plan with quantified failure rates, a customer requirement into a new platform milestone with EVT/DVT/PVT gates, or a manufacturing escape into a design change with updated validation criteria. You will drive decisions on program trade-offs — adjusting scope when qualification gates slip, balancing deployment speed against fleet risk, and determining when to accept interim mitigations instead of holding for root-cause fixes. When a large scale of GPU servers depend on your program landing on time, you are the one ensuring hardware readiness, qualification completeness, and operational handoff happen without gaps.  
  
Why You Will Love It  
The world's most advanced frontier models are trained on the platforms you help build. Your programs launch the GPU servers that power the largest AI/ML workloads on the planet. You will see your decisions reflected in fleet reliability metrics within weeks of deployment. The team is small and high-trust — you own programs end to end from concept through production, with direct access to leadership and engineering alike.  
  
The Ideal Candidate  
You have deep technical intuition across hardware and software — enough to challenge engineering decisions, not just track them. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing structure to programs where requirements, timelines, and dependencies are still forming. You align priorities across teams in different organizations, and you escalate with data, not noise. You actively mentor and develop others — TPMs and engineers alike. You contribute to hiring, promotion assessments, and raising the bar for program management practices in your organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Strategy & Mechanisms  
  

* Define program strategy, objectives, and success criteria; influence resource allocation and priority decisions across engineering workstreams to align with organizational goals
* Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data-driven decisions and early risk detection
* Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity

  
Requirements & Planning  
  

* Facilitate requirements gathering with internal customers; develop Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) covering server specs, rack configurations, PCIe topology, power/cooling topology, and SKU definitions
* Build program timelines aligned to different phases (Program Initiation, Design, Qualification, Pilot, Post-launch) with critical path analysis, risk identification with new & unique changes to the hardware, and milestone tracking for the program.
* Drive Program Initiation reviews: scope definition, preliminary annualized failure rate predictions, resource planning, supply chain long-lead identification, and RFP (Request for Proposal) issuance to ODMs

  
Execution & Coordination  
  

* Drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, firmware (BIOS, BMC, CPLD), software, and operations teams through design reviews, manufacturing readiness and production readiness for fleet deployment.
* Manage ODM partnerships: track EVT/DVT/PVT builds, manufacturing readiness gates, Bill of Materials (BOM) management in PLM systems, and quality checkpoints
* Identify blockers early, escalate dependencies before they impact critical path, and facilitate technical trade-off decisions across engineering workstreams.
* Communicate program status to leadership with clear reporting on milestone progress, risk posture, and mitigation plans.

  
Risk & Quality  
  

* Challenge technical workstreams to surface risks early; quantify impact to schedule and reliability (annualized failure rate targets, availability SLAs) with proposed mitigations
* Drive root cause analysis of fleet-wide hardware failures and ensure corrective actions flow back into qualification criteria and design requirements
* Define acceptance criteria, coordinate qualification testing at server and rack levels, and manage go/no-go decisions for mission-critical AI/ML workloads

  
Transition  
  

* Conduct knowledge transfer and document lessons learned; ensure operational readiness including automation, monitoring, and runbook completeness for production handoff

  
May require occasional (

You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you triage a fleet reliability issue with operations data, drive alignment on corrective actions, and update executive stakeholders on program risk posture.
