Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

We seek a knowledgeable and experienced Senior Hardware Engineer - Memory & Storage Qualification to collaborate with Cloud Hardware Infrastructure Engineering, Azure Engineering, and Exchange Engineering groups to qualify memory and storage components for Microsoft Data Center.

We are looking for a candidate who can understand components architecture, software applications, and OS environment to create components qualification test plan for both device and system levels. This role will also include writing test software in some cases and debug. At the cutting edge of high-performance computing, provides an opportunity to benefit millions of users daily. The successful candidate must be able to synthesize complex and sometimes conflicting requirements from hardware, software and business teams.

#SCHIE

 **Responsibilities**

* Define and drive Microsoft's memory and storage qualification strategy across current and future Azure server platforms.
* Lead the architecture of scalable qualification frameworks, validation methodologies, automation infrastructure, and deployment readiness processes for cloud-scale environments.
* Influence component and platform architecture decisions by partnering with engineering, silicon, firmware, operating system, and service teams across Microsoft.
* Establish qualification coverage, reliability requirements, usage models, telemetry strategy, and health monitoring frameworks to ensure production readiness at hyperscale.
* Drive resolution of the most complex memory and storage issues impacting Azure platform availability, performance, and reliability.
* Lead cross-functional investigations involving hardware, firmware, operating systems, drivers, and cloud services to identify root causes and define corrective actions.
* Influence supplier roadmaps and engineering investments through strategic engagement with OEMs, ODMs, silicon providers, and storage and memory ecosystem partners.
* Champion engineering excellence through data-driven decision making, technical reviews, risk management, and continuous improvement of qualification processes.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship across engineering teams, helping establish best practices and raising organizational capability.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:

* + Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in hardware validation and qualification (planning, documentation, development, execution, and debug)

* Knowledge of server system, system memory, and storage architecture including HDD and SSD

* Familiar with networking, power, rack management and remote access environments

* Experience integrating and validating hardware components and/or system levels.

* Familiar with and able to develop scripts (PowerShell, Python, Perl) and routines to enable debug and accelerate data collection and data reduction via automation

* Self-motivated individuals must be able to work collaboratively in team environment and across internal divisions and industry (OEM, ODM), demonstrate technical leadership in driving successful product development.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage leadership audiences.

* Expertise with storage architecture including NVMe

* 8+ years Experience in server systems validation and qualification

* Experience defining test strategy for new products.

  
  
  

Hardware Engineering IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 - $234,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

jobs.title: Director, Spacecraft Systems Engineering, Integration, & Test, TeraWave
jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

  

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As Director, Spacecraft Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test, you lead the Spacecraft Systems Integration Office, the connective tissue of the TeraWave spacecraft. Your organization ensures that design decisions trace to requirements, stay consistent with interfaces, and are fully verified at every gate. Your team tests, and qualifies the space vehicle.

Your organization works closely with the TeraWave Chief Systems Architecture (CSA) Office and the spacecraft engineering teams. You own the spacecraft requirements, budgets and margins, and their sub-allocation to Avionics, Mechanical/Structural, GNC, Propulsion, Flight Software, and Mission Operations. Your organization is the authoritative source of spacecraft technical performance measures (TPMs) for CSA system models and program analytics. You work closely with payload, launch vehicle, flight software, networking, manufacturing, regulatory, and mission assurance partners to deliver a qualified vehicle on schedule.

As part of a growing team, you set technical direction, define bounding assumptions and freeze dates, and stay hands-on in the hardest trades. You favor lean, tool-driven workflows over moving data by hand, including AI-assisted requirements traceability and consistency checks, AI-generated test procedures and scripts under engineer oversight, and TPMs published as a dataset rather than reported manually. Success is a fully qualified, launched, and commissioned satellite that performs to specification and meets our space sustainability commitments, and a team that can sustain it into production.

  

Travel anticipated up to 25% of time.

  

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Own spacecraft segment requirements , including allocation to subsystems, verification planning, verification closure, and the verification compliance matrix.

* Own the spacecraft interface control documents, including payload-to-bus, bus-to-dispenser, bus-to-launch vehicle, and drive interface issues to closure.

* Manage the spacecraft technical performance budgets including: power and mass budgets, pointing, thermal margin, data, propellant, and reliability.

* Lead spacecraft safety analysis, including vehicle hazard analysis, energetic-failure mitigation, passivation, battery and pressure-system safety with Avionics and Propulsion, and range safety data packages.

* Lead demisability and disposal analysis, including demise analysis, the part-by-part demise change list, design-for-demise guidance to the engineering teams, micrometeoroid and orbital debris (MMOD) analysis, disposal reliability, and reentry timeline.

* Own the Space Sustainability Strategy, which sets the program's commitments, methodology, and philosophy on debris mitigation, disposal, collision avoidance, and space traffic coordination, and the technical framework for orbital debris assessment filings (ODAR/ODM). Provide the technical content for those filings to Spectrum & Regulatory.

* Stand up and run the spacecraft development lab, including FlatSat, avionics benches, flight software and GNC in-the-loop testing, propulsion checkout simulation, electrical ground support equipment (EGSE), and spacecraft-level test software.

* Lead environmental qualification, including functional test, vibration, thermal vacuum, EMI/EMC testing, and acceptance test requirements for production.

* Own spacecraft reliability engineering, including FMEA/FMECA, reliability predictions, and reliability growth tracking, in partnership with CSA Mission Assurance, which provides independent oversight.

* Hire, develop, and retain engineering leaders and engineers, manage performance, compensation, and promotions, and build a culture of safety, ownership, and technical excellence.

* Communicate technical status, risks, and schedule to program leadership, and support launch, early orbit operations, commissioning, and on-orbit anomaly resolution.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, or systems engineering, physics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 12+ years of systems engineering, integration, or test experience on spacecraft, launch vehicles, aircraft, or other complex high-reliability systems.

* 7+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers or multidisciplinary engineering teams.

* 7+ years of experience owning requirements, interfaces, and verification for a flight vehicle from definition through qualification.

* 7+ ye

jobs.description:
**Summary of Role:**  
Under general supervision, this position will provide plant engineering support in the design, assembly, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of PLC-based control systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), company policies, safety policies and practices, quality standards, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* Responsible at all times for ensuring that tasks are performed according to food safety, quality, and regulatory guidelines.
* Promote a safety culture and awareness within area of responsibility and support all plant safety policies and procedures at all times.
* Assist with the design and modification of new and existing process control and instrumentation systems.
* Manage capital projects relating to automation and controls infrastructure, etc. and complete projects as assigned within defined scope, allocated costs, time commitments and expected outcome.
* Provide plant leadership for manufacturing and distribution in all technical and administrative aspects related to PLC’s, microprocessors, etc.
* Continually improve packaging and manufacturing equipment controls logic for better efficiency and reduced waste.
* Assist in the identification and development of project justification and business recommendations for engineering proposals including providing input for capital planning processes.
* Lead cross-functional teams and address technical challenges to achieve critical objectives.
* Understand business needs, risks and organizational dynamics as well as their implications based on developing alternate plans and choices.
* Understand processing automation for troubleshooting and improving cycle time throughput.
* Identify and support cost reduction and efficiency improvement initiatives.
* Develop and coordinate all technical training requirements for operations and maintenance personnel related to instrumentation and controls.
* Promote active leadership in the implementation of plant-wide lean manufacturing efforts and TPS while integrating lean manufacturing disciplines in the engineering department.
* Assist with quality software systems for customized reports and data analysis.
* Support and recommend continuous improvement initiatives utilizing lean manufacturing tools and techniques.
* Perform other related duties as required and assigned.

**Qualifications:**  

* Experience with Allen-Bradley controls hardware required.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or Controls related field with 2 years of engineering experience in a high-volume, multi-SKU, fast-paced manufacturing environment preferred, OR
* High school diploma or GED with 5 years of Service Tech with controls/PLC experience in a high-volume, multi-SKU, fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Experience with ladder logic, HMI programming, and VFD setup required.
* Field Service or controls integration experience preferred.
* Experience with industrial networking and ethernet IP devices preferred.
* Experience troubleshooting controls systems to assist with maintenance preferred.

**Key Competencies & Attributes:**  

* High energy, self-starter with the ability to influence others.
* Leadership and project management experience.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Skilled use of standard computer software including MS Office Suite.
* Proficiency in updating or creating electrical schematics.
* Capable of reading detailed blueprints, schematics, and P&IDs.
* Familiarity with PLCs and machine control logic.
* Knowledge of Lean and Six Sigma methods.
* Ability to maintain punctuality and predictable attendance.

**Working Conditions:**  

* Must wear appropriate personal protective equipment and clean room attire.
* Moderate physical activity, requires standing, bending, twisting and/or walking for more than four (4) hours per day and up to twelve (12) hours per shift.
* Must be able to lift and carry items weighing 50 pounds.
* Must be able to perform work onsite and be comfortable in a light industrial environment, including some exposure to non-toxic dust.

jobs.title: Senior Mission Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) Mobility, Surveillance & Bombers (MS&B) is seeking a **Senior Mission Systems Engineer** with a focus on avionics and electrical systems to join our P-8A Augmented Fleet Support Team in **Tukwila, WA with a Domestic Temporary Assignment (DTA) in Jacksonville, FL**.

  
  

This position represents Boeing P-8 engineering as an integral part of a multi-disciplined team. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, customers, and technical subject matter experts.

  
  

The successful candidate will have a strong background in aviation systems engineering with a focus on safety, teamwork, and customer service. This role requires frequent interactions with cross-functional teams, maintenance personnel, and US Navy customers, necessitating excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Provide expert support for the troubleshooting and resolution of mission systems issues for the P-8 aircraft, focusing on avionics and electrical systems; systems will include, but are not limited to: electrical/electronic, communication & navigation, flight control & avionics systems, mission systems, landing gear, APU, Hydraulic, Fuel, Environmental, and engine systems.
* Effectively troubleshoot and resolve difficult, intermittent, chronic, or complex system problems consistent with operational protocols through the P-8 aircraft lifecycle.
* Work under minimal direction to support US Navy customer with troubleshooting efforts to diagnose and resolve mission system faults for in service P-8 fleet.
* Augment standard troubleshooting and repair technologies with innovative approaches.
* Document troubleshooting and repair solutions and supporting data in both Boeing internal and US Navy customer computing systems as applicable.
* Lead enhancements, improvements, and revisions to P-8 fleet command media; support updates to operational procedures and documentation relevant to P-8 in service fleet to drive engineering disposition process efficiencies and mitigate recurrent/repeat technical issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Engineering coordination, independence, and technical acumen along with frequent interaction re: US Military personnel.
* Represent P-8 fleet and advocate for customer priorities at internal Boeing meetings.
* Coordination and communication with P-8 engineering personnel in Boeing Global Services (BGS), Boeing Defense and Space (BDS), and Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA) at all levels.
  

  

**This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location.** This temporary assignment is located in **Jacksonville, FL**. This position offers transportation benefits and a DTA (Domestic Temporary Assignment Benefit) based on candidate eligibility.

  
  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus in Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement. **Candidate must meet Academic Standard or the Exception Criteria to be considered.**
* 10+ years of full time aerospace industry experience within Avionics and/or Electrical Systems.
* Experience with P-8 (or similar systems) fleet support or aircraft system design.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience working in a cross-functional environment with multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of aircraft systems, flight operations, and airworthiness requirements.
* Strong organization and communication skills.
* Experience with maritime surveillance systems.
* Experience working on P-8 Increment 3 Block 2 (I3B2) or similar modification programs.
* Familiarity with technical aspects of the P-8 aircraft and its mission systems.
* Experience with P-8 Mission Systems, Flight Testing System Support, Production Support, or Fleet Support.
* Experience working Commercial Derivative Aircraft (CDA) avionics systems.
* Experience with troubleshooting and repairing aircraft electrical, electronic, and avionics systems.
* Experience directly supporting customers at customer facilities with minimal oversight.
* Experience with aircraft systems and/or mechanical systems troubleshooting.
* Experience analyzing aircraft data from various on-board recording systems.
* Familiarity with Airplane Flight Manuals, Aircraft Maintenance Manuals, Fault Isolation Manuals, Fault Reporting Manuals, Powerplant Buildup Manuals, Wiring Diagram Manuals, and/or System Schematic Manuals.
* Active US Clearance.
  

  

**Conflict of Interest:**

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

### **Job Details**

##### **Job Description**

**Job Description:**

**INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!**

At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

  
  

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

  
  

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story, click HERE.

The Sr. Systems Firmware Quality Engineer will provide technical leadership in the development and **validation of complex connected product** that integrate hardware, embedded firmware, software, communications, and technologies using opensource tools/libraries/framework with AI.

  
  

This role will apply a combination of Quality and Test engineering skills to identify and mitigate Risks across the platform and products, with particular emphasis on hardware-firmware-software interfaces. The Sr. Systems Firmware Quality Engineer will work cross-functionally with Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, Product, and Service teams to ensure Systems requirements, interfaces, failure modes, and quality expectations are understood and validated throughout the product development lifecycle using Automation approach

  
  

**You’ll Be DISRUPTIVE Through These Duties and Responsibilities**
------------------------------------------------------------------

### **System Testing and Test Automation**

* Own end-to-end system testing for connected products, validating complete customer workflows across hardware, embedded firmware, BLE/wireless/RF connectivity, iOS/Android mobile applications, backend services, APIs, cloud platforms, and external integrations.
* Develop and execute System End-to-End (E2E) Test Strategies based on product requirements, system architecture, customer journey, risk, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) characteristics, and failure modes.
* Translate system requirements into testable scenarios, including positive, negative, boundary, recovery, interoperability, reliability, and real-world customer use cases.
* Define test dependencies and readiness criteria for hardware, firmware, mobile applications, backend/cloud services, test environments, accounts, configurations, data, and supporting infrastructure before System Test execution.
* Design, develop, and implement automated System and E2E tests using technologies such as Python, REST/API automation, device-control frameworks, mobile app automation technologies, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop reusable test automation frameworks that support mobile, API, cloud, device, and connected-product validation while reducing duplicated test development and improving scalability.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback on firmware, mobile application, backend, API, and system-level changes.
* Validate cross-component interactions, including device provisioning, authentication, BLE communication, synchronization, cloud connectivity, data persistence, OTA updates, notifications, location services, and account/device management.
* Maintain requirements-to-test traceability, ensuring system requirements, CTQs, customer journeys, identified risks, automated tests, defects, and test evidence are traceable throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Manage System Test execution using platforms such as Azure DevOps, including test plans, test cases, automation results, defects, test evidence, requirements traceability, and release-readiness status.
* Define and monitor System Quality and Test Automation KPIs, including requirements coverage, automated regression coverage, execution pass rate, defect discovery, defect leakage, test stability, flaky-test rate, customer-journey coverage, and release readiness.

### **Triage and Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in cross-functional system-level defect triage across hardware, firmware, BLE/wireless connectivity, mobile applications, APIs, backend/cloud services, test automation, and test environments on issues identified/logged by providing more details to identify solution.
* Analyze logs, telemetry, screenshots, video, API responses, network traces, automated test results, and other diagnostic evidence to isolate failures and accelerate root-cause identification.
* Differentiate product defects from automation, infrastructure, configuration, and test-environment failures, and route issues to the appropriate engineering teams for investigation and resolution.
* Troubleshoot with Engineers on complex System E2E failures to determine root cause.
* Help team in prioritizing defects based on severity, customer impact, reproducibility, frequency of occurrence, CTQ impact, and release ri

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Embedded Software Engineer** **| West Bend, WI**

#### **JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a motivated and hardworking individual to join our team in West Bend, WI as a Embedded Software Engineer. You will be part of a group of engineers dedicated to high-quality work, value-add solutions, skill development, and career growth. We welcome candidates from the Milwaukee metro and beyond to apply.

Employees working in West Bend, WI have a short commute from Germantown, Hartford, Jackson, Menomonee Falls, Slinger, Cedarburg, Grafton, and Milwaukee, and will enjoy professional growth and community engagement through our regional presence in Minnesota, Wisconsin, North Dakota and South Dakota.

As an **Embedded Software Engineer**, you will:

* Develop embedded software for advanced electro-hydraulic systems and controls
* Support programming and development efforts for hydraulic drive systems and loader arm control functions
* Design, implement, test, and validate control algorithms for electric-hydraulic applications
* Utilize MATLAB/Simulink for modeling, simulation, code development, and system validation
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to define system requirements and deliver robust control solutions
* Troubleshoot and optimize software performance in both development and testing environments
* Support integration activities involving software, electronics, sensors, actuators, and hydraulic components
* Participate in product development activities from concept through validation and release
* Work collaboratively with suppliers and Applied partners
* Contribute to projects that impact communities in Neighboring towns and the greater metro area
* Apply your skills in a dynamic environment that values ownership and innovation

#### **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor of Science in Computer or Electrical Engineering required
* Experience developing embedded software for control systems
* Background in electro-hydraulic controls or hydraulic system automation
* Demonstrated experience with MATLAB/Simulink
* Understanding of control theory, system modeling, and software development principles
* Experience with embedded systems, real-time software, and hardware integration
* Experience developing control software for hydraulic drive systems
* Experience with loader arm controls, mobile equipment, off-highway vehicles, or heavy machinery
* Experience validating and tuning electro-hydraulic control systems in laboratory or field environments
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Capable of working independently and as a team member
* Strong work ethic and unwavering integrity
* Excellent interpersonal skills and a learning mindset
* Curiosity, problem solving, and analytical thinking
* Effective verbal and written communication
* Desire to work on a variety of projects

#### **ESTIMATED PAY RANGE**

Engineer I: $40.45–$46.52/hour

Engineer II: $44.14–$50.76/hour

Engineer III: $47.83–$55.00/hour

Senior Engineer: $51.51–$59.24/hour

Final compensation is based on experience, skills, and alignment with role expectations. Paid overtime may be available.

#### **COMPANY OVERVIEW**

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

GE HealthCare’s Bone & Metabolic Health (BMH) business, known worldwide as Lunar, leads the world in dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA). DXA is the clinical reference standard for measuring bone mineral density and body composition. Our measurements are trusted because of their precision, and that precision depends on getting the physics right across the whole system: X-ray source, filtration, beam geometry, detector, mechanics, calibration and analysis.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer who thinks from first principles and enjoys hard technical problems. In this role, you will work out how the system behaves, find out why it sometimes doesn’t, and decide what to change. You will model, measure and explain system performance, lead investigations of complex cross-domain issues, and guide design decisions on new products and the installed base. This is not a requirements-management or traceability role. It is for someone who would rather be in the lab with a phantom and an analysis script than maintaining a requirements database.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and responsibilities**

**System physics and performance**

  

* Own the system-level understanding of how DXA measurements are formed: X-ray spectra, dual-energy attenuation, filtration, scatter, beam hardening, detector response, geometry and dose. Use that understanding to set and defend performance targets.
* Build analytical and numerical models (for example, spectral models, Monte Carlo and error budgets) that predict how subsystem changes affect precision, accuracy, image quality and dose.
* Design and run experiments with phantoms and lab systems to characterize performance, check models against data and quantify margins.
* Identify the parameters that drive measurement accuracy and precision, and turn them into well-reasoned specifications for hardware, firmware, and algorithm teams.

**Technical problem solving**

  

* Lead root-cause investigations of complex system-level issues from development, manufacturing and the field, especially issues that cross mechanical, electrical, detector, software and algorithm boundaries.
* Form hypotheses, design discriminating tests, analyze data rigorously and drive issues to a verified physical explanation and lasting fix.
* Act as the technical escalation point for problems other teams haven’t been able to explain.
* Plan and analyze reliability testing at the system and subsystem level, including accelerated life testing, stress testing and life-data analysis such as Weibull. Use physics-of-failure reasoning to explain degradation mechanisms in X-ray sources, detectors and electro-mechanical components, and to predict field performance.

**Design leadership and integration**

  

* Evaluate design trade-offs (for example, source and filter choices, detector technology, scan geometry, calibration strategy, component substitutions) and recommend options backed by data and physical reasoning.
* Work with detector, algorithm, mechanical, electrical and software engineers to integrate subsystems and make sure the whole system meets its performance targets.
* Assess the system impact of supplier changes, component end-of-life replacements and cost-reduction proposals on the installed base.
* Contribute physics-based input to risk analysis, verification strategy and regulatory submissions. Your role is to supply the technical substance; dedicated owners run those processes.

**Technical influence**

  

* Mentor engineers in physical reasoning, experimental design and data analysis.
* Share findings clearly with engineering, clinical, service, quality and leadership audiences.
* Contribute to the technology roadmap by identifying physics-driven chances to improve precision, lower dose, add clinical capability or reduce cost.

**Required qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in physics, engineering physics, medical physics or a closely related field
* 7+ years of experience in product development, R&D or applied physics, with progressively more technical responsibility
* Strong grounding in X-ray physics and radiation–matter interactions, plus practical experience with X-ray sources, detectors or radiation measurement
* A track record of solving complex, ambiguous technical problems through first-principles analysis, controlled experiments and careful data interpretation
* Strong statistical skills, including measurement uncertainty, precision and accuracy analysis, and design of experiments
* Clear written and spoken communication, including the ability to explain complex physics to non-specialists

**Desired characteristics**

  

* Master’s degree or PhD in physics, medical physics or a related field
* Experience with DXA, CT, radiography or other quantitative X-ray imaging modalities
* Experience with Monte Carlo radiation transport tools (for example, Geant4, MCNP, EGSnrc, PENELOPE)
* Hands-on proficiency with quantitative analysis and modeling tools such as MATLAB or Python (NumPy/SciPy)
* Familiarity with calibration methods, phantom design and quantitative imaging metrology
* Experience working on integrated hardware/software systems in a regulated medical device setting (FDA, IEC 60601, ISO 13485)
* Knowledge of radiation safety and dose optimization
* Curiosity, persistence, and comfort working at the edge of what’s known
* A bias toward the lab: when there’s a question, you’d rather measure it than debate it

**Additional information**

Work location: hybrid with on-site in Madison, WI. Position requires regular presence in engineering labs for system integration and test. Occasional domestic and international travel. Legal authorization to work in the country of employment is required.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

==========================

You’ll own the technical health and delivery commitments of the hardware organization and develop the engineers in it. You’ll also partner with software, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, sourcing and product management to deliver safe, reliable and differentiated products.

A small sample of what we work on: We ship the Microsoft Build of OpenJDK, the Microsoft Build of Go, work on OpenJDK and Go internals with upstream OSS partners, tune Java workloads at massive scale, enable millions of developers with our VS Code Python extensions, skills/plugins, and MCP servers, build insightful performance diagnostic tooling, and act as a liaison between Microsoft and the wider Java, Python and Go ecosystems.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of engineers. You’ll grow the team, set its technical direction with partners across Microsoft and the relevant OSS communities, and share our strong desire to make the work of our users and developers more productive, satisfying and enjoyable.

Day to day, you’ll stay close to the technology: reviewing designs and code, mentoring engineers, and working with customers inside and outside Microsoft, partner teams and a wide range of technologies. Our code is written in many languages, with C/C++, Java, Go, Shell, TypeScript, assembly and Python being the most common.

AI-first engineering is part of how CoreAI works. You’ll model the responsible use of AI tools across the development lifecycle, and help the team apply human judgment to, and take ownership of, the requirements, designs and code those tools help produce.

If you are interested in growing your career as an engineering leader, in a team where a healthy work/life balance and your own career path are core principles, there is no better place to do it!

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead, coach and grow a team of engineers in a collaborative, inclusive environment where everyone keeps learning and has a clear career path.
* Hire and onboard diverse talent, develop engineers through individual growth plans, and hold a consistent performance and quality bar across the team.
* Drive performance tuning and benchmarking for first-party customer workloads and industry benchmarks, using profiling data, telemetry and customer feedback to decide where to invest.
* Take learnings from first-party customer workloads to bring into products that also serve third-party customers.
* Set clear priorities and technical direction with product management, partner teams across CoreAI and Azure, and the relevant OSS community, weighing quick wins against longer-term platform investments.
* Guide the team in applying AI-assisted engineering best practices across design, coding, testing and performance analysis, while keeping a high bar in code reviews.
* Experiment with AI tools and practices that make the team faster and our software better, measure their impact, and share what works across the organization.
* Work in the open with the OSS language communities and other vendors to upstream improvements and represent Microsoft’s needs in those ecosystems.
* Keep leadership and partner teams informed of plans, progress and risks, and help develop the next generation of engineering leaders.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualififcations**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience managing an engineering team, including hiring and coaching
* 3+ years of experience working in the OpenJDK project
* Experience leading teams that build and ship platforms or runtimes used at very large scale
* 3+ years of experience with language design, compilers, managed runtimes, or OS internals
* Demonstrates knowledge of low-level programming concepts, including memory management, the hardware/software interface, and concurrency
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, with a clear sense of where they help and where human judgment is still needed
* Familiarity with large language models and AI agents, and how they can be applied to compiler, runtime and performance engineering work
* Demonstrates excellent judgment and problem solving, and makes data-driven decisions using benchmarks, telemetry and customer feedback
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with partner teams and open-source communities

  
  
  

Software Engineering M5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $142,800 - $274,800 per year. jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking a talented **Mid-Level Systems Engineer** to join our Federal Strategic Cyber program supporting a federal law enforcement customer in Washington, DC.

  

**Location: Washington, DC | On-site**

  

**Position Overview**

  

We are seeking a Mid-Level Systems Engineer to support the design, implementation, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise IT infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate will possess experience administering complex network and server environments, troubleshooting system and communication issues, and supporting virtualization, storage, backup, and operating system technologies. This role will work closely with technical teams and government stakeholders to ensure stable, secure, and high-performing infrastructure supporting mission-critical operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain network hardware, server infrastructure, operating systems, and associated technologies.
* Evaluate, configure, test, and deploy new hardware and software solutions.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and utilization to ensure optimal operations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve network, server, storage, backup, and communication issues at both the physical and logical layers.
* Support network infrastructure utilizing standard communication protocols including TCP/IP.
* Participate in architecture planning, technical reviews, and implementation of network and systems infrastructure upgrades.
* Administer and support virtualization technologies and enterprise infrastructure environments.
* Perform systems integration and systems management activities across multiple technology platforms.
* Design, deploy, evaluate, test, certify, and maintain storage and backup solutions and related components.
* Apply approved security patches and updates to maintain compliance and system security.

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), technical documentation, and user reference guides.
* Provide technical consultation, training, and support to system administrators, engineers, and end users.
* Advise management on infrastructure strategy, technology investments, and future-state architecture planning.
* Support database, processing, storage, and application infrastructure decisions that align with organizational objectives.

#CMAS

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

* Experience administering Windows and/or Linux server environments.
* Experience supporting network infrastructure, operating systems, storage, and backup technologies.
* Knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and services including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, and switching.
* Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and communication issues in complex enterprise environments.
* Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to operate independently while supporting multiple complex assignments.
* U.S. citizenship required.
* A current Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility and the ability to obtain a polygraph.
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting federal government, DoD, or intelligence community programs.
* Experience supporting cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or hybrid architectures.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, system hardening, vulnerability management, and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting storage area networks (SAN), backup solutions, and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Familiarity with system accreditation and RMF processes.
* Industry certifications such as Security+, Network+, VMware VCP, Microsoft, Cisco, AWS, Azure, or related certifications.
* Experience developing infrastructure roadmaps and enterprise architecture recommendations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code. They build the systems that power AI-driven workflows at massive scale, enabling customers to uncover insights and act on complex data with confidence.

aiR Services Team

The aiR Services team builds the shared backend platform that powers Relativity’s generative AI products. These systems enable secure and scalable access to foundation models across the aiR Suite while handling challenges such as limited model capacity, global data privacy requirements, and fair usage across products and customers. The team works on high-throughput, distributed systems that route AI traffic across regions and providers, protect downstream services from reliability risks, and optimize cost and performance at scale.

If you’re excited about building platforms that power an entire product suite, working with generative AI systems in production, and solving distributed systems challenges at global scale, this is a high-impact team to join.

Job Description And Requirements

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you will build and operate backend services that power Relativity’s generative AI platform, aiR. You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, helping to deliver reliable, scalable systems that sit on the critical path of AI-powered workflows.

This role reports to the Manager of Software Engineering and provides the opportunity to work on multi-region, multi-cloud systems that handle large-scale AI traffic and complex orchestration challenges.

What You’ll Do

Design and build performant, scalable, and secure backend services with a strong focus on quality, not just meeting requirements
Collaborate with a software development team to deliver high-quality, reliable systems that operate at massive scale
Develop and maintain systems that support high-throughput AI workloads, including asynchronous job orchestration and distributed processing
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests supported by static analysis and thoughtful test strategy development
Contribute to improving engineering processes by recommending enhancements to tools, workflows, and practices
Participate in pair programming to improve software quality and share design and implementation knowledge
Contribute to building systems that route and manage AI traffic efficiently while maintaining reliability and fairness across workloads

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience building backend services using languages such as C#, Python, or similar
Understanding of software engineering disciplines and the ability to work across multiple layers of the application stack
Strong foundational knowledge of distributed systems, scalability, and backend service design

Preferred

Understanding of DevOps principles and experience with tools such as GitHub Actions
Experience working with large language model (LLM) APIs or generative AI systems
Experience designing and building scalable systems in Azure or other cloud platforms
Experience with Kubernetes, serverless technologies, and cloud-native architectures
Familiarity with domain-driven design and event-driven architecture
Experience with AI-driven development practices or AI-assisted coding tools
Awareness of emerging technology trends and their practical application in engineering

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful AI Platform

Build foundational systems that power Relativity’s generative AI capabilities and enable products across the aiR Suite.

Distributed Systems at Scale

Work on high-throughput, multi-region services that handle large volumes of AI traffic reliably and efficiently.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Gain hands-on experience with generative AI systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and modern distributed architectures.

Growth Opportunity

Develop deep expertise in backend systems, cloud platforms, and AI-driven services while working on highly visible, impactful projects.

Collaborative Culture

Work with a team that values strong engineering fundamentals, shared ownership, and continuous learning.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, company-wide breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

$79,000 and $119,000

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Documentations, Engineering Design, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Project Management, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, System Integration, Troubleshooting

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Software Development

Who We Are

Helsing develops artificial intelligence enabled capabilities to protect and defend democracies. We are growing our US operations, cultivating an ambitious and committed team of mission driven professionals to apply their skills to solve challenging problems.

The role

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to the development of a next generation loitering munition system for the U.S. Army. Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will support the development, integration and verification of complex defense systems, helping translate customer requirements into practical engineering solutions.

You will work alongside Senior and Lead Systems Engineers, supporting activities across the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements development, system documentation, interface management, integration and test.

Your work will span the All Up Round (AUR), Fire Control System (FCS), and their integration into the Infantry Brigade Combat Team (IBCT) force structure. You will collaborate with hardware, software, mechanical, electrical and safety engineering teams to ensure individual components and subsystems work together as part of a fully integrated system.

This is an opportunity for an engineer with a strong technical foundation and an interest in complex defense systems to take ownership of meaningful engineering deliverables, develop their systems engineering expertise and contribute directly to the delivery of operational military capability.

The day-to-day

Support the development, documentation and management of system and subsystem requirements.
Assist with translating customer and stakeholder needs into clear, measurable and verifiable engineering requirements.
Maintain requirements traceability, ensuring requirements are appropriately allocated to subsystems and linked to verification activities.
Develop and maintain systems engineering documentation, including specifications, interface documentation, engineering reports and verification records.
Support system architecture development and interface definition across hardware, software and mechanical subsystems.
Work with multidisciplinary engineering teams to support system integration and resolve technical issues.
Assist with integration, verification and validation activities to demonstrate system compliance against defined requirements.
Support the preparation and execution of system level testing, including laboratory integration and hardware-in-the-loop activities.
Analyse test results, document findings and support the investigation and resolution of engineering issues.
Participate in technical design reviews, including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and Critical Design Review (CDR).
Support configuration management, technical baseline documentation and engineering change processes.
Work with Senior and Lead Systems Engineers to identify technical risks, dependencies and potential design improvements.
Support the development of engineering solutions that meet system safety, reliability, maintainability and performance requirements.

Hold a university degree in systems engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline.
Have approximately 3–5 years of engineering experience, ideally within systems engineering, defense, aerospace, advanced manufacturing or complex hardware development.
Have a foundational understanding of systems engineering principles and the systems development lifecycle.
Have experience or exposure to requirements development, technical documentation, system specifications or engineering change management.
Understand the importance of requirements traceability, interface management and configuration control.
Have an interest in system integration, verification and validation, and the testing of complex engineering systems.
Are comfortable working across multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicating technical information clearly.
Demonstrate strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate technical issues and work towards practical solutions.
Are organised, detail oriented and able to manage multiple engineering tasks.
Are motivated to take ownership of engineering deliverables and develop your technical capabilities within a growing engineering organisation.
Are a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Are willing to travel to government test facilities and vendor or partner sites as required.

Nice to have

Previous experience supporting defense, aerospace, military platform, munition or unmanned aircraft development programmes.
Familiarity with requirements management and systems engineering tools.
Exposure to Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), SysML or Cameo MagicDraw.
Familiarity with MIL-HDBK-516C, MIL-STD-882E, SAE ARP-4754A, ARP-4761, DO-178C or DO-254.
Exposure to system integration, hardware in the loop testing or verification and validation campaigns.
Understanding of system safety, reliability and airworthiness principles.
Familiarity with Army tactical networks, ATAK, UVC standards or Common Control concepts for uncrewed systems.
Exposure to configuration management and technical baseline control.
Able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation. The defense industry is entering an exciting phase of technological development, and Helsing is part of that progress.

We actively encourage healthy, proactive and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted and encouraged to practice responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity.

A generous compensation and benefits package (in addition to base salary) that includes, but may not be limited to, insurance coverage (medical and travel), flexible paid time off, paid holidays, and remote and/or hybrid work available depending on position.

jobs.description:
TL;DR
– We’re looking for Staff Software Engineers to join the team and build Lovable for our Enterprise customers. Your time will be split between customer engagements and building our core product. Up to 40% of your time could be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers to solve their hardest technical problems. The rest you’ll spend back in the product team, building what you’ve learned in the field into the Lovable platform. It’s a unique opportunity to work on both sides of enterprise software and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

About The Role

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You'll build the parts of Lovable that Enterprise level companies depend on: security, governance, admin controls, integrations with their existing systems, and performance at scale.

Up to 40% of your time you’ll be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers on their hardest technical problems. The rest of the time you’ll be back in the product team, building what the field showed you. The aim of every rotation is to turn what one customer needs into something every customer can use.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on, close to both real customer problems and the product that solves them, this is that role. Forward Deployed rotations may involve travel to customer sites.

What You’ll Do

Build and ship core enterprise capabilities across Lovable’s frontend, backend and AI systems, and operate them in production
Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems
Spend up-to 40% of your time forward deployed with enterprise customers, solving their hardest technical problems
Turn what you learned in the field into foundational platform improvements
Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams.
Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration
Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries
Shape how the Enterprise team runs its field rotations, including engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks
Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

What We’re Looking For

8+ years experience building, shipping and maintaining production-grade software
Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including robust backend (Go, Rust) development and React and TypeScript on the frontend
You have worked directly with customers, and have the product sense to tell a one-off request from something every customer needs
Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
Experience building for enterprise requirements such as SSO, role-based access control, audit logging, data residency or compliance
Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions

Bonus if you’ve:

Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before
Led zero-to-one product development
Worked in a forward deployed, solutions, or partner engineering role
Worked in a founding or early startup environment

Our Tech Stack

Backend: Golang & Rust
Frontend: React, Typescript
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers
Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more

How We Hire

Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team.
Complete a quick live coding exercise.
Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud.

About Your Application

Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

Job details:

A bit about us:

We are a global media, technology, and information services organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses and a strong commitment to innovation. Our technology teams support a complex, enterprise-scale environment, leveraging modern infrastructure, cloud technologies, security platforms, and automation to improve how our businesses operate.

We are continuously investing in technology modernization, operational efficiency, and emerging capabilities, including AI-driven automation. Our teams work collaboratively across engineering, infrastructure, and cybersecurity to solve meaningful technical challenges and develop scalable, long-term solutions.

Why join us?

Fully Remote Opportunity: Work remotely from anywhere within the United States while collaborating with experienced engineering and security teams.

High-Impact Project: Take ownership of complex endpoint engineering challenges and deliver measurable improvements across an enterprise environment.

Modern Technology Stack: Work with Microsoft Intune, Iru/Kandji, CrowdStrike, Tenable, and enterprise automation technologies.

Automation-Focused Engineering: Build scalable solutions that eliminate recurring issues and reduce manual intervention.

Innovation & AI: Leverage scripting, APIs, data analytics, and AI-assisted engineering to improve endpoint management and security operations.

Ownership & Autonomy: Drive technical solutions from root-cause analysis through implementation, with the opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Job Details

We are seeking an experienced Senior Endpoint Automation Engineer for a six-month contract engagement focused on improving endpoint management health, vulnerability patching, and operational automation across enterprise Windows and macOS environments.

This is a highly hands-on engineering position designed to address persistent operational challenges through root-cause analysis, advanced scripting, data correlation, and automated remediation.

The successful candidate will work across Microsoft Intune, Iru/Kandji, Tenable, CrowdStrike, and related platforms to identify why endpoints fall out of management, diagnose patching failures, reconcile inconsistent compliance data, and implement automated solutions that prevent issues from recurring.

This is not a traditional endpoint administration, support, or architecture role. We are looking for an engineer who can investigate complex issues, build effective automation, and deliver measurable operational improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Management & Device Health

Investigate Windows and macOS devices that stop communicating with endpoint management platforms.

Establish automated monitoring to identify endpoints that fail to check in within defined timeframes.

Diagnose root causes involving agent health, connectivity, identity, certificates, configuration, and device state.

Develop automated workflows to identify, classify, and remediate inactive or noncompliant devices.

Automate the identification and removal of retired devices across MDM, directory, identity, and security platforms.

Improve endpoint inventory accuracy and eliminate stale or conflicting device records.

Patching & Vulnerability Management

Investigate operating system and application patching failures across Windows and macOS environments.

Identify and resolve the underlying causes of devices remaining unpatched beyond established SLAs.

Correlate data across Microsoft Intune, Iru/Kandji, Tenable, CrowdStrike, and inventory platforms to validate patch compliance.

Investigate discrepancies between endpoint management, security, and vulnerability reporting systems.

Build automated remediation, monitoring, and escalation workflows for patching failures.

Establish reliable compliance reporting that accurately reflects endpoint security and vulnerability exposure.

Automation & Process Improvement

Design, develop, and implement scalable automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, and existing enterprise tooling.

Replace repetitive manual processes with reliable, repeatable workflows.

Automate endpoint cleanup, agent remediation, patch troubleshooting, and compliance reporting.

Develop scripts and integrations to identify recurring issues and initiate corrective action.

Incorporate appropriate error handling, logging, validation, and exception management into automated workflows.

Document automated solutions and transfer knowledge to permanent engineering teams.

Data Analysis & AI-Assisted Engineering

Analyze large datasets from endpoint management, security, vulnerability, and ITSM platforms.

Correlate information across multiple systems to identify technical patterns and systemic failures.

Validate data accuracy rather than relying solely on existing dashboards or platform reporting.

Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools for investigation, scripting, analysis, and workflow development.

Ensure AI-generated solutions are technically validated and aligned with organizational security requirements.

Develop meaningful metrics and reporting to demonstrate improvements in endpoint health, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

Strong enterprise-level endpoint engineering experience across Windows and macOS environments.

Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune.

Experience with Iru/Kandji, Jamf Pro, or comparable macOS management platforms.

Experience with Tenable, CrowdStrike, or similar vulnerability management and endpoint security tools.

Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash.

Demonstrated experience working with APIs and integrating data across multiple enterprise platforms.

Strong understanding of endpoint patch management, vulnerability remediation, and device compliance.

Experience troubleshooting endpoint agent failures, device communication issues, and inconsistent inventory records.

Proven ability to develop automated remediation workflows rather than relying on manual endpoint administration.

Experience analyzing and reconciling large, complex datasets from multiple management and security platforms.

Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to improve engineering, automation, and analysis workflows.

Excellent root-cause analysis, technical troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to independently own technical challenges from initial investigation through implementation and measurable resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing automated device lifecycle management and decommissioning processes.

Experience integrating endpoint management, vulnerability management, identity, and security tooling.

Familiarity with enterprise ITSM platforms and automated incident or remediation workflows.

Experience building operational dashboards, compliance reporting, and automated exception management.

Relevant Microsoft, Apple, endpoint management, security, or automation certifications.

What Success Looks Like

By the end of the engagement, the successful candidate will have delivered measurable improvements in three key areas:

1. Reliable Endpoint Visibility

Endpoints consistently check in within defined management windows.

Devices that fail to check in are automatically identified and classified by root cause.

Retired devices are automatically removed from relevant management, identity, and security platforms.

Stale records and unexplained device management gaps are eliminated or substantially reduced.

2. Accurate Patch Compliance

Patching failures are investigated and corrected at the root cause.

Conflicting data across endpoint management, vulnerability, and security platforms is reconciled.

Compliance reporting accurately reflects defined SLAs and provides leadership with reliable metrics.

Devices exceeding remediation deadlines are automatically identified and routed for corrective action.

3. Sustainable Automation

Repetitive cleanup, remediation, and reporting activities are automated.

Common agent failures, stale records, and patching issues are addressed through reusable workflows.

Manual intervention is limited to genuine exceptions.

Permanent engineering teams inherit documented, maintainable solutions that significantly reduce ongoing operational effort.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a hands-on endpoint engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and eliminating them through automation. You don't simply report what a dashboard says. You investigate the underlying data, identify why something is failing, and develop solutions that prevent it from happening again.

You are equally comfortable troubleshooting Windows and macOS management issues, writing scripts, integrating APIs, and validating information across multiple security and management platforms.

Most importantly, you are a builder and problem solver who measures success by the issues permanently resolved and the manual work eliminated.

for heavy industry: combining agentic AI with rigorous data architecture and deterministic guardrails to bridge the gap between raw telemetry and high-level economic, operational, and energy optimization. Our systems operate in domains like refining, petrochemicals, metals, and building materials – environments governed by physical laws, hard constraints, and real safety and economic consequences.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer
to lead the future of our reasoning platform. This role is for someone who sees LLMs and agents not as chat interfaces, but as building blocks of a non-deterministic reasoning layer that must operate safely within deterministic operational constraints. This is not a prompt-engineering role, nor a model research role. It is a systems engineering role
at the intersection of AI, data, and industrial reality.

The Technical Mission

You will be responsible for the capability, scalability, and architectural integrity
of our reasoning platform. Core challenges include:

Hybrid Reasoning Architectures: Designing systems that combine LLM-based planning and agents with symbolic logic, structured data models, optimization techniques (regression, LP/MIP), and physics-based simulation (thermodynamics, kinetics).
Deterministic Guardrails for Non-Deterministic Agents: Building validation, constraint-checking, and middleware layers that ensure agent-generated analyses and plans are safe, feasible, and compliant with real-world operating constraints.
Continuous & Proactive Reasoning: Enabling reasoning to run continuously over high-volume telemetry streams to detect issues and opportunities early—while managing compute cost, latency, and token budgets.
High-Throughput Telemetry Integration: Architecting data pipelines that ingest, normalize, and contextualize high-frequency sensor data so it can be reliably understood and consumed by agentic systems.
AI-Native Tooling & Productivity: Leading by example in using agentic developer tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to maintain high velocity without sacrificing clarity, testability, or architectural discipline.
The Technical Requirements
Strong Technical Fundamentals: We build in Python (Pydantic, FastAPI, Pandas, asyncio), but what matters most is how you think—your ability to reason through complex systems problems, craft elegant solutions, balance velocity and debt, and pick up new tools quickly. Deep Python expertise is a plus, not a prerequisite.
Agentic Systems Experience: Proven experience building multi-agent or agent-orchestrated systems – whether via frameworks like LangGraph or custom state machines – that involve long-running tasks, tool invocation, feedback loops, and dynamic replanning.
Distributed Systems Judgment: You are a systems thinker. You can reason clearly about service boundaries, APIs, caching, failure modes, schema evolution, and consistency tradeoffs. You are comfortable making – and defending – calls like GraphQL vs. gRPC, when to centralize vs. federate, and where eventual consistency is acceptable.
Industrial Domain Empathy: This is not consumer software. You don't need prior industrial experience, but you should be energized (not intimidated) by the fact that your code operates alongside physical processes with real safety and economic stakes, and that a factory cannot simply "reboot" if your code fails. We value pragmatic engineering judgment over formal perfection.
Principal-Level Ownership: You are comfortable setting architectural direction, being the tie-breaker on hard decisions, and mentoring engineers through complex design tradeoffs.
Our Culture: High-Sync / High-Trust / AI-Native
High-Sync: We work remote-first, favoring fast feedback loops, focused technical discussions, and clear written communication—not meeting sprawl.
High-Trust: No micro-management. We hire seniors because we trust your judgment on architecture, tech debt, and when to "build vs. buy."
AI-Native: We don't just build AI; we use it. You will be encouraged to automate busywork so you can focus on the hard, high-leverage engineering problems.
Who This Role Is Not For

Role

This role will be deeply satisfying for the right person—and frustrating for the wrong one. You probably should not apply if:

You are primarily interested in prompt engineering or chat UIs. This role is about building the systems behind agentic reasoning: orchestration, validation, data flow, and constraints—not crafting chat experiences.
You want to focus on model training or LLM research. We use frontier models as components. We do not train foundation models or publish model architecture research.
You prefer greenfield prototypes over long-lived systems. This role involves owning production systems that must evolve safely over time, with backwards compatibility, observability, and operational discipline.
You expect fast iteration without accountability. We move quickly – but our systems influence real operations. Designs must be defensible, failure modes understood, and guardrails explicit.
You aren't comfortable with Principal-level ownership. This role requires making hard architectural calls, living with their consequences, and helping others reason through tradeoffs. You will shape the problem space, not just execute within it.
You rely on in-person proximity for effectiveness. Our team is remote-first, which means influence, clarity, and technical leadership are expressed through writing, async collaboration, and deliberate communication rather than hallway conversations.
How to Apply

Contact Aaron Brown (CTO & Co-founder) at aaron@archimetis.ai

Bonus:
If you have a GitHub or a technical write-up detailing a complex system you've built, please share it. We care more about what you've built than where you've worked or studied.

Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come.
