We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, to help us fulfill that mission.

The Senior Software Engineer
applies advanced knowledge, skill, and expertise to software delivery. Work is both independent and collaborative in nature. This role emphasizes using AI coding tools to develop software efficiently, while owning the judgment calls AI can't make, including reviewing, testing, and correcting AI-generated work, and taking end-to-end ownership of delivery from specification through production. Beyond using AI tools well, this role is expected to actively drive how the team adopts new AI-assisted development practices by piloting new tools and techniques, and championing what actually works. This is primarily a hands-on senior engineering role within the team, with the opportunity to grow into a cross-team responsibility for advancing how the broader engineering organization uses AI-assisted development tools as the role matures.

The finalist will be hired at the salary and level commensurate with their qualifications. For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary between $110,000 and $135,000

Location:
This is a remote position, based in the United States.

Visa:
Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship.

What You Will Be Working On

Technical Leadership & Complex Problem-Solving
Solve complex technical problems across the team's core systems, using AI-assisted approaches to move faster, including integrations with related platforms.
Contribute senior-level technical judgment to active modernization initiatives within the team, using AI tools to accelerate legacy-to-modern platform migrations.

AI Tooling Strategy & Adoption
Pilot new AI-assisted development tools, models, and techniques within the team (e.g., new agentic coding workflows, MCP integrations, updated model versions), evaluating them against real delivery work rather than vendor claims.
Propose and champion new use cases for AI in the team's engineering practice, backed by a measured before/after comparison — time saved, defect rate, or review burden.
Feed adoption learnings back into team practice, updating norms, playbooks, or tooling recommendations as new approaches prove out (or don't).

Deep Domain Knowledge
Apply deep familiarity with the team's platform architecture, history, and constraints to guide technical decisions, including where AI-assisted approaches can speed modernization work.

AI-Directed Development & Delivery Ownership
Direct AI coding tools and agents to implement features from specs, tickets, or requirements, and own end-to-end delivery of the feature from specification through production.
Review, test, and correct AI-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit; catch both subtle errors (a plausible-but-wrong calculation, an approach that won't scale) and obvious ones.
Act as a steward against AI-specific security and supply-chain risk, scrutinizing AI-suggested dependencies, flagging unfamiliar or unverified packages before they're accepted, and treating AI-generated code that touches auth, data access, or external integrations with elevated review.
Write specs detailed enough for an AI tool to implement correctly on the first or second pass; for ambiguous problems, exercise judgment on whether to escalate or proceed independently.
Maintain and extend the team's eval and guardrail practices that catch AI-introduced regressions before they reach production.

Analysis, Recommendations & Autonomy
Independently evaluate where AI-assisted development tools, primarily Claude Code, alongside comparable tools as needed, add genuine value, for example, scaffolding and legacy code comprehension, while applying extra human scrutiny to auth-adjacent or compliance-sensitive logic.
Recommend and refine engineering practices with a high degree of autonomy, guided by high-level direction and using independent judgment to accomplish goals.

Acts as a Resource for Colleagues
Proactively share and teach AI-assisted development practices with the team (code review norms, prompt approaches, and verification habits for AI-generated output)with the opportunity to extend this to other engineering teams as the role grows.
Operate as an individual-contributor role, building credibility and driving adoption of good practice through technical expertise and collaboration.

Program & Initiative Leadership (Growth Path)
As the role matures, lead or contribute to a cross-team initiative establishing shared, practical standards for responsible AI tool usage in engineering, including guidance on what's safe to share with external AI tools, and when AI-generated code warrants elevated review.
Participate in the engineering support rotation per the team's standard model.

Role Progression

The following outlines key milestones and expectations for the first year in this role.

3-Month Mark

Completed onboarding on the team's platform architecture and AI tooling conventions; has shipped a few small features or fixes through AI-directed development, with work reviewed and merged at the team's normal quality bar.
Is closely working with other team members to understand production issues and system configurations, and has demonstrated at least one concrete instance of catching an AI-generated error or gap before it shipped.

6-Month Mark

Owns a feature or workstream end-to-end — writing the spec, directing AI-assisted implementation, and handling review and testing — with minimal day-to-day oversight from the lead.
Has contributed a concrete improvement to the team's AI-assisted development practice (a new guardrail, a refined spec template, a prompt pattern) that at least one other engineer has adopted.
Demonstrates a working understanding of the end-to-end architecture of the platforms they support, including how those platforms integrate with other systems across the broader technology ecosystem, and the underlying infrastructure architecture beneath them.

12-Month Mark

Has led a modernization effort or comparable initiative to completion, with AI-directed development visibly accelerating delivery versus a traditional approach.
Is beginning to extend influence beyond the team, if the opportunity has arisen — through early contributions to the cross-team AI standards initiative, informal mentoring, or a guardrail others have started using.

Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible software engineering experience.
Engineering Fundamentals

Data modeling and query performance reasoning, across relational and/or schema-driven data layers.
API design fundamentals: contracts, versioning, and backward compatibility, whether REST or schema-first (e.g., GraphQL).
Security fundamentals: authentication/authorization flows, common injection classes, and dependency risk.
Distributed systems fundamentals: failure modes, statelessness, and behavior under concurrent load.

Agentforce Operations is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end-to-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email. Super Agent

Deep experience implementing or operating enterprise-grade bot management platforms (e.g., HUMAN, AWS Bot Control, Cloudflare Bot Management, Akamai Bot Manager).
Advanced knowledge of HTTP protocol, CDN caching strategies, edge compute functions (e.g., Lambda@Edge), and TLS management.
Strong software development experience in a modern language (e.g., Python, Go, TypeScript, Java).
Track record of building safe, observable, and performant infrastructure at scale.

Experience authoring real-time request evaluation logic at the edge.
Familiarity with HTTP/2, QUIC, and emerging transport protocols for low-latency content delivery.

Experience supporting traffic segmentation, geo-steering, or multi-CDN architecture.

Proficiency in building distributed rate-limiting or request scoring systems.
Familiarity with principles of secure system design and zero-trust architectures.
Contributions to open-source projects in the edge, networking, or observability space.

jobs.description:
Description

The Field Control Systems Engineer provides mechatronics support for Amazon's warehouse automation and material handling equipment, covering the electrical, controls, and mechanical layers. This role focuses on diagnosing and resolving electrical and controls faults, replacing and configuring devices, working with PLC logic and HMIs, interpreting system metrics, and performing IO checks, with hands-on support across both mechanical and electrical systems. The role is a systems-level technical resource supporting commissioning, go-lives, and remote and on-site troubleshooting.

Key job responsibilities

Diagnose and resolve electrical and controls faults across MHE (conveyors, sortation, vertical lifts).

Perform electrical changes and replace controls devices: MDR cards, sensors, scanners, drives, and IO modules.

Configure and parameterize devices (device configuration, drive parameters, network addressing).

Work with PLC logic: read, interpret, and make minor/mid-complexity logic changes, I/O, and config files.

Configure, develop, and troubleshoot HMIs; support operators with HMI access and operation.

Interpret system metrics and logs to diagnose performance issues and identify root cause.

Support SCADA / visualization monitoring at a working level.

Lead and document RCAs on controls-related events through to resolution.

Provide remote and on-site support during commissioning, go-lives, and escalations.

Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation; meet First Engagement SLA (≤15 min).

A day in the life

This is a field-first role. Most weeks you're on-site at a deploying or live facility, boots on the floor supporting commissioning, go-lives, and break-fix. You run and verify IO checks, configure and replace devices (MDR cards, sensors, scanners, drives), and get hands-on with PLC logic and HMIs to isolate electrical, controls, and mechanical faults, working side by side with OEM and RME teams. You drive high-sev events to recovery on the spot and lead the RCA to closure so the fix becomes a repeatable standard. Expect heavy travel, especially during onboarding, training, and site ramp-ups.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent

jobs.title: Senior Officer, AI Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Organizational Context

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian network, with 191 member National Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. IFRC uses the Triple R – response, resilience and respect – to deliver on Strategy 2030. IFRC responds to disasters and crises, ensuring timely, coordinated and locally led humanitarian action. IFRC supports its members in building community resilience in the areas of climate and environment, health and wellbeing, and migration and displacement. IFRC promotes respect for our fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality, including in our work on values, power and inclusion. The IFRC focuses throughout on our core mandate – our raison d’être – of strategic and operational coordination, humanitarian diplomacy, National Society development, and accountability.

IFRC is led by its Secretary General and has its Headquarters in Geneva and five regional offices in Africa (Nairobi); the Americas (Panama); Asia Pacific (Kuala Lumpur); Europe (Budapest); and MENA (Beirut) as well as representation offices, service centres and delegations across the globe.

IFRC is led by its Secretary General, and has its Headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. IFRC has five regional offices in Africa, Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and the Americas. IFRC also has country cluster delegations and country delegations throughout the world. Together, the Geneva Headquarters and the field structure (regional, cluster and country) comprise the IFRC Secretariat.

IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles.

Background to the position

In virtually all countries, people increasingly rely on and expect a diverse range of digital services (e.g., through their mobile devices) to interact with local government, companies, and community organizations and services. This disruption is already happening to humanitarian assistance. Yet, the Digital Divide remains a persistent and significant challenge at both national and local levels.

The need for a successful and large-scale digital transformation is urgent. And Digitally Transforming the IFRC and its 191 members is a complex process which requires collaborative action and support across the membership. Therefore, the IFRC recently developed a Digital Transformation Strategy which was approved by the IFRC Governing Board in May 2021.  

The Digital Transformation Department (DTD) has full leadership responsibility for the implementation of the digital transformation strategy and the positive impact it will have on the 191 National Society members of the IFRC. The DTD provides strategic leadership and guides the IFRC Secretariat as well as the members network to adapt and innovate humanitarian services, drawing on digital services, data-enabled decision-making, and other opportunities for digital transformation in support of the IFRC’s Strategy 2030. In addition, the DTD is responsible for the development and implementation of business transformation, information technology and digitalization services throughout the IFRC Secretariat, thereby supporting the same transformation in 191 NSs, setting the vision, and drawing stakeholders together on this digital journey. 

Job Purpose

The incumbent reports to the AI and Data management unit (“AI & Data unit”), that is accountable to the Director of the DTD. The other units and teams reporting to the DT Director include the Enterprise Architecture, Strategy & Planning unit, the Digital development and management unit, the Infrastructure & Security Team and the Global Service Desk and Endpoint Management team. Under the leadership of the Director, these units and teams serve as members of the global DTD management team, along with the CISO and Regional DT managers.

The AI & Data unit is responsible to deliver greater value from IFRC’s data, and ensures the development and implementation of IFRCs data and AI governance and strategy, in close collaboration with the IFRC’s Data Protection Office and through indirect management of data professionals in other departments. The unit oversees all data operations, data product lifecycles and manages the organisation’s data platform, as well as the coordination and support to AI initiatives.

The Senior Officer, AI Platform Engineering will also interact with internal and external AI and data experts, private sector, academia, external suppliers, vendors and consultants who are sourced to deliver AI-related activities.

Job Purpose

The Senior Officer, AI Platform Engineering builds and runs the shared platform that IFRC teams use to create AI solutions on Microsoft technologies. The role provisions and operates Azure AI services, supports colleagues who build agents in Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot, and makes it easy for teams to build AI that is secure, compliant and affordable.

The role puts into practice the IFRC security and governance standards, and works closely with developers, data protection colleagues and IT operations across the Secretariat.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Azure AI Platform Operations
Operate and maintain IFRC's Microsoft-based AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI and related Azure services, Copilot Studio and Power Platform) across development, testing and production environments.
Configure and maintain platform components and integrations to support the deployment and operation of AI applications and services.
Develop and maintain version-controlled infrastructure-as-code templates for AI platform resources, automate environment provisioning and identify and remediate configuration drift against approved baselines.
Manage model deployments, quotas and capacity, and track model retirements so that applications keep working when models are updated or withdrawn.
Ensure proper life-cycle management of AI related services.
Monitor platform availability, performance, resource utilization and operational costs, identifying opportunities for optimization.
Maintain resource tagging and usage attribution by team or solution, configure budget and abnormal-consumption alerts, provide cost and capacity forecasts, and coordinate the removal or resizing of unused resources with their owners.
Operate the AI gateway in Azure API Management, including authentication, rate limits per team, load balancing, and usage logging.
Troubleshoot platform and deployment issues, investigate incidents and implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.
Support for developers and makers
Build and maintain reusable templates, reference architectures and code samples for common patterns, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agents built with Foundry Agent Service or the Microsoft Agent Framework.
Support colleagues building AI applications and agents in Azure AI Foundry, building agents in Copilot Studio and extending Microsoft 365 Copilot, including environment setup, connectors and publishing.
Build and maintain the pipelines that connect AI services to IFRC data in SharePoint, Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse and other sources.
Onboard new teams to the platform, answer their technical questions and keep its documentation clear and current.
Collaborates with the team in developing and providing to the organization trainings and learning materials related to AI with a focus on platform and security.

Job Duties And Responsibilities (continued)

AI Workload Operations and Security
Build, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for AI applications and related platform components, including version control, automated testing, deployment and release management.
Develop and apply established operational practices for managing AI workloads, including appropriate resource allocation and environment configuration.
Implement established security configurations and operational procedures for AI workloads.
Implement and maintain approved Azure Policy and network security guardrails for AI services, including permitted deployment regions, private connectivity, restrictions on public access and approved authentication methods; monitor compliance and track exceptions through the agreed review process.
Monitor relevant Azure security alerts and recommendations affecting AI workloads (e.g. Defender for Cloud) and coordinate follow-up actions.
Apply established identity and access management practices for applications and workloads, including secure credential and secrets management using Azure Key Vault and Microsoft Entra ID.
Prepare the technical evidence needed for the release review of AI agents and services, and put agreed controls in place before go-live.
Support the implementation of data protection and security controls for AI solutions, including relevant Microsoft Purview configurations.
Contribute to technical security assessments and incident investigations related to AI workloads.
Configure Power Platform environments and data loss prevention (DLP) policies for Copilot Studio.
Documentation and Collaboration
Maintain technical documentation of Azure AI platforms and solutions, including deployment configurations, integrations, dependencies, operational procedures, data sources and data flows.
Collaborate with AI developers, data professionals and other technical stakeholders to ensure the reliable deployment and operation of AI solutions.
Ensure that AI platforms and workloads align with IFRC's infrastructure, security and operational standards.
Act as the first technical point of contact for operational questions and issues related to Azure AI platforms and deployed solutions.
Stay up to date with developments in Azure cloud technologies, platform engineering, DevOps and AI operations, and identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, automation, performance, cost efficiency and existing processes.

Duties applicable to all staff

Experience

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Compute
jobs.description:
About Nominal

Engineers today are building some of the most ambitious machines humanity has ever seen. They should have AI that’s purpose-built for them.

Nominal is building the Hardware Intelligence Platform that gives engineers increased visibility into complex physical systems, helps them make better decisions, and ultimately gets their products into the real world faster. It brings together the systems, data, intelligence, and applications hardware engineering requires to meet the AI moment. Hardware engineering teams use Nominal to simulate, test, manufacture, and operate the physical systems that keep the world moving, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation energy systems and robotics.

Our customers span aerospace, defense, manufacturing, transportation, energy, and robotics. They include Anduril, Shield AI, Wisk Aero, Pratt Miller Motorsports, Antares, and Shinkei Systems, amongst others, alongside programs within the U.S. Air Force and Navy. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, Tesla, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software.

Some of the world’s leading technology investors, including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Lux Capital, and Insight Partners, are backing Nominal’s ambition to change how machines are built and operated. We’re looking for engineers who want to take on hard problems and help make a new generation of world-changing hardware possible.

Join Nominal as a Full Stack Software Engineer, Compute

At Nominal, the frontend goes far beyond a visual layer on top of APIs. It's where thousands of high-frequency data sources are streamed and drawn on screen in time for an engineer to decide whether to continue, pause, or abort tests running against real hardware. Our customers monitor mission-critical systems through Nominal, so the data has to be fast, correct, and trustworthy at every layer. Meeting that bar means balancing raw performance with an experience engineers can depend on and understand, so they can build trust in the platform.

We're looking for product engineers who care about high-scale data computation, runtime performance, and device constraints as much as building intuitive interfaces. You'll work at the intersection of product, design, and engineering to turn a highly expressive compute engine into the foundation that every visualization in Nominal depends on, from highly optimized time series charts to flexible user-defined custom visualizations. Success in this role is measured by building a data layer that stays fast, correct, and observable on whatever device and network our customers bring.

You'll partner closely with backend engineers, designers, and product teams to define workflows, shape product direction, and make thoughtful technical tradeoffs in an environment where requirements are often ambiguous and the best solutions aren't immediately obvious. You'll own the shared compute and data layer of the platform’s applications end to end. Your judgment will shape how live and historical data workflows feel across the whole product.

🚀 About the role

Build the data foundation every application stands on

Own the layer between Nominal's compute engine and the user: streaming over WebSockets, orchestrating web workers, handling columnar data formats, caching intelligently, and processing live and historical data on the client. You'll design generalized data and compute capabilities that serve today's product and the use cases we haven't met yet, so that new panels, new query types, and open-ended user-defined visualizations can be built quickly on the stability and guarantees already in place.

Make performance and correctness non-negotiable

Customers stream thousands of high-frequency series into live monitoring dashboards with low-latency expectations and zero tolerance for incorrect data. You'll squeeze everything possible out of varied user hardware, hunt memory leaks down to the allocation, benchmark and profile the render pipeline, and handle out-of-order, late, and missing data so the picture on screen converges on the truth.

Own ambiguous product problems

Partner closely with product, design, and engineering to turn loosely defined ideas into intuitive user experiences. You'll challenge assumptions, validate workflows directly with users, and make confident product decisions when requirements are incomplete.

Bring New Compute Capabilities To Users

Take new features from the compute layer and expose them in a composable, scalable form that end users can understand: new capabilities, aggregations, grouping mechanisms, and transforms that can power every application and workflow in the Nominal platform.

Make complexity feel simple

Design experiences that expose powerful capabilities without overwhelming users. You'll think deeply about information architecture, interaction design, and how technical users reason about their work.

Success in this role comes from combining strong frontend engineering with product judgment. You'll spend as much time thinking about how users reason about complex systems as you will writing React code.

🙌 We'd love to hear from you if you have

3+ years experience building products for technical users where you’ve been involved in the infrastructure behind demanding, data-heavy applications.
Strong experience with TypeScript, and modern frontend architecture, along with an understanding of how frontend systems interact with backend services.
Experience building high-throughput data applications in the browser, with hands-on use of web workers, WebSockets, columnar formats such as Apache Arrow, and canvas or WebGL/WebGPU rendering.
A deep understanding of the web as a runtime: memory allocation and garbage collection, message passing between threads, the performance characteristics of network transports, and how a rendering pipeline actually spends its frame budget.
Strong product instincts. You naturally ask "Why are we building this?" before "How should I implement it?" and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions when you believe there's a better solution for users.
A systems mindset. You enjoy reasoning about data models, user workflows, and how complex systems should behave before jumping into implementation.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical and product tradeoffs clearly across engineering, design, and product teams.

⚡ Skills that supercharge us

Browser Familiarity

A deep understanding of the browser as an environment for data-intensive applications: threading, networking, memory, and the rendering pipeline.

Streaming Real-time Data

Experience building interfaces over live data streams, and balancing the speed, correctness, and resilience they demand.

Performance Engineering

Experience with client-side memory management, benchmarking, profiling, and an obsession with delivering a fluid user experience.

Systems Thinking

Experience designing products around complex object models, relationships, and workflows rather than simple CRUD interfaces.

Product Thinking

Ability to understand user goals, simplify complicated workflows, and make thoughtful product decisions under ambiguity.

Frontend Architecture

Strong experience with React, TypeScript, modern state management, asynchronous data flows, and scalable application architecture.

Backend Collaboration

Comfort reasoning about APIs, data loading strategies, backend constraints, and making architectural tradeoffs across the full stack.

Performance Engineering

Experience optimizing rendering, managing large datasets, virtualized interfaces, streaming updates, caching strategies, and browser performance.

✨ Benefits/Perks

🏖️ Unlimited PTO and sick leave
🍽️ Free lunch, snacks, and coffee
🚀 Professional Development Stipend

✈️ Annual company retreat

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT MIND:**
---------------

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

**THE ROLE:**
-------------

At Mind Robotics, we're building generalized physical AI — robotic systems capable of dexterous, adaptive, reasoning-intensive and most importantly safe work in real-world industrial environments. Systems engineering is the discipline that holds it all together: translating mission requirements into hardware reality and ensuring every subsystem behaves as a coherent whole.

We're looking for a Systems Engineer to own the requirements and architecture baseline for the robot — from decomposing high-level behaviors into measurable, traceable specs, to making sure the system and its safety requirements hold together from concept through field deployment. You'll define how the robot is supposed to behave, how we prove it, and what "ready to ship" means, working alongside software, mechanical, electrical, and integration teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
---------------------

* Own the system requirements baseline: capture top-level robot behaviors and performance targets, and decompose them into measurable subsystem requirements, budgets, and interfaces, with traceability through to verification
* Define software requirements from high-level system requirements, using first-principles analysis and hardware/model-based testing
* Contribute to architectural decisions for new robot subsystems — communication protocols, control strategies, and hardware-software partitioning — alongside firmware/controls, mechanical, and electrical teams
* Own interface definitions across mechanical, electrical, firmware, controls, and software, and manage requirement and interface changes and their cross-subsystem impact
* Lead system-level failure mode and hazard analysis (DFMEA, HARA, FTA) together with subsystem owners, and derive, allocate, and trace the resulting safety requirements to subsystems and their verification
* Work cross-functionally to drive the verification and validation strategy: system-level test plans from bench testing through field deployment, acceptance criteria, and requirements coverage
* Work cross-functionally with subsystem owners to drive requirements and system-level coverage for on-robot diagnostics, telemetry, and health monitoring that support field deployment and service
* Drive readiness reviews, sign-off, and post-launch monitoring across firmware, hardware, controls, reliability, and manufacturing stakeholders
* Work with integration engineers to turn bench and field findings into requirement, interface, and design changes

**REQUIREMENTS:**
-----------------

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in systems engineering on complex electromechanical, robotic, or autonomous products, including at least one product taken through to field deployment
* Demonstrated experience writing, decomposing, and managing requirements — making high-level system behaviors measurable and testable, with traceability from requirement to design to verification
* Hands-on experience with hazard and risk analysis (DFMEA/FMEDA, HARA, FTA) and turning the results into requirements and test cases
* Working knowledge of functional safety standards and concepts (IEC 61508, ISO 13849, IEC 62061, ISO 26262, or similar)
* Strong hardware and software fundamentals — able to bridge electrical schematics, embedded communication protocols, and firmware architecture, and to debug system-level issues alongside integration and firmware engineers
* Proficient in data analysis and scripting — able to use hardware and field data to validate or challenge requirements
* Clear written and verbal communication — specs that mechanical, electrical, and firmware teams can all build and test against
* You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast, and have an "engineering curiosity" that drives you to understand how the entire system works, not just your part

**NICE TO HAVE:**
-----------------

* Experience with requirements management tools (Jama, Polarion, DOORS, etc.) or model-based systems engineering (SysML)
* Experience supporting product safety certification (NRTL or notified body) as a technical contributor
* Experience specifying or validating systems that include learned/ML-based components
* Background in robotics, EV powertrains, drones, aerospace, or other dense electromechanical systems
* Exposure to manufacturing self-test design or service diagnostics

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Subsense**
------------------

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

### **The Opportunity**

Design, develop, and integrate electronics and hardware for emerging neurotechnology, biotechnology, and medical-device systems. You will contribute to the development of experimental platforms, proof-of-concept devices, data acquisition systems, and integrated hardware supporting a range of research and development activities. Projects may involve electronics for optical, magnetic, sensing, and other biomedical technologies as technical needs evolve.

This role offers an opportunity for an early-career engineer to gain hands-on experience across electrical engineering, biomedical instrumentation, and multidisciplinary system development. You will work on hardware from initial concepts and circuit designs through prototyping, integration, characterization, and testing, with opportunities to independently develop electrical subsystems and experimental solutions.

Working closely with specialists in engineering, neuroscience, biology, and software, you will help translate experimental requirements into functional hardware systems. The ideal candidate is curious, enjoys building and troubleshooting physical systems, and has a strong interest in applying engineering principles to biotechnology, biomedical research, and neurotechnology.

### **What You'll Own**

* Assist engineers with the assembly, integration, and testing of electronic circuits and hardware prototypes for biomedical instrumentation and neurotechnology applications.
* Build and modify circuits, cables, and test assemblies using schematics, wiring diagrams, and team guidance, including soldering, component installation, and basic rework.
* Support PCB bring-up and debugging by performing initial checks, taking measurements, recording results, and helping investigate issues.
* Assist with schematic updates, circuit simulation, component research, and straightforward PCB layout tasks under engineering supervision.
* Help set up and operate data acquisition systems, including connecting sensors, configuring equipment, and checking acquired signals.
* Support the integration of sensors, actuators, power supplies, embedded controllers, and other components into team-developed experimental platforms.
* Write or modify small scripts for instrument control, data collection, and test automation using existing code, examples, and team guidance.
* Perform electrical measurements using oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, and bench power supplies, following established procedures.
* Help troubleshoot circuit and system issues, document observations, and work with engineers to identify next steps.

You will balance compression efficiency, visual quality, latency, power consumption, thermal limits, and memory usage, working across media frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers. Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems.

* Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline

* Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field

jobs.description:
About us:

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What you'll do:

At Viasat, we're building the next generation of global connectivity by seamlessly integrating terrestrial 5G networks with advanced satellite communications. Our Access Edge Terminal Software team develops the embedded software that powers innovative connectivity solutions across aviation, maritime, residential, automotive, and emerging mobility markets.

We are seeking a **Staff Embedded Software Engineers - 5G Devices & NTN Connectivity** to architect and develop software platforms for 5G User Equipment (UE) and Customer Premises Equipment (CPE). In this role, you will combine industry-leading 5G technologies with Viasat's satellite capabilities to create hybrid connectivity solutions that deliver reliable communications wherever customers operate.

This is a highly impactful engineering position focused on device-side software architecture, embedded Linux development, modem integration, and platform design. You will work closely with chipset vendors, hardware teams, and product stakeholders to define and deliver next-generation connected devices.

**Note:** This position focuses on device/UE software architecture and development and is distinct from RAN (gNodeB/base station) or 5G Core network roles. Candidates should have experience with device-side, client-side, or CPE software development rather than network infrastructure technologies.

The day-to-day:

**Software Architecture & Platform Development**

* Design and implement modular software architectures with reusable building blocks for devices operating on Viasat's satellite and NTN networks.
* Develop hardware abstraction layers (HALs), middleware, and platform services that decouple application software from modem and hardware implementations.
* Create scalable software frameworks that support multiple device variants, deployment models, and market-specific requirements.
* Define robust APIs and interfaces that enable independent development, testing, and lifecycle management of software components.
* Balance architectural flexibility, maintainability, and performance in resource-constrained embedded environments.

**5G Modem Integration & Embedded Development**

* Integrate 5G modem solutions from industry-leading vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, and other ecosystem partners.
* Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers supporting modem interfaces including PCIe, USB, SDIO, and UART.
* Implement software responsible for modem initialization, configuration, power management, diagnostics, and runtime operation.
* Customize vendor Board Support Packages (BSPs) to meet Viasat hardware and product requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware-software integration challenges.
* Optimize system performance for latency, throughput, power efficiency, reliability, and stability.

**Reference Architectures & Partner Enablement**

* Design and maintain reference software architectures used by OEM and ODM partners.
* Create SDKs that include software libraries, sample applications, documentation, and development tools.
* Develop "golden reference" implementations demonstrating best practices for building 5G NTN-enabled devices compatible with Viasat networks.
* Provide technical guidance and support to external development partners.
* Ensure reference platforms align with industry standards and evolving ecosystem requirements.
* Balance platform standardization with flexibility to support diverse partner and market needs.

**System Integration & Validation**

* Collaborate with hardware and systems engineering teams to define device architectures and software-hardware interfaces.
* Develop automated test frameworks and validation solutions for software platform verification.
* Perform software profiling, performance analysis, and end-to-end optimization.
* Support field trials, customer deployments, and production issue resolution activities.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with chipset vendor field application engineers (FAEs) and technical specialists to resolve complex integration challenges.
* Collaborate with product management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Work closely with application development teams to ensure platform capabilities support future product needs.
* Mentor engineers on embedded systems, 5G device technologies, Linux development, and software engineering best practices.

What you'll need:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience developing embedded software for wireless communication devices.
* Proven track record delivering commercial 5G UE or CPE products.
* Familiarity with 5G device architecture, including RF, baseband, and application processor subsystems.
* Hands-on experience integrating 5G modem chipsets from vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, or Samsung.
* Knowledge of 3GPP UE protocol stacks including NAS, SDAP, RRC, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers from a device perspective.
* Familiarity with 5G NR procedures, MIMO technologies, carrier aggregation, and device performance optimization.
* Familiarity with regulatory and certification requirements including FCC, CE, and carrier approvals.

**Software & Systems Expertise**

* Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded and system-level programming.
* Strong experience with Linux kernel

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems (SI&WS) Organization is seeking a **Gigabit Ethernet Data Multiplex System (GEDMS) Communications & Network Systems Engineer** to support System Network Architecting and Application Engineering activities in **Huntington Beach, CA**.

The GEDMS program, led out of Huntington Beach, CA, consists of geographically distributed team members. Locations include the east coast and shipbuilding facilities in Bath, ME as well as Pascagoula, MS. The GEDMS team is responsible for the design and sustainment of a family of ship-wide network system variants that include equipment for ruggedized switching, routing, and message/signal processing. The system is designed for use on both United States (US) Navy and foreign ships.

The candidate will be instrumental in performing and managing high visibility tasks assigned by the US Navy customer for the System Engineering effort (network design and architecture development, requirements derivation, use cases, functional analysis, specifications development, verification and validation, etc.) required to develop and evolve the next-generation secure GEDMS architectures. The selected candidate will be responsible for providing Systems Engineering support for major shipboard design variants. In addition, responsibilities will include coordinating ongoing activities with internal and external team members and communicating with the customer.

Our teams are currently hiring for a broad range of experience levels including Experienced or Lead Level Engineers.

jobs.title: Principal Robotic Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a defense technology team developing autonomous directed-energy systems. As the senior technical anchor for controls, you will shape precision pointing and tracking architecture, from theory and simulation through real-world hardware testing.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design control architecture for coarse gimbals and fine steering mirrors, including bandwidth allocation, multi-rate operation, and stage handoffs.
* Develop Kalman, interacting multiple model, and nonlinear filters that fuse radar, EO/IR, and inertial data into latency-compensated aimpoint estimates.
* Build line-of-sight stabilization and jitter-rejection methods, including inertial stabilization, feedforward, and adaptive or notch filtering for structural modes.
* Allocate pointing error budgets across jitter, bias, latency, and atmospheric effects, then validate precision performance against dynamic targets in field tests.
* Model plants and identify system dynamics for gimbals, mirrors, and structures, using simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.
* Analyze stability and robustness under disturbances and parameter variation, and integrate controls with tracking, engagement sequencing, and safety logic.
* Deploy control algorithms to embedded targets, collaborate on kilohertz-rate loops, and compare field test results with simulation predictions.
* Provide technical review across controls and sensor integration, and mentor engineers through hands-on technical leadership.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 10 years of experience closing loops on precision pointing, tracking, or stabilization hardware, with PhD-level depth in control theory and estimation.
* Proficiency in robust control, including H-infinity, mu-synthesis, and LQG, plus optimal estimation such as Kalman variants, IMM, and nonlinear observers.
* Experience shipping C or C++ control loops on embedded or RTOS targets, and working with MATLAB/Simulink and Python.
* Background in sensor fusion, multi-rate and sampled-data design, real-time hardware-in-the-loop validation, system identification, and structural dynamics.
* Ability to serve as the controls technical anchor on a small team. Directed-energy or high-energy laser experience and an active security clearance, or ability to obtain one, are advantages.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary range: $250,000 to $315,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, United States.

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Methodology, Infrastructure, Silicon Engineering, and Labs engineering (MILE) team delivers the physical design CAD flows, tools, and infrastructure that Microsoft’s silicon design teams use to take advanced-node chips from RTL to tapeout. Within MILE, the Physical Design (PD) CAD signoff group owns logic signoff, including formal equivalency checking, ECO verification, and low-power verification. Our flows are how design teams prove their silicon is functionally correct before tapeout, so quality here directly protects schedule, cost, and silicon quality across Microsoft’s cloud and AI programs.

We are looking for a Senior PD CAD Equivalency Engineer to own and evolve our formal equivalency flows, working with design teams and EDA vendors to deliver reliable, high-quality equivalency checking for Microsoft’s next-generation silicon.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Own the end-to-end formal equivalency CAD flow, including RTL-to-netlist, netlist-to-netlist, functional ECO, and low-power (UPF-aware) verification, for Microsoft’s silicon programs
* Develop, debug, and maintain production flows and automation in Tcl and Python for Synopsys Formality and Cadence Conformal, including handling of complex design classes
* Partner with physical design, front-end/synthesis, and signoff teams and with EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence) to qualify new tool releases, resolve critical tool issues, and support design teams through tapeout closure
* Independently drive technical decisions for the equivalency domain, identify root causes of ambiguous tool behavior, and define clear paths to resolution; mentor and serve as a backup for other engineers in the team
* Deliver measurable improvements in flow quality, runtime, and reliability, including regression coverage, documentation, and support turnaround for design teams

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in silicon CAD, physical design (logic synthesis), or design verification flows using tools such as Synopsys Fusion Compiler/Design Compiler and/or Cadence Genus/Innovus
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with formal equivalency checking tools (Synopsys Formality and/or Cadence Conformal) in advanced process nodes
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using Tcl and Python for developing and debugging production CAD flows
* Experience with ECO flows, including functional-metal ECO and low-power (UPF-aware) equivalency verification
* Experience qualifying and deploying EDA tool releases and working with vendor application engineers to drive issue resolution; familiarity with both Synopsys and Cadence equivalency tools
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with distributed design and CAD teams and translate complex tradeoffs into clear next steps
* Experience supporting multiple concurrent tapeouts and familiarity with cloud-based EDA compute environments

**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We believe powerful AI can compress a century of scientific progress into a decade. Bringing Claude to scientists and engineers is a big part of building toward that future.

Claude has already helped uncover a novel enzyme system, formalize Fermat’s Last Theorem, design more efficient quantum circuits, and compute new results in theoretical physics — and this is just the beginning. You’ll figure out what scientists and engineers need from Claude and build it from 0 1.

You’ll be a technical leader with a high degree of autonomy, helping clear the path to harnessing scientific AGI. You’ll work with internal experts and industry partners. Initiatives like our AI for Science Program will connect you with researchers we support in high-impact work across scientific fields.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build products that unlock scientific discovery
* Partner with product management, design, and go-to-market to make complex workflows, like modeling and simulation, simple to run with Claude
* Work closely with research to make models better at science and engineering
* Spend time with users in academia and industry to decide what to build next
* Own technical design and delivery end to end, shipping product quickly rather than just executing a spec

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Software engineering experience, including owning the technical design and delivery of products
* Experience building products from 0 to 1 in fast-moving environments, and setting technical direction with limited precedent to lean on
* Experience building AI products, and knowledge of what it takes to turn model capabilities into applications people actually use
* Ability to think holistically about user experience and craft tools that are a pleasure for scientists and engineers to use
* Comfort working directly with technical domain experts and customers, and turning what you learn into product

===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

JPL’s **Avionics Systems Engineering Group** within the **Avionics, Power, & Instrument Electronics Section** is dedicated to developing avionics subsystem avionics concepts, implementing avionics system architecture designs, designing and ensuring implementation of hardware for flight projects, and supporting project formulation and proposals. We are seeking a creative, experienced **Avionics Systems Engineer III**, with expertise in space hardware development and task leadership, to join the group and participate in developing the next generation of space avionics hardware.

The **Avionics Systems Engineer III** will lead avionics systems engineering tasks within JPL's Avionics Systems Engineering Group. This role carries task-level leadership responsibility, including developing system designs and requirements, and reporting technical progress to Line, Project, and Institutional Management. Candidates should bring several years of systems engineering experience, with a strong preference for prior aerospace or space hardware development.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

* Responsible for generation of requirements from the avionics subsystem level through electronic card level, design description and interface documents, engineering change requests, trade studies, model generation and analyses, and verification item generation.
* Develop and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans.
* Will closely collaborate with Cognizant Engineers, Design Engineers and I&T Engineers throughout the product design, I&T and delivery lifecycle.
* Report on technical progress, schedule, and budget to Line, Project, and Institutional Management.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar technical discipline with typically a minimum of 6 years of related work experience, a Master’s degree in similar disciplines with typically a minimum of 4 years of related work experience, or a PhD in a similar discipline with typically a minimum of 2 years of related work experience.
* Knowledge of industry and/or academic practices and standards across a range of applications related to the development, testing and integration of electronic assemblies for space applications
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in relating to both internal and external customers
* Strong ability to multi-task with an established track record of meeting schedules with milestones
* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to work with a fluctuating, competing, and fast-paced environment
* Ability to obtain and maintain any required U.S. Government security clearance, and be able to work with export-controlled (ITAR) hardware and technical data, which may require U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience working with high data throughput systems
* Experience working with Versal ACAP
* Experience with Fiberoptic harnessing, connectors, and associated electronics
* Experience taking a design from concept to Design, Build, Test and Deliver for a Space mission
* Military, Aerospace & Space hardware development experience
* Experience developing and delivering Avionics system documentation (requirements, functional description documents, test plans, and test reports)
* Experience specifying, designing, or testing Command and Data Handling modules
* Experience with the use of Jama (or similar) for requirement and verification item management and tracking.
* Experience with integration and test of flight electronics.

**Note: Must be willing to obtain Top Secret (TS) clearance based upon Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI) and must be approved for Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Video SWE
jobs.description:
Meta's Wearables Media Codec and Framework team develops the video encoding and media capture software that powers wearable experiences. We are looking for a Video Codec Software Engineer to build and optimize codec implementations and hardware-accelerated media pipelines for resource-constrained devices like smart glasses.In this role, you will own technical problems from camera capture through encoding, media containers, and audio/video synchronization. You will balance compression efficiency, visual quality, latency, power consumption, thermal limits, and memory usage, working across media frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers. Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Video SWE Responsibilities:**

* Architect, implement, and troubleshoot video codec and media capture pipelines for wearable devices, from camera capture through encoding and media output
* Develop, configure, and tune video encoders, including rate control and compression algorithms, to improve encoding efficiency and visual quality
* Optimize codec performance within device power, thermal, latency, and memory constraints, using profiling and measurement to evaluate trade-offs
* Integrate hardware-accelerated video codecs with mobile and embedded media stacks, working across application processor frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers
* Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline
* Diagnose and resolve video artifacts, synchronization issues, and performance regressions through codec-level and end-to-end system debugging
* Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps
* Build and improve automated tests and regression infrastructure for code correctness, visual quality, performance, and power consumption

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field
* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant video software engineering experience in industry settings with understanding of multimedia stack, codecs, containers
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience leading large or complex projects, defined goals and delivered milestones by leading teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with image compression and formats such as JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, or raw/Bayer compression
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience developing automated media regression tests or working with codec tools and libraries such as FFmpeg, libavcodec, x264/x265
* Experience integrating hardware-accelerated video encoding on mobile or low-power systems-on-chip, using media interfaces such as Android MediaCodec, Codec2, OpenMAX, or V4L2
* Knowledge of codec internals, including rate control, motion estimation, intra/inter prediction, rate-distortion optimization, and bitstream analysis
* Experience with media-path firmware or kernel drivers, camera capture integration, or direct collaboration with silicon vendors on hardware-software integration
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience evaluating visual quality using metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF, and diagnosing compression artifacts and quality regressions
* Experience with media containers such as MP4/ISOBMFF, muxing and demuxing, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization
* Experience designing and optimizing media software within power, thermal, latency, and memory bandwidth constraints on wearable, mobile, or embedded devices
* Experience implementing, configuring, or tuning production video encoders using standards such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. Join an engineering and R&D team as a Robotics Engineer focused on autonomous systems. You will design, build, integrate, and test drone-based robotic systems from prototype through field validation, supporting safe and reliable delivery operations.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and integrate robotic mechanisms, sensors, actuators, controllers, and drone payload systems.
* Develop control, navigation, path-planning, and obstacle-avoidance solutions.
* Build robotics software with ROS or ROS 2 and C++ or Python, and validate systems in simulation.
* Integrate flight controllers, companion computers, communication links, and telemetry with drone systems.
* Build, troubleshoot, and independently validate robotic systems in the field.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, and software teams on prototypes and deployments.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of hands-on experience building or delivering robotics, UAV, or autonomous systems.
* Strong fundamentals in kinematics, dynamics, control theory, PID, and system integration.
* Proficiency in C++ or Python, ROS or ROS 2, and Linux; MATLAB familiarity is useful.
* Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, flight controllers, motors, ESCs, and batteries.
* Knowledge of IMU, GPS/RTK, LiDAR, sensor fusion, and GPS-denied navigation.
* Embedded systems experience with microcontrollers, Raspberry Pi or Jetson, actuators, and hardware debugging.
* Familiarity with CAN, UART, I2C, drone telemetry, simulation, flight-log analysis, and field testing.
* A degree in robotics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, aerospace, computer science, or a related field.
* Computer vision, machine learning, SLAM, Gazebo or Webots, CAD, or BVLOS experience is a plus.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

On-site in Indianapolis, United States.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Working across the globe, V2X builds smart solutions designed to integrate physical and digital infrastructure from base to battlefield. We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $3.9B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism.

V2X is seeking a Senior Principal Systems Engineer with a passion for autonomous vehicle system integration and test to join our Systems Engineering team in Indianapolis, IN. This position involves creating advanced autonomous technologies as part of a fast‑moving, cross‑functional team. You’ll work closely with partners inside and outside the organization to design and deliver innovative solutions for autonomous vehicles in a variety of operational environments.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Principal Lead Systems Engineer provides technical and programmatic leadership throughout the development life cycle, from concept development, requirements definition, functional analysis, design review support, system implementation, integration, verification, and validation. The Senior Principal Systems Engineer will work within a cross-functional Integrated Product Team (IPT), where strong communication and team building skills are critical to success.

The ideal candidate embraces modern development processes and techniques that improve product quality & team productivity and has experience developing and integrating advanced systems including situational awareness displays, mission computers, avionics, sensors, mission equipment, and radar systems. We are looking for engineers that enjoy a challenge and have a passion to support our DoD customers and international allies.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a DoD Secret Clearance.
* Minimum 15 years of related engineering experience in systems, software, or hardware engineering.
* Experience providing leadership, technical direction, and guidance to large multi-discipline teams.
* Experience leading all systems engineering tasks and cross-product activities across the program.
* Ability to take ownership of the engineering scope within the program and drive the necessary tasks to ultimately ensure the cross-function team meets the technical  
  requirements.
* Experience developing technical baselines (requirements/architecture); leading development teams; and developing and reviewing Engineering Change Requests.
* Strong communication skills and ability to effectively communicate to internal and external stakeholders including leading both internal and customer design reviews.
* In-depth understanding of the System Engineering Lifecycle and processes.
* Experience mentoring engineers of all grade levels.

**Desired Skills:**

* Comprehensive understanding of AA&E and Airborne Store related systems.
* Experience managing suppliers and overseeing the development of subsystems and components.
* Experience with the design, development, and integration of UAI Type I and Type II Carriage Systems.
* Experience with the design, development, and integration of gravity release and pneumatic ejection systems.
* Knowledge and experience working with Universal Armament Interface (UAI) including MIL-STD-1553 EBR, MIL-STD-1760, and JMMI.
* Experience working with government customers including the US Army, US Navy, USMC and/or USAF. Direct support of UAI JICWG is desired.
* Experience with Carriage System development including design criteria standards (ex. MIL-STD-8591, MIL-STD-2088B)
* Experience working IEEE Standard 15288
* Experience supporting Government integration, ground, and flight test events (including planning, test card generation, telemetry/data acquisition systems, and system validation).
* Experience working the front end of the business, creating/reviewing RFPs, SOWs, BOEs, technical volumes, proposals, cost, and schedule estimates.

**Education / Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related STEM discipline. A Master’s degree in Engineering or a related STEM degree may be counted as the equivalent of 2 years of engineering experience.

**At V2X, we are deeply committed to both equal employment opportunity, including protection for Veterans and individuals with disabilities, and fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We ensure all individuals are treated with fairness, respect, and dignity, recognizing the strength that comes from a workforce rich in diverse experiences, perspectives, and skills. This commitment, aligned with our core Vision and Values of Integrity, Respect, and Responsibility, allows us to leverage differences, encourage innovation, and expand our success in the global marketplace, ultimately enabling us to best serve our clients.**

jobs.description:
**Description**

Do you love building algorithms and developing on embedded systems to solve hard problems with real-world applications?

Are you eager to take initiative and work on projects across a broad range of technical challenges, from high-reliability to rapid prototyping?

Do you want to work in an atmosphere where risk taking, innovation, and creativity are openly encouraged and sought out?

If so, we are looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are seeking an embedded systems engineer to help us build and prototype innovative technology applications for future electronic warfare (EW) systems. Your work will contribute to ensuring that the US and its allies dominate in the RF spectrum.

You'll be joining our innovative team of systems engineers, algorithm developers, FPGA and embedded software engineers, and advanced EW technology enthusiasts who enjoy working together to craft creative solutions to complex challenges in addition ot bringing real solutions from concept to prototyping.

**As an Embedded Systems Engineer, we will trust you to ...**

* Develop software and firmware for real-time embedded systems.
* Implement digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms for various types of communication, radar, and EW systems.
* Integrate embedded systems with EW payloads.
* Apply Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms for EW applications.
* Test and demonstrate your work in field tests and lab demos.

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you ...**

* Have a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or another related technical field.
* Have general knowledge of embedded systems design with FPGAs.
* Demonstrated familiarity with VHDL, Verilog, or other FPGA development languages.
* Have experience with MATLAB, C/C++, Python, or similar programming languages.
* Have relevant experience working with embedded systems and embedded programming.
* Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date, and can ultimately obtain a Top Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You 'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you ...**

* Have a Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering.
* Have at least seven years of relevant experience working with embedded systems and embedded programming.
* Bring experience in programming for Software Defined Radio (SDR).
* Have experience in high-speed FPGA development.
* Are knowledgeable of standard digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms.
* Have experience working with Linux operating systems.
* Hold an active DoD Secret level clearance or higher.
