jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Firmware Lifecycle and Release Management
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle End to End:** Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.
* **Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases:** Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.
* **Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns:** Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.
* **Drive Security and CVE Response:** Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.
* **Govern Vendor Relationships:** Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.
* **Build the Machine:** Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.
* **Surface Risk and Drive Decisions:** Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.
* **Improve Continuously:** Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Program Leadership at Scale:** 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.
* **Server Firmware Expertise:** Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.
* **Risk and Dependency Management:** Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.
* **Process Builder’s Mindset:** Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.
* **Educational Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience at a GPU cloud provider or hyperscaler managing large-scale fleets (thousands of nodes).
* A track record of driving firmware currency and compliance programs across a production fleet.
* Hands-on experience with vendor escalation management, including driving OEM/ODM and silicon partners to fix and validate firmware on tight timelines.
* Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and the dependencies between firmware, drivers, and cluster networking.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness supp

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer III
jobs.description:
***Mechatronics Engineer III - Scientific Instrumentation & Process Engineering (SIPE)***

The mission of the Allen Institute is to understand the principles that govern life, and to advance health. Our creative and multi-dimensional teams focus on answering some of the biggest questions in bioscience. We accelerate foundational research, catalyze bold ideas, develop tools and models, and openly share our science to make a broad, transformational impact on the world.

The Mechatronics Engineer III is a hands-on engineering role within the Scientific Instrumentation and Process Engineering (SIPE) team. This position designs, builds, and integrates robotic and automated systems for SIPE's custom scientific instruments, bringing together mechanical design, sensors, motion control, and software to deliver reliable, high-performance automation for neuroscience research.

The Mechatronics Engineer III works with minimal supervision and exercises independent judgment, leading defined subsystems and projects from concept through deployment. On any given week, this might mean tuning a control loop and integrating a force or vision sensor into a robot's motion routine, programming and validating tool paths for dissection automation, and updating CAD models and drawings for an end effector used in robotic wafer handling. This role works closely with the Principal System Design Engineer (robotics focus) on tissue processing and dissection automation. A successful candidate takes ownership of complex technical problems, contributes to engineering standards and documentation, and mentors less experienced team members. This role reports to the Hardware Engineering Manager.

At the Allen Institute, we believe that science is for everyone – and should be open to everyone. We are dedicated to combating biases and reducing barriers to STEM careers more broadly.

We also believe that science is better when it includes different perspectives and voices. We strive to make the Allen Institute a place where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to do their best work in a supportive environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourage people from all backgrounds to apply for our open positions.

**Essential Functions**

**Robotics & Automation Integration**

* Implement, integrate, and commission robotic systems, such as robotic wafer handling to load and unload samples from imaging instruments
* Partner with the Principal System Design Engineer to develop robotic subsystems for tissue processing and dissection automation
* Program robot motion and tool paths; define, test, and validate trajectories, teach points, and coordinate frames for precision handling tasks
* Integrate sensors (e.g., force/torque, vision, encoders, proximity, limit and presence sensors) into robotic control and feedback systems
* Design, tune, and validate control loops for motors, stages, and actuators to meet positioning, speed, and repeatability requirements
* Perform kinematic and dynamic analysis, size motors and actuators, and evaluate accuracy and repeatability of motion systems
* Develop and execute calibration procedures for robots, cameras, and work cells (e.g., tool, frame, and hand-eye calibration), and verify positioning accuracy
* Develop firmware and control code for microcontrollers and motion controllers; implement communication between sensors, drives, and controllers (e.g., digital I/O, serial, CAN, EtherCAT, Modbus)
* Implement interlocks, e-stops, error handling, and recovery routines to protect samples, instruments, and operators; support safety reviews and risk assessments led by senior engineers

**Mechanical & Electrical Design and Build**

* Create parts, assemblies, and drawings in CAD (OnShape preferred) for end effectors, fixtures, mounts, and mechanisms; perform tolerance analysis and basic FEA as needed
* Specify, evaluate, and select motors, drives, actuators, sensors, controllers, and mechanical components
* Design power and signal wiring, wiring harnesses, and control enclosures; select motor drives and power supplies; develop simple circuit boards for sensor interfaces as needed
* Create and maintain bills of material (BOMs), system diagrams, and wiring schematics for assemblies and subassemblies
* Build, assemble, and debug prototypes and production instruments using the SIPE workshop (3D printing, laser cutting, hand tools, and bench electronics)

**Testing, Documentation & Collaboration**

* Work with scientists and engineers to capture requirements and translate them into specifications and test plans
* Plan and execute verification and validation testing; write reports and document processes, procedures, and SOPs
* Use source control (e.g., Git) and issue tracking to manage code, configurations, and design changes
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware/software issues on deployed automated instruments with minimal guidance
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers and instrument specialists
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and contribute to SIPE engineering standards and best practices

Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not proscribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, mechatronics, electrical, robotics, or systems engineering, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 3 years of relevant experience designing, building, and integrating electromechanical, robotic, or automated systems
* Hands-on experience with motion control and sensor integration, including programming robots or multi-axis motion systems
* Proficiency with CAD and with a programming language (e.g., Python, C/C++, C#) for hardware control

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Staff Engineer for our Messaging Experience team, responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving Canvas, our flagship product. That means supporting the orchestration and sending of messages for clients worldwide. Our products rely on sophisticated real-time and batch processing of massive amounts of data, providing analytics, automated decision-making, and an industry-leading customer engagement tool. In this role, you will bridge the gap between the customer-facing dashboard and the underlying orchestration engines which power delivery. You will partner with engineering managers and technical leads embedded in teams to ensure our architecture supports a maturing suite of channels, while collaborating with senior leadership on initiatives that ensure a consistent, high-quality experience across the entire division.

In this role you will:

Partner on the technical vision and quality bar for the division. Drive architectural direction, define best practices, and ensure teams have a clear path to resolving persistent quality and technical debt issues

Support maturing channels. Help teams evolve their stacks to support more sophisticated marketing use cases, ensuring that foundational primitives are flexible and robust
Mentor engineers at every level. Simplify hard problems, connect technical decisions to business outcomes, and raise the bar through code review, architecture review, and pairing
Champion reliability and operability. Improve observability and tighten error handling across the dashboard and delivery layers, advocating for incremental rollouts and reducing division-wide incidents
Deliver code. Staff Engineers at Braze are hands-on; you will design and build the foundational systems and frameworks that act as a force multiplier for the organization

Recent and ongoing work across the division includes:

Developing shared frameworks for our orchestration tools to ensure a consistent experience across all messaging channels
Evolving the dashboard to support real-time feedback and sophisticated automated flows for building, testing, launching and analyzing user journeys
Building platforms and code-generation tooling that allow teams to automate delivery of sophisticated user journeys which cater to our customer’s most demanding needs

Who You Are

Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time as a technical leader influencing multiple teams or complex product systems
Experience building foundational backend systems at scale and working on complex and performant web-based user interfaces
Are comfortable working across the full stack. You have experience in Ruby on Rails and are proficient in modern frontend environments (TypeScript, React) where customers configure their experience
Have designed and shipped foundational infrastructure. You've built frameworks, libraries, or platform services used by many other engineers to build product features
Bring strong architectural judgment. You know when to invest in abstraction, when to keep things simple, and how to make technical bets that support a maturing product suite
Are an effective communicator and mentor. You can translate technical debt into business risk and elevate the engineers around you through coaching and clear technical vision
Have a track record of identifying highest-leverage work. You can build consensus across different teams and drive projects to completion with minimal direction through high ambiguity

Bonus experience:

Experience building or maintaining shared component libraries or design system primitives
Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures as they relate to message orchestration
Experience with developer experience tooling, such as code generation, scaffolding, or CI/CD for large-scale codebases
Experience maturing a product from "early stage" to "enterprise scale" without losing developer velocity

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. Position Description

Ready to launch your software career? The Bluestaq Software Engineering Residency Program is an 11.5-week, paid, cohort-based program built around one goal: turning promising early-career developers into full-time Bluestaq Associate Software Engineers. This isn't a coffee-run internship. From week one you'll work real backlog items on the systems our U.S. Space Force customers use every day, guided by a dedicated engineer-mentor, and you'll close out the program by presenting your capstone work directly to Bluestaq engineering leadership.

Who We’re Looking For

We're offering the residency to early-career software talent ready to commit to a full-time engineering role, including: final-year associate, undergraduate, or master's students (graduating by January 2027), recent graduates in Computer Science, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. If you're excited about learning fast, collaborating, and shipping real-world solutions, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do

At Bluestaq, our residents aren't confined to one technology stack. You'll explore multiple technologies while contributing to impactful projects. Expect to work with languages and tools like Java, Python, Angular, Groovy, REST Services, GIT, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Athena, NiFi, Quarkus, and cloud platforms like Google Cloud, MS Azure, and AWS.

This isn't just about coding — we're all about growing your skills. You'll pair with experienced engineers, learn data storage solutions, front-end and back-end technologies, and cloud-based infrastructure, with structured milestones along the way: an onboarding week covering our tooling and secure development practices, a midpoint demo, and a capstone presentation. We offer the perfect balance of guidance and independence, allowing you to learn while making a real impact.

You have software development experience through coursework, personal projects, bootcamp work, or prior internships.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is looking for a Systems Engineering Manager 2
to be located in Roy, UT or Colorado Springs, CO.
This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.

Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

What You Will Get To Do

The selected candidate will clearly demonstrate strong management skills and will have a track record as a motivated leader, an effective communicator, and problem solver who is able to develop and maintain good working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The selected candidate will be placed according to their skillset and interests. Key responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

Own both technical and programmatic leadership for a team of ~10 FTE performing systems engineering functions to define and develop support equipment or training devices.
Serve as a Work Package Lead (WPL), owning, cost, schedule, and earned value responsibilities for the work your team performs.
Review OPSCON documentation to understand requirements decomposition necessary to meet support equipment functional needs
Generate OPSCON documentation to identify and understand the activities and support equipment required to maintain the prime mission equipment within the weapon system
Develop and mature interface products (Interface Requirements Specification, Interface Design Description, Interface Control Model)
Develop and mature verification applicability matrix (VAM) within the support segment spec tree
Perform requirements and verification approach definition for 200+ pieces of support equipment
Own all aspects of Employee performance management, mentorship, training, and career development (functional homeroom at 20% of the time)
This leadership opening is in Roy, UT with up to 10% travel on occasion.

Position Benefits

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Defense Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:

Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
401k
Educational Assistance
Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
Paid Time Off
Health & Wellness Resources
Employee Discounts

This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.

You’ll Bring These Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) with 8+ years of related technical experience or Masters Degree with 6+ years of related experience
2+ years of experience with Systems Engineering Lifecycle, in any of the following systems engineering domains: requirements development, systems architecture, verification planning, and interface definition experience
Must have an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope.

These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have

At least 3+ years experience leading a project and/or driving performance against schedule with proven results
Strong understanding of the SE process, including SE experience across multiple levels of integration. 3+ years of experience with Systems Engineering Lifecycle, including requirements development, systems architecture, verification planning, and interface definition experience
3+ years of experience using IBM DOORS, Cameo, CPLM and/or NX
2+ years of experience with Agile project management using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent tools
1+ years of experience with Support Equipment development, engineering and sustainment

jobs.description:
Davidson is distinguished in the aerospace and missile defense industry, in part, because of its excellence in hiring exceptional experts, engineers and software developers dedicated to delivering advanced, intelligent technology solutions in defense of our nation.

Davidson is seeking a Principal Systems Engineer
in Colorado Springs, CO

This position is located at a site that is NOT on a military base or military installation.

The qualified candidate will support the Missile Defense Sensors (MDS) department. The MDS department delivers cutting-edge expertise in concept development, architectural design, requirements generation and flow-down, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, integration, test, and evaluation of world-class Missile Defense & Sensor Systems. You will play a critical part in the enhancement and modernization of Ground-Based Radar (GBR) Systems. Your contributions will include developing and analyzing system requirements, designing system architectures, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver advanced radar solutions.

Job Responsibilities

Lead the development of architectures and requirements to define, characterize, and document Ground Based Radar (GBR) systems.
Contribute to architectural framework updates, system-of-system functional and performance requirements, detailed algorithm descriptions, test scenario definitions, and verification approaches.
Conduct requirements analysis and benchmarking to validate algorithm designs and ensure system-level performance aligns with operational objectives.
Collaborate closely with software and integration/test engineers to deliver innovative and high-performing radar solutions.

Job Requirements

BS or MS in Engineering, Science, Math or related discipline
8+ years experience in an engineering role with system integration and/or test of complex, large scale DOD systems
Advanced knowledge of job area/domain expertise (ie Radars/Sensors, Ship Systems, System Integration and Test)
Significant experience with system integration and test process, tools and techniques
Experience with Systems Engineering Product Development Cycle
Experience with MATLAB and DOORS; Demonstrated Successful Leadership as a Complex System Integration and/or Complex System Test Lead
Experience developing and presenting technical information/presentations to leaders or customers
Has advanced specialty knowledge in Systems Engineering and Integration/Test of complex, large-scale systems; Provides guidance, coaching or training of others

Desired Competencies

Experience with radar system concepts including detection, discrimination, tracking, and signal processing algorithms, as well as their behaviors and performance.
Proven experience in system-level requirements development, documentation, maintenance, and/or the design of system-level software architecture.
Hands-on experience in developing and coding system models, algorithms, test vectors, and evaluation tools to analyze radar requirements and performance.
Demonstrated ability to develop, document, and maintain processes, methods, and tools to ensure engineering excellence.
Track record of developing technical solutions to complex engineering challenges.
Proficiency in programming languages such as python, C/C++, Java, and tools like DOORS.
Familiarity with the software development process using Agile methodologies and associated tools, such as JIRA and Confluence.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proven history of delivering innovative technical solutions.
Proficiency with the MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
Excellent communication skills, including technical writing, oral presentations, and interpersonal skills.
Previous experience interfacing with customers and leading the development of technical solutions for complex user requirements.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a geographically distributed team environment.
Experience collaborating across disciplines and communicating effectively with all levels of the organization and external stakeholders.
Advanced Degree in STEM

Clearance Requirements

Currently hold active DoD Secret Clearance.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Engineer – On Site: New York, NY

Company Profile

AppCard builds software used by millions of shoppers every day. We let the independent retailer compete with the largest big box stores by providing them with a top tier suite of analytics and marketing tools that help grow and power their business. We’re a small agile team that lets our engineers take ownership of their code. We believe in doing things the right way, and aren’t afraid to try new things.
AppCard is rapidly growing with leadership comprising seasoned tech entrepreneurs and loyalty marketing pioneers, alongside investors such as Founders Fund and Innovation Endeavors with backers behind giants like Facebook and AirBnB. Join us early in our journey to reshape retail!

Objective of this Role

As AppCard expands its services and integration efforts, we're seeking a seasoned Software Engineer to join our NYC-based team. This role is pivotal in developing and enhancing our platform, ensuring we continue to deliver exceptional value to our users and clients. If you're passionate about leveraging your extensive engineering expertise to drive innovation and scale cutting-edge solutions, we'd love to have you on board.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions in collaboration with your engineering peers.
Lead technical architecture discussions and guide the development of complex scalable systems with distributed edge devices.
Mentor engineers and lead knowledge building initiatives, fostering a culture of technical transparency and accountability.
Troubleshoot, identify, and resolve high-level systemic issues across platforms.
Collaborate cross-functionally with customer success, support, and business teams to deliver on company goals.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and propose adopting new solutions that can enhance AppCard's offerings.
Work on new designs and refactor old systems to meet new business needs and scale.
Contribute to technical roadmapping and influence new features.
Bring in new technologies and frameworks as you see fit.

Skills and Qualifications

A Rich Background:
3+ years of hands-on experience in developing high-performance distributed systems. Your journey has equipped you with expert coding practices and a proven track record in a senior role.
Technical Mastery:
A solid foundation in computer science principles, excelling in software design, and an appreciation for both monolithic and distributed architectures. Experienced in Python and Java with a keen ability to identify, adopt, and champion the right tools for the task at hand. Experienced in cloud services (e.g., AWS) and CI/CD pipelines.
A Proactive Approach:
Demonstrated capability in developing and implementing efficient tools, processes, and methodologies to address challenges and enhance efficiency. You're skilled at identifying and resolving potential bottlenecks efficiently. Whenever you raise issues you bring along possible solutions as well.
Independence and Initiative:
The ability to lead projects from inception to delivery, demonstrating your capacity to work autonomously and produce solutions that meet or exceed project expectations.
A Commitment to Excellence:
An unwavering belief in the importance of documentation, recognizing that clear, comprehensive documentation is as crucial as the code itself.

Your Role and Responsibilities Will Include:

Hands-On Leadership:
Direct engagement with your team and partners to develop and deploy secure, industry-standard code that's robust and ready for production.
Culture of Quality:
Championing a culture of quality in every aspect of the development process, ensuring that the products we deliver are of the highest standard.
Clean Code:
Advocating for clean code practices, ensuring that our codebase remains manageable and efficient. You'll take a proactive stance on controlling technical debt, making strategic decisions that balance immediate needs with long-term maintainability.
Mentorship:
Actively mentoring engineers, contributing to their skill growth and career development, sharing your expertise and insights to enhance team capability and performance.
Effective Communication:
Facilitating clear and effective communication across various teams and stakeholders, ensuring transparency and efficiency in all project phases.

Things that Will Make You Happy

A leadership team that values innovation and promotes a culture of transparency and support.
Competitive compensation package, including stock options and comprehensive benefits.
A casual and inclusive office environment with a focus on results, not politics.
Opportunities for professional growth and development in a growing sector.
Flexible working arrangements to accommodate life’s opportunities and challenges.
An empathetic manager who cares about you and will invest in your professional development.
Stock options.
Competitive salary and incentives.
Choice of health, dental and vision benefits.
Life Insurance Coverage, 401(k) plan, vacation/sick leave, paid company holidays.
Flexible Spending Account (FSA).
Health Savings Account (HSA).
Commuter benefits.

Join AppCard in transforming the retail landscape and strengthening shopper experience through technology. Apply now to become a part of our mission-driven team as a Software Engineer.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer – HPE Campus and Branch
jobs.description:
This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Description

Job Description:

Senior Systems Engineer – HPE Campus and Branch

***This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home, however candidates must reside in ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.***

Job Description:

This is a customer-facing sales role that covers multiple states and may require approximately 50% of your time traveling.

HPE Campus & Branch Specialist

If you are looking for your next challenge and want to make a meaningful impact helping customers modernize their campus and branch networks, this is an opportunity to join a high-performing specialist team focused on HPE Mist. HPE Mist delivers AI-native networking experiences across wireless, wired, WAN, network access, location services, and cloud-based operations.

Role Summary

As a Senior Systems Engineer - HPE Campus & Branch, you will serve as an HPE Mist specialist partnering with the AI for Networking Seller and be the trusted technical advisor supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers throughout the customer lifecycle. You will partner closely with HPE account teams to win new customers, expand strategic accounts, and ensure existing customers remain successful.

You will lead from the front by driving technical discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements. You will help HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers develop winning technical strategies, differentiate HPE Mist from competitive solutions, and guide customers from initial evaluation through successful adoption and operational outcomes.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted relationships across customers, partners, sales teams, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Partner with HPE Sales Teams

Act as the HPE Mist technical specialist supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers across strategic sales opportunities.
Partner with account teams to develop technical account strategies that drive new-logo acquisition, competitive displacement and customer expansion.
Engage early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify technical and business requirements, and align HPE Mist solutions to desired outcomes.
Provide technical leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from qualification and discovery through design, validation, close, deployment, and adoption.
Build strong working relationships with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers and operate as an extension of the account team.

Lead Technical Sales Engagements

Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings.
Translate complex customer requirements into clear, differentiated HPE Mist architectures and solution recommendations.
Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from network engineers and architects to IT leaders, CISOs, and CIOs.
Develop competitive technical strategies and position the unique value of HPE Mist AI-native networking against alternative solutions.
Create compelling customer experiences that build technical confidence, accelerate decisions, and improve win rates.

Drive Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept

Own and lead HPE Mist demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements from planning through successful completion.
Define clear POC objectives, success criteria, test plans, customer responsibilities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
Configure, deploy, validate, and troubleshoot HPE Mist solutions in customer environments.
Partner with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers to convert successful technical evaluations into production opportunities.
Document results, lessons learned, and reusable best practices that improve future demonstrations and POCs.

Ensure Customer Success

Serve as a trusted technical advisor before, during, and after the sale to help customers realize the full value of HPE Mist.
Provide architecture guidance, migration planning, deployment best practices, operational recommendations, and adoption support.
Proactively identify technical risks, adoption barriers, and customer health concerns, then coordinate the right HPE resources to drive resolution.
Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product Management, and Engineering on strategic customer needs and escalations.
Help maintain happy customers who become long-term advocates and references for HPE Mist.

Maintain HPE Mist Technical Excellence

Develop and maintain deep expertise across HPE Mist wireless, wired, WAN, access assurance, location services, cloud operations, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.
Stay current on product releases, architectures, competitive developments, industry standards, and emerging campus and branch technologies.
Be hands-on with design, configuration, demonstrations, troubleshooting, and customer validation.
Create and share technical content, design guidance, demos, best practices, and reusable enablement materials.
Contribute actively to the broader HPE Mist technical community and promote a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

Enable HPE Teams and Partners

Enable HPE Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and distributors through mentoring, technical training, workshops, and opportunity support.
Help scale HPE Mist expertise across the field by sharing repeatable sales motions, competitive insights, demo practices, POC methodologies, and lessons learned.
Support customer events, webinars, seminars, executive briefings, partner sessions, and field enablement programs.
Collaborate across HPE teams to ensure consistent positioning and a unified customer experience.

HPE Campus & Branch Mist Expertise

The successful candidate will develop and maintain specialist-level expertise across:

HPE Mist AI and Marvis AI
Enterprise wireless networking and Wi-Fi 6E/Wi-Fi 7
Campus and branch switching
Wireless Assurance and Wired Assurance
WAN Assurance and branch networking
NAC, identity, and network access control
Location Services and user engagement capabilities
Cloud management, APIs, automation, and AI-driven operations
Campus routing, segmentation, resiliency, and security architectures

Qualifications

Candidate must reside in one of the following states: ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.
7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, technical consulting, or a related enterprise networking role.
Proven success supporting complex technical sales cycles, customer demonstrations, architecture workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements.
Deep knowledge of enterprise wireless networking, including RF fundamentals, industry standards, site surveys, high-density design, roaming, security, and troubleshooting.
Strong campus and branch networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, TCP/IP, Layer 2/Layer 3 design, routing, switching, multicast, QoS, ACLs, firewalls, segmentation, and resiliency.
Experience with identity and access technologies including 802.1X, AAA, RADIUS, EAP methods, certificates, SAML, and common client operating systems.
Experience designing and supporting large campus, distributed enterprise, and branch networking environments.
Hands-on experience with wireless design and validation tools such as Ekahau, Hamina, NetAlly, or iBwave.
Familiarity with REST APIs, Python, scripting, automation, cloud integrations, or Infrastructure as Code is highly desirable.
Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
Executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities and customer engagements simultaneously.
Self-motivated, collaborative, and passionate about customer success, technical excellence, and winning as a team.
Ability to travel up to 50% based on customer and business needs.

Preferred Experience And Certifications

Prior experience with HPE Mist, Aruba or another leading enterprise networking platform.
Experience supporting competitive displacement and complex enterprise transformation initiatives.
Relevant industry certifications such as CWNP/CWNE, JNCIP/JNCIE, CCNP/CCIE, CISSP, or equivalent.

What Success Looks Like

You are recognized as the HPE Mist expert that Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and customers trust for their most important campus and branch opportunities. You help HPE win new customers, expand strategic accounts, execute successful demonstrations and POCs, and ensure customers achieve lasting technical and business outcomes. You lead from the front, raise the technical capability of the broader team, and help establish HPE Mist as the best technical solution for modern campus and branch networking.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

Description

Job Description:

Senior Systems Engineer – HPE Campus and Branch

***This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home, however candidates must reside in ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.***

Job Description:

This is a customer-facing sales role that covers multiple states and may require approximately 50% of your time traveling.

HPE Campus & Branch Specialist

If you are looking for your next challenge and want to make a meaningful impact helping customers modernize their campus and branch networks, this is an opportunity to join a high-performing specialist team focused on HPE Mist. HPE Mist delivers AI-native networking experiences across wireless, wired, WAN, network access, location services, and cloud-based operations.

Role Summary

As a Senior Systems Engineer - HPE Campus & Branch, you will serve as an HPE Mist specialist partnering with the AI for Networking Seller and be the trusted technical advisor supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers throughout the customer lifecycle. You will partner closely with HPE account teams to win new customers, expand strategic accounts, and ensure existing customers remain successful.

You will lead from the front by driving technical discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements. You will help HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers develop winning technical strategies, differentiate HPE Mist from competitive solutions, and guide customers from initial evaluation through successful adoption and operational outcomes.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted relationships across customers, partners, sales teams, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Partner with HPE Sales Teams

Act as the HPE Mist technical specialist supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers across strategic sales opportunities.
Partner with account teams to develop technical account strategies that drive new-logo acquisition, competitive displacement and customer expansion.
Engage early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify technical and business requirements, and align HPE Mist solutions to desired outcomes.
Provide technical leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from qualification and discovery through design, validation, close, deployment, and adoption.
Build strong working relationships with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers and operate as an extension of the account team.

Lead Technical Sales Engagements

Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings.
Translate complex customer requirements into clear, differentiated HPE Mist architectures and solution recommendations.
Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from network engineers and architects to IT leaders, CISOs, and CIOs.
Develop competitive technical strategies and position the unique value of HPE Mist AI-native networking against alternative solutions.
Create compelling customer experiences that build technical confidence, accelerate decisions, and improve win rates.

Drive Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept

Own and lead HPE Mist demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements from planning through successful completion.
Define clear POC objectives, success criteria, test plans, customer responsibilities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
Configure, deploy, validate, and troubleshoot HPE Mist solutions in customer environments.
Partner with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers to convert successful technical evaluations into production opportunities.
Document results, lessons learned, and reusable best practices that improve future demonstrations and POCs.

Ensure Customer Success

Serve as a trusted technical advisor before, during, and after the sale to help customers realize the full value of HPE Mist.
Provide architecture guidance, migration planning, deployment best practices, operational recommendations, and adoption support.
Proactively identify technical risks, adoption barriers, and customer health concerns, then coordinate the right HPE resources to drive resolution.
Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product Management, and Engineering on strategic customer needs and escalations.
Help maintain happy customers who become long-term advocates and references for HPE Mist.

Maintain HPE Mist Technical Excellence

Develop and maintain deep expertise across HPE Mist wireless, wired, WAN, access assurance, location services, cloud operations, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.
Stay current on product releases, architectures, competitive developments, industry standards, and emerging campus and branch technologies.
Be hands-on with design, configuration, demonstrations, troubleshooting, and customer validation.
Create and share technical content, design guidance, demos, best practices, and reusable enablement materials.
Contribute actively to the broader HPE Mist technical community and promote a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

Enable HPE Teams and Partners

Enable HPE Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and distributors through mentoring, technical training, workshops, and opportunity support.
Help scale HPE Mist expertise across the field by sharing repeatable sales motions, competitive insights, demo practices, POC methodologies, and lessons learned.
Support customer events, webinars, seminars, executive briefings, partner sessions, and field enablement programs.
Collaborate across HPE teams to ensure consistent positioning and a unified customer experience.

HPE Campus & Branch Mist Expertise

The successful candidate will develop and maintain specialist-level expertise across:

HPE Mist AI and Marvis AI
Enterprise wireless networking and Wi-Fi 6E/Wi-Fi 7
Campus and branch switching
Wireless Assurance and Wired Assurance
WAN Assurance and branch networking
NAC, identity, and network access control
Location Services and user engagement capabilities
Cloud management, APIs, automation, and AI-driven operations
Campus routing, segmentation, resiliency, and security architectures

Qualifications

Candidate must reside in one of the following states: ME, NH, MA, RI, CT, DE, NJ, DC, VA, WV, PA, MD, NY, and VT.
7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, technical consulting, or a related enterprise networking role.
Proven success supporting complex technical sales cycles, customer demonstrations, architecture workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements.
Deep knowledge of enterprise wireless networking, including RF fundamentals, industry standards, site surveys, high-density design, roaming, security, and troubleshooting.
Strong campus and branch networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, TCP/IP, Layer 2/Layer 3 design, routing, switching, multicast, QoS, ACLs, firewalls, segmentation, and resiliency.
Experience with identity and access technologies including 802.1X, AAA, RADIUS, EAP methods, certificates, SAML, and common client operating systems.
Experience designing and supporting large campus, distributed enterprise, and branch networking environments.
Hands-on experience with wireless design and validation tools such as Ekahau, Hamina, NetAlly, or iBwave.
Familiarity with REST APIs, Python, scripting, automation, cloud integrations, or Infrastructure as Code is highly desirable.
Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
Executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities and customer engagements simultaneously.
Self-motivated, collaborative, and passionate about customer success, technical excellence, and winning as a team.
Ability to travel up to 50% based on customer and business needs.

Preferred Experience And Certifications

Prior experience with HPE Mist, Aruba or another leading enterprise networking platform.
Experience supporting competitive displacement and complex enterprise transformation initiatives.
Relevant industry certifications such as CWNP/CWNE, JNCIP/JNCIE, CCNP/CCIE, CISSP, or equivalent.

You are recognized as the HPE Mist expert that Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and customers trust for their most important campus and branch opportunities. You lead from the front, raise the technical capability of the broader team, and help establish HPE Mist as the best technical solution for modern campus and branch networking.

jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions (AP&S) is responsible for the product development and project management of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. From sales support to campaign execution, delivery, and billing, our division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $7B+ annual advertising business. Together, we’re building the platform that powers the future of advertising at NBCU.

Our Data Collaboration Group, a core part of AP&S, powers the full advertiser lifecycle across insights, measurement, onboarding, activation, and optimization, utilizing various integration pathways including Data Clean Rooms and secure data shares.

Within the Data Collaboration Group, our Engineering & Operations team builds the automation and platform capabilities behind these workflows. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Automation Engineering to join the Engineering & Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Automation Engineering, this role will build AI-enabled automation systems and production-grade software that support NBCUniversal’s data collaboration ecosystem. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Python engineer who can design reliable systems, productize repeatable workflows, and build AI agents that help automate complex engineering and operational tasks across data platforms for audience activation, measurement, and reporting. 

Responsibilities:

AI Agent & Automation Engineering 

Design and build internal AI agents and automation workflows using technologies such as, Snowflake Cortex, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks, to support planning, tool use, retrieval, validation, and human-in-the-loop execution where appropriate. 

Develop reusable tools, APIs, and components that engineers can compose into new agentic workflows. 

Implement retrieval-augmented generation workflows, context management strategies, and prompt patterns that improve accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. 

Agent Evaluation & Reliability 

Build evaluation harnesses, regression tests, and monitoring patterns for AI-agent behavior. 

Define and track metrics such as task completion, groundedness, response accuracy, latency, cost, and failure rate. 

Design guardrails and validation patterns to reduce hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and unreliable automation behavior. 

Partner with engineering and operations teams to move AI workflows from prototype to production-ready systems. 

Software Engineering & Platform Development 

Design, build, and maintain production-grade Python applications, libraries, and services. 

Champion object-oriented design principles, including encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance/composition, reusable interfaces, and clean separation of concerns to improve maintainability and extensibility. 

Champion software engineering best practices including modular design, automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews, observability, and documentation. 

Create reusable engineering patterns that reduce bespoke development effort and improve consistency across partner engagements. 

Collaborate with product, engineering, operations, and data platform teams to translate repeatable business needs into scalable technical solutions. 

Audience & Measurement Productization 

Build reusable Python libraries that support clean room capabilities across first-party audience workflows and core measurement use cases, including audience onboarding, ingestion, indexing, activation, campaign and impression delivery analysis, reach and frequency, attribution, and incrementality. 

Abstract complex analytical and data collaboration workflows into repeatable, self-service components for internal teams and external partners. 

Enable configurable feature deployment so new audience and measurement capabilities can be delivered quickly and consistently across partners. 

Technical Mentorship 

Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical design discussions, and operational best practices. 

Help establish engineering standards for AI-assisted workflows, agentic system design, reusable libraries, and production automation. 

Promote a culture of reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field 

Software Engineering

5+ years of experience building production-grade software using Python, including libraries, services, testing, CI/CD, and code reviews 

AI / LLM Engineering

Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, or frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar tools 

Agentic Systems / Automation 

Experience designing AI-enabled workflows, reasoning agents, tool-using agents, or complex automation systems 

Data Platforms 

3+ years of hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies 

Systems Design 

Strong understanding of production system design, including observability, reliability, scalability, performance tuning, and operational support 

Preferred Qualifications 

Clean Room Knowledge 

Exposure to data clean room concepts or platforms such as Snowflake Clean Rooms, Databricks Clean Rooms, LiveRamp, Habu, or similar technologies 

Ad Tech / Measurement 

Experience with advertising technology, audience activation, campaign delivery, reach and frequency, attribution, incrementality, or reporting workflows 

Certifications 

Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, or similar cloud/data platform certification

Posting Summary

Job Title Assistant Professor, Department of Industrial, Mechatronics & Systems Engineering Division Divison of Academic Affairs Department School of Engineering Work Status Full Time Position Category Faculty Faculty Rank Assistant Professor FLSA Exempt Pay Range Exempt Salary Range $75,000 - $90,000 / year Fund Source State Support Job Summary

Morgan State University is Maryland’s preeminent public urban research university and a designated National Treasure, charting the futures of its residents through educational and research opportunities. Located in the heart of Baltimore, the university serves as an educational and economic engine for local, national, and international communities. Econsult Solutions reports that Morgan State University generated $1.5 billion for the state economy and $891 million for Baltimore in 2024. With a deep commitment to expanding opportunity for groups underrepresented in engineering, the Clarence M. Mitchell Jr. School of Engineering contributes through innovative programs and excellence in teaching, research, and service.

The Department of Industrial, Mechatronics and Systems Engineering (IMSE) was formed through the reorganization of the Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering with the Mechatronics Engineering program. The department offers a Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering, a Bachelor of Science in Mechatronics Engineering, a Master of Engineering, and a Doctor of Philosophy in Industrial Engineering. The Industrial Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET (EAC-ABET), and is the only program of its kind in the State of Maryland. The Mechatronics Engineering program is the only program of its kind offered at an HBCU in the State of Maryland. The Mechatronics program will be seeking initial EAC-ABET accreditation during the upcoming 2027 review cycle.

IMSE invites applications and nominations for a tenure-track faculty position in systems engineering, autonomy, and intelligent systems. The department seeks colleagues who can contribute across both of its undergraduate programs.

The successful candidate will be expected to strengthen the department’s research enterprise by developing a sustainable, externally funded research program at the intersection of systems engineering, autonomous systems, robotics, intelligent cyber-physical systems, and software-intensive engineered systems, while contributing to teaching and curricular development across Industrial Engineering and Mechatronics Engineering.

Job Duties

Develop competitive research proposals and pursue external funding from federal agencies, industry, and other sponsors in areas aligned with systems engineering, autonomous systems, robotics, intelligent cyber-physical systems, artificial intelligence, digital engineering, and cyber-physical security and resilience.

Publish high-quality peer-reviewed research; recruit, advise, and mentor graduate and undergraduate researchers; and contribute to growth in doctoral research activity and research visibility.

Develop and expand experimental platforms, research laboratories, and cyber-physical testbeds that support sponsored research as well as hands-on teaching, laboratory instruction, and course development.

Contribute to undergraduate and graduate instruction in areas aligned with the candidate’s expertise in systems engineering and intelligent cyber-physical systems, while supporting the broader educational needs of the Industrial Engineering and Mechatronics Engineering programs

Advise undergraduate and graduate students

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Other Characteristics

The department is particularly interested in candidates with background and interests in systems engineering, software and information systems engineering, and supply chain and logistics systems, combined with capability in one or more of the following: robotics and autonomous systems, machine perception and computer vision, applied machine learning for engineering systems, and security of cyber-physical systems. Because several of the courses attached to this position are software-intensive, demonstrated strength in software architecture and development for engineered systems is of particular importance.

To support the department’s research growth, additional areas of interest include embodied and edge AI, intelligent control, human-robot teaming, trustworthy AI, cyber-physical security, and digital engineering. Other areas include verification and validation of autonomous systems, systems-of-systems engineering, autonomous manufacturing and logistics, and digital-twin environments, with particular interest in research connecting systems methods to autonomous and cyber-physical platforms.

Experience with model-based systems engineering, digital twins, or simulation of complex engineered systems is welcome. Evidence of the ability to teach effectively across both industrial engineering and mechatronics engineering subject matter is of particular value.

Required Minimum Qualifications

An earned doctorate, held at the time of appointment, in Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Other Preferences for Consideration

Involvement in curriculum and laboratory development

Hands-on laboratory development experience in robotics, embedded systems, or autonomous platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Browser Isolation
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

United States: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Seattle, WA; Washington DC
United Kingdom: London
Portugal: Lisbon

About The Team

Cloudflare Browser Isolation runs web content in remote browsers, helping protect users from threats while preserving a responsive browsing experience. Our team builds the Chromium-based browsing engine, remote rendering and streaming technology, and distributed services that manage browser sessions across Cloudflare’s global network.

You will work at the intersection of systems programming, distributed systems, and security. Engineers contribute across the product, collaborating on browser changes, service orchestration, observability, and build infrastructure.

Scope and growth

At this level, you will be accountable for outcomes across a problem area that may span several components. You will establish technical direction, make uncertainty and trade-offs explicit, and help other engineers succeed while remaining hands-on. This is an individual-contributor role; people-management experience is not required.

Technologies we use

Browser engine: Chromium and C++.
Systems programming: Rust.
Distributed services and orchestration: Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Nomad, and Consul.
Remote rendering and streaming: WebRTC and Skia.
Browser client: TypeScript, WebAssembly, and WebGL.

What You Will Do

Lead complex, multi-component initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, staged rollout, and measurable production outcomes.
Design and implement changes in our Chromium-based C++ browser and the distributed services and systems components supporting remote browsing, working across Go, Rust, and TypeScript.
Make and explain architectural trade-offs across latency, availability, resource efficiency, security boundaries, and operational complexity.
Investigate difficult cross-layer failures and performance bottlenecks, distinguishing browser, host, network, and control-plane causes.
Improve resilience, capacity management, observability, and release safety; define success metrics and validate results.
Coordinate work with partner teams, surface dependencies and risks early, and guide delivery through ambiguity.
Mentor engineers and raise the quality of code reviews, design reviews, testing, documentation, and operational practices.
Participate in the team’s production on-call rotation after onboarding, lead technical incident investigations as needed, and drive durable corrective actions.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Strong production C++ proficiency, including memory and resource ownership, concurrency, and debugging in substantial codebases.
A track record of independently leading complex systems or distributed-service improvements across multiple components, from an unclear problem to a reliable production outcome.
Strong Linux/UNIX and networking fundamentals, with experience diagnosing correctness, latency, and resource-consumption issues using profiling and operational evidence.
Experience designing and operating distributed systems, with sound judgment about service boundaries, data partitioning, consistency, timeouts and retries, backpressure, capacity limits, and recovery from partial failures.
Experience designing safe rollout and recovery strategies and maintaining production software over its lifecycle.
Ability to communicate trade-offs clearly, align stakeholders, mentor teammates, and improve engineering practices through constructive feedback.
A willingness to work across C++, Rust, Go, and TypeScript and learn unfamiliar parts of the stack.

Bonus Points

These are preferred qualifications, not prerequisites. Prior Browser Isolation or Cloudflare experience is not required.

Browser engines, Chromium, browser sandboxing, or security-sensitive systems.
Low-latency streaming, graphics, remote computing, or other real-time systems.
Container and workload orchestration, including Nomad or Kubernetes, and service discovery.
Experience using Rust for systems programming or distributed services.
Go or TypeScript; WebRTC, Skia, WebAssembly, or WebGL.
Production observability, capacity planning, incident response, or build and release infrastructure.

Compensation

For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000
For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000
For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000
For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.

The final offer will be in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.

Applications will be accepted until November 25, 2026.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance

Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

If you love high profile and challenging programs and Marine Engineering projects supporting the U.S. Navy and commercial customers – Serco has a great opportunity for you.

Serco is looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Senior Electrical Engineer to join our dynamic Maritime Engineering Operation (MEO) and to support the design of ships and ship systems at our Arlington, Virginia location. The MEO team leverages its corporate knowledge to conceive, design, construct, support and evaluate high-performance maritime systems for a variety of customers. As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will be part of a dynamic multi-disciplinary team that works closely with the customer and other Serco teams in an integrated design environment to deliver high quality designs to schedule.
