**The Role**
============

The Mechatronics Engineer is a professional engineering position responsible for researching, designing, developing, and testing automation, intelligent systems, and industrial control systems used in Schweid & Sons’ food manufacturing operations. Applying principles of mechanical, electrical, controls, and engineering, the Mechatronics Engineer designs and implements automated solutions and electromechanical and control-system improvements that increase the reliability, safety, quality, and throughput of production and facility systems. The position leads engineering analysis of equipment performance and failures, and provides technical direction to maintenance technicians and contractors in implementing engineered solutions.

**What You’ll Work On**
=======================

* **Automation Design.** Design, develop, and implement engineering systems and control solutions for the automation of industrial tasks, including the automated transfer, handling, processing, and packaging of materials, components, and finished goods.
* **Controls Engineering.** Design, develop, program, and implement control circuits, algorithms, and PLC, HMI, servo, and motion-control programs for electromechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic devices and systems.
* **Component Selection.** Research, select, and apply sensors, communication technologies, industrial networks, and control devices for motion control, position sensing, pressure sensing, and electronic communication, and identify materials appropriate for mechatronic system designs, including sanitary-design requirements.
* **Equipment Upgrades and Design Documentation.** Upgrade the design of existing production equipment by adding mechatronic elements; create mechanical design documents, electrical drawings, and specifications for parts, assemblies, and modifications using computer-aided design (CAD) software.
* **Modeling, Testing, and Commissioning.** Create models or simulations to evaluate mechatronic design concepts; implement, test, and commission design solutions; and document qualification test results before release to production.
* **Feasibility and Cost Analysis.** Determine the feasibility, costs, and performance benefits of new mechatronic equipment and capital or continuous-improvement projects; prepare engineering cost estimates and project justifications, and monitor project and equipment-related costs against budget.
* **Engineering Analysis and Process Improvement.** Analyze existing manufacturing procedures and equipment performance, downtime, and failure data; lead engineering root-cause analysis; and recommend and implement design or process improvements that increase reliability, safety, quality, throughput, and maintainability.
* **Calibration and Optimization.** Monitor and calibrate automated systems, industrial control systems, and system components to maximize efficiency of production.
* **Reliability Engineering.** Define the engineering requirements of preventive and predictive maintenance programs for automated production equipment, utilities, and facility systems; evaluate equipment condition and lifecycle; and recommend repairs, replacements, upgrades, and lifecycle plans.
* **Technical Troubleshooting Support.** Provide engineering support in diagnosing complex mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, instrumentation, robotics, PLC, HMI, servo, sensor, and controls failures, and direct the restoration of safe operation to minimize downtime.
* **Technical Direction and Training.** Provide technical guidance, consultation, and training on mechatronics and automated control to maintenance technicians, operations personnel, and management; assign, schedule, and review the technical work of maintenance technicians in accordance with company policies.
* **Contractor Oversight.** Oversee the work of contractors, integrators, and vendors in accordance with project requirements, including scope, specifications, schedule, safe work practices, quality, and acceptance testing.
* **Technical Records.** Maintain technical project files and publish engineering reports documenting design details; maintain electrical drawings, control-program backups, technical documentation, spare-parts specifications, and standard operating procedures.
* **Standards and Compliance.** Ensure designs and work comply with applicable electrical and mechanical codes and standards, workplace safety requirements (including lockout/tagout), food-safety and sanitary-design practices, company procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration.** Partner with Operations, Quality, Safety, and vendors to define equipment requirements, prioritize engineering work, and plan shutdowns and project execution.
* **On-Call Engineering Support.** Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours engineering support when required by operational needs.
* Complete additional responsibilities as assigned, consistent with the professional engineering nature of the position.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent (including a Mexican licenciatura or Canadian baccalaureate degree), in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation or Controls Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
* At least 3 years of professional engineering experience designing, programming, testing, or improving automated manufacturing equipment, including PLC-controlled electromechanical systems.
* At least 2 years of experience leading technical project tea

**Who is Rainforest?**

Rainforest is an early stage payments-as-a-service startup that has developed a solution that makes monetizing payments for vertically focused software platforms fair and simple.

We focus on small-to-mid sized platforms that want to add value to their small business customers through embedded payments — and want to do so without adding operational or regulatory burdens or costs.

Led by a successful repeat fintech founder with deep knowledge of the industry, and with venture backing from a Top 10 VC firm, Rainforest is well positioned to make an impact in the payments-as-a-service space, and we're looking for new team members who want to be a part of this journey!

**Who are we looking for?**

We're looking for a hands-on Software Engineer to help build agentic products for our customers. You've spent the last couple of years building agent harnesses on top of commercial LLMs, and you've seen what happens once those systems run in production for months. You’ve worked end-to-end, from scoping the work to shipping it and keeping it reliable as usage grows. If you're excited about bringing that experience to payments and helping shape a new product and team from day one, you'll feel right at home at Rainforest.

We seek innovators, hackers, and pioneers who can both get-stuff-done and collaborate effectively with development peers. Your first focus will be customer-facing agentic products that vertical SaaS companies can embed in their business, the same way they embed our payments components in their software.

**What are some of the high-impact opportunities you’ll tackle?**

* Building and evolving the agent harness behind our customer-facing and internal agentic products, taking them from a working prototype to a production product used by many customers
* Turning Rainforest's payments expertise into the skills, knowledge base, and runbooks agents can use to handle specific situations
* Building agentic connectors with MCP
* Managing data retention and security with AWS Bedrock AgentCore products
* Enforcing policy at the harness level so every action Rainforest’s agent attempts is checked against clear rules before it runs
* Anticipating the problems that show up at scale
* Building internal agents for teams across Rainforest, starting with our Risk team
* Scoping and leading projects within the squad and partnering closely with an incoming product manager

**This opportunity is for you if you have / are:**

* Hands-on experience building agentic products that run in production
* Experience building agent harnesses on commercial LLMs, ideally Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI models
* Strong working knowledge of persistent memory, tool and skill design, and multi-step task execution
* Experience building MCP servers or similar tool integrations, including authentication and permissioning for agents acting on a user's behalf
* 6+ years of software engineering experience, with the last 2 years focused on agentic or LLM-based systems
* Comfort working as an individual contributor who scopes and leads projects without direct reports
* Ability to work from our Atlanta HQ on Tuesdays and Wednesdays
* Experience with AWS, Bedrock AgentCore, or open-weight models (a plus)
* Payments or fintech experience (a plus, and our team can teach you the domain)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience

jobs.title: Thermal and Fluid Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position utilizes the core competencies of thermal and fluid sciences, using and advancing analytical and experimental approaches to answer key questions about the performance and architecture of a system or component. This drives decisions and creates technical content which ultimately leads to state of the art, highly effective, environmentally friendly, and competitive products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product, system, and/or technology problems that are related to thermal and fluid sciences, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and supports the improvement of processes such as Pre Program Planning, (PPP), Product Preceding Technology, (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), or Value Package Change, (VPC), Engineering Standard Work, (ESW), Functional Excellence Practice (FEP) and tools related to thermal and fluid sciences such as GT-Suite, Boost, Fluent, Converge, Concerto, CyberApps (virtual application model), Cummins Data Analysis Tool (CDAT), Mach, test data calculation, DARTS, test data storage, Calterm, Electronic Control Module (ECM) calibration tool, Emissions data system, Integrity, and ACCEPTS ECM in-loop test bench required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input and negotiates with immediate stakeholders, such as team members, technical managers, project leaders, other Thermal Sciences engineers, product and manufacturing engineers, and supplier partners and delivers information and recommendations to support project decisions, or to provide input related to further analysis, design optimization, feasibility studies, or architecture definition. Makes decisions in the areas of day to day project details, such as conducting analysis, testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful progression of projects. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Applies Principles of Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer - Interprets and predicts the performance of fluid and thermal systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of the flow of liquids and gases, the transfer of thermal energy between elements of a system, and the application of modeling and experimental tools, to answer key questions about the system or component.

Applies Principles of Thermodynamics and Energy Conversion Systems - Interprets and predicts the performance of energy conversion systems such as IC engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, and batteries, by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, modeling tools, controls, and experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Broadband CPE
jobs.description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview  
T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.  
  
You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.  
  
Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and maintain one or more microservices within the device management agent, in C and C++ on RDK-B.
* Implement and maintain device data model parameters and USP protocol behavior across supported hardware platforms.
* Interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS to configure them, query state, and report it upstream.
* Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.
* Write unit tests for new and changed code and extend our automated test coverage.
* Debug across the device software stack, from log analysis and root cause investigation through to fix verification.
* Support device maintenance releases, including test support, firmware validation, and release verification.
* Work with OEM partners on defect triage and reproduction.
* Improve how we collect data and logs from the field so issues can be triaged and resolved faster.
* Contribute ideas that improve how we build, test, and deliver device software.
* Document your code, the data model and device behavior.

**Job Summary**

This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.
* Collaborate with technical teams to deliver effective technical solutions and continuously learn new technologies, including supporting software debugging, testing, release verification, and defect investigation with OEM partners.
* Create clear documentation for software code, system designs, and business requirements, including device data models and software behavior.
* Contribute to technology strategy by understanding current technologies and supporting business goals, including improvements to device software testing, diagnostics, and development processes.
* Present innovative ideas to improve systems, processes, or services based on industry research, including improvements to device software reliability and troubleshooting.
* Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

The Systems Engineer is the lead technical resource for our Lenexa, KS location. This person owns IT at the site from end to end: the local network, servers, desktops, printers, and the software used in production and in the office. Beyond the site, they help look after the company-wide network and cloud environment, and triage incoming IT support requests, resolving them directly or routing them to the right team. This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable at a user's desk as in a server room or working a support queue.

**Location IT Ownership**

* Serve as the primary on-site IT resource for the Lenexa location, owning its network, servers, desktops, and software.
* Build, configure, and maintain on-site servers, including setup, patching, backups, and hardware replacement.
* Manage the location network, including switches, firewalls, wireless, cabling, and internet connectivity.
* Install, configure, and support location software, including production, prepress, and print-related applications.
* Manage IT equipment for the site, including inventory, setup, and retirement, and provide input on purchases.
* Work with vendors and service providers to resolve site issues and coordinate repairs.

**Desktop and End-User Support**

* Provide hands-on support for desktops, laptops, printers, phones, mobile devices, and peripherals.
* Set up and image new computers, and handle user onboarding and offboarding, including accounts, access, and equipment.
* Troubleshoot operating system, Microsoft 365, and business application issues for on-site and remote users.
* Guide and train users on the effective use of company technology.

**Service Desk and Support Triage**

* Monitor the IT support queue, triage incoming requests, and set priorities.
* Resolve issues directly where possible, and route others to the right internal team or vendor with clear notes.
* Act as an escalation point for complex technical problems.
* Track tickets through to resolution and keep users informed.
* Spot recurring issues and fix the underlying cause, not just the symptom.

**Company Network and Infrastructure**

* Help maintain the company-wide network, including multi-site connectivity, VPN, and remote access.
* Support cloud infrastructure and services, including Microsoft 365, Azure, and identity management.
* Support network and security appliances such as firewalls, load balancers, and web application firewalls.
* Monitor system health, performance, and availability, and respond to alerts and outages.
* Carry out patching, upgrades, and technology refresh work across servers and endpoints.

**Security, Backup and Continuity**

* Maintain endpoint protection, user access controls, and security best practices.
* Manage backups and help test disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Take part in security incident response and remediation.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain documentation for systems, network diagrams, configurations, and procedures.
* Provide status updates and ad hoc reports to management.
* Take part in after-hours maintenance and on-call support as needed.

Requirements:

**Education and Experience:**

* 3+ years of IT experience covering desktop support, systems administration, and networking.
* Experience as the main IT resource for a site or small team preferred.
* Experience supporting manufacturing, printing, or production environments is a plus.
* Technical certifications preferred.

**Qualifications, Skills, Abilities and Competencies:**

**Technical Skills**

* Windows desktop and server administration, including building and maintaining servers.
* Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and cloud identity administration.
* Networking, including switching, routing, firewalls, wireless, VPN, and remote access.
* Virtualization, backup, and recovery tools.
* Cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Endpoint management and security tools.
* Help desk and ticketing systems.
* PowerShell or other scripting experience is a plus.
* Basic SQL knowledge is a plus.

**Competencies**

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service with users at all technical levels.
* Able to explain technical issues in plain language, to individuals and to groups.
* Able to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently as the on-site IT lead, while collaborating with the wider IT team.
* Keeps clear and accurate documentation.
* Contributes to a strong, positive team spirit and aligns with GSP values.

**Physical Demands:**

* Work on site at the Lenexa location, in both office and manufacturing areas.
* Occasional travel to other company locations as needed.
* Extended periods of computer work.
* Lift and move equipment up to 50 pounds.
* Stand, walk, bend, kneel, and reach when installing or servicing equipment.

------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

Ford Energy is a newly formed, wholly-owned subsidiary of Ford Motor Company dedicated to accelerating U.S. energy independence. Leveraging Ford’s century of manufacturing excellence and world-class battery energy storage systems (BESS) technology, Ford Energy designs, manufactures, and services grid-scale and commercial DC battery energy storage systems (BESS). COURSER is a partnership platform that helps technology service companies identify and take the next step in growth. jobs.description:
**Description**

Would you be excited to build communications/networking architectures across hardware/firmware/software boundaries?

Are you interested in trying novel, creative, and risky approaches for communications systems to solve and overcome mission critical challenges?

Would you enjoy rapid prototyping of ideas on both novel and deployed RF hardware/systems?

If so, we’re looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

The Networked Systems and Integrated Fires group is seeking a Communications Systems Engineer to contribute to communications system design, implementation, hardware test/evaluation, firmware, real-time embedded software, and more. As part of our team, you will make critical contributions to both new and legacy communications systems and work on a variety of projects in a fast-paced team environment.

**As a Communications Systems Engineer, you will:**

* Work with multi-disciplinary teams in designing, implementing, and analyzing systems/algorithms for future resilient, secure, and adaptive communications networks operating in highly contested environments
* Develop FPGA firmware (VHDL) from concept through implementation, evaluation, and deployment
* Contribute to MATLAB modeling and simulation
* Validate and analyze performance of prototypes and tactical systems against complex operational scenarios
* Work as part of a team to design novel solutions and approaches for size/weight/power/cost (SWaP-C) constrained communications concepts
* Provide status updates, analysis results, and algorithms in written reports and in presentations to internal APL staff, program contractors, and government sponsors
* Support occasional field tests for hardware testing

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you…**

* Have a BS degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Have 3+ years of experience in FPGA/firmware development in VHDL or Verilog
* Have demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team
* Can effectively communicate ideas and results
* Have professional experience in at least **one** of the following:
* Implementing digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms on FPGA
* C/C++ embedded programming on FPGA System-on-Chip (SoC) devices
* RF systems link analysis or communications algorithm modeling/simulation in Python or MATLAB
* Strong knowledge of RF (Radio Frequency) hardware design/test principles, with hands-on experience using test equipment
* Are able to obtain an Interim Secret security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Secret security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You’ll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you…**

* Have a MS degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Have experience implementing advanced concepts on FPGA such as adaptive filtering techniques, error correction codes, etc.
* Have hands-on experience implementing high speed ADC/DAC interfaces on FPGA
* Have experience with current military links (e.g. CDL, Link 16 / MIDS)
* Have an active Top Secret security clearance

  
  
**About Us**

**Why Work at APL?**

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

**What we need**

Symbotic’s vision is automation at large scale, carried by physical AI. It starts in the warehouse, where robots see, decide, and move goods at extraordinary speed and density — and extends to new platforms and applications still taking shape. As that vision grows, so does the challenge: turning intelligence into physical action through the power, sensing, compute, harnesses, and electrical integration that bring Physical AI to life.

Symbotic is seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to drive electrical design for automated material-handling robots and related platforms. In this role you will lead the conceptualization, architecture, design, analysis, fabrication, integration, and test of complex electrical systems — not only PCBAs and cables, but the full bot-level electrical system — from concept through production.

You will set technical direction for other electrical designers, work through Symbotic’s Product Development Process (PDP), and partner with PLM and contract manufacturers so designs can be built, qualified, and released at volume.

**What we do**

The Electrical Engineering – Bot Hardware team is part of Symbotic’s Hardware Engineering organization and develops the electrical hardware that powers and connects our robotic systems. Our team designs PCB-based electronics, harnesses, and electrical interfaces that support power distribution, sensing, compute, communications, and control across our automation platforms. We partner closely with mechanical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and other engineering teams to integrate these designs into reliable, manufacturable robotic products and support them from development through production.

**What you'll do**

* Lead technical solutions to complex electrical problems that require regular ingenuity and creativity, at board, harness, and system-integration level (power, sensing, compute, interconnect, grounding, and interfaces to mechanical, firmware, and controls).
* Drive designs from concept through production: architecture, schematic, PCB layout, prototype, DVT, design freeze, production release, and sustaining.
* Follow and lead others through the PDP — phase gates, design reviews, requirements, verification, and release discipline — so the team ships on a repeatable path.
* Design schematics and PCB layouts in Altium — not layout guidance only. Own stackup, placement, routing, SI/PI, EMC-aware layout, and DFM through release.
* Apply DfX (DFM, DFA, DFT, DFS, and related) so designs are manufacturable, testable, serviceable, and cost-capable at the contract manufacturer.
* Work in PLM (BOMs, ECOs/ECNs, item and document release) and with contract manufacturers to enable builds, first article, and production ramp.
* Write requirements and test plans; plan and execute the testing needed to validate safety, function, and robustness of the design, including support of EMC/EMI bring-up and mitigation.
* Investigate issues and failures in the lab and at customer or manufacturing sites; lead containment and corrective design when the product is in the field or in ramp.
* Research and qualify electro-mechanical components (connectors, sensors, power devices, compute modules) for robotics / automation / automotive-class environments.
* Mentor electrical designers and raise the bar on reviews, documentation, and release quality.
* Travel to customer sites, CMs, and test houses to support bring-up, installation, and failure analysis as required.

**What you'll need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; advanced degree a plus.
* 12+ years of electrical design experience, with a record of taking products from concept to production.
* Expertise in Altium schematic capture and strong PCB layout design (or equivalent high-end ECAD with demonstrated willingness to work in Altium).
* Expertise in automation robotics and/or automotive platforms — mobile robots, AGVs/AMRs, or automotive electronic systems in harsh electrical and mechanical environments.
* Demonstrated system-level integration of electronics, not PCBA- or cable-only ownership: interconnect, grounding, power distribution, sensors, and partner-subsystem interfaces.
* Working knowledge of safety standards applied to automation and robotic platforms (ability to work with Functional Safety and interpret product safety requirements; prior SIL / ISO 13849 / IEC 61508 or equivalent experience a plus).
* Working knowledge of EMC/EMI and best design practices (grounding, filtering, shielding, return paths, cable and enclosure effects) and ability to debug to a passing result.
* Expertise in DfX and a track record of designs that contract manufacturers can build and test at volume.
* Familiar with a formal PDP / phase-gate process and able both to follow it and to lead a team through it.
* Familiar with PLM and with working through contract manufacturers to enable production (BOMs, ECOs, first article, process feedback).
* Ability to work in a results-oriented, project-driven team, prioritize across programs, and deliver quality under tight constraints.
* Strong interpersonal skills; works collaboratively with mechanical, firmware, test, operations, safety, and supply chain.

**Physical and Environment Requirements**

* Wilmington, MA (lab and cross-functional presence).
* 10% Travel to customer sites, CMs, and test facilities as required.

Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.

===================

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

  

**In this position...**

This position serves as an **Embedded Software Engineer** for Audio Management frameworks within Ford’s next-generation infotainment products. You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and validation of audio software features across the software life cycle. You will work with domain architects, senior engineers, and distributed software teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-quality audio solutions for Ford infotainment platforms.

**What you'll do...**

* Develop and integrate software for the Android platform audio domain, including custom AOSP framework modifications and Ford-specific SDK platform components.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of Android Audio HAL (HIDL/AIDL), Audio Policy, and Linux Kernel audio driver interfaces such as ALSA/ASoC on automotive System-on-Chip platforms.
* Support end-to-end audio quality improvements by working with partner teams, test teams, and automation stakeholders.
* Participate in audio solution development for virtualized or multi-OS environments, including integration with QNX, Automotive Linux, or related real-time operating system components.
* Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and engineering best practices to support high-quality software delivery.
* Collaborate with domain architects and technology partners to develop solutions for the Ford Infotainment System audio platform.
* Perform root cause analysis for software defects, integration issues, and system stability concerns.
* Participate in optimization of boot-up performance, system responsiveness, and resource usage.

**You'll have...**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related.
* **Three or more years** of experience in software development on Android AOSP using C++/Java/Kotlin or related languages for automotive, embedded, mobile, or consumer electronic platforms.
* **Two or more years** of experience with Android audio framework, media application development, Android System Services, audio focus management, or related embedded audio software components.
* **One or more years** of experience with in-vehicle signaling mechanisms such as CAN, Ethernet, or related automotive communication technologies.
* **Must be willing to work on a hybrid schedule requiring in-office presence for 4+ days per week.**

**Even better, you may have...**

* Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science.
* Experience with Android Audio HAL development, Audio Policy, or Linux audio integration such as ALSA/ASoC.
* Experience working with Hypervisor-based virtualization architectures, QNX, Automotive Linux, or equivalent embedded environments.
* Working knowledge of the Android OS stack, including HAL, VHAL, Android System Applications and Services, and Android Framework layers.
* Exposure to audio transport methods and standards such as A2B or EAVB.
* Exposure to AI prompt engineering to enhance software development workflows and productivity.

jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

**Senior Controls Engineer – Motion Controls Architecture**

We are currently seeking a **Senior Controls Engineer** motivated by the application of control theory to achieve desired powertrain performance and vehicle dynamics.  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to architect and design control systems that help elevate vehicle ride and handling attributes via the actuation of motors, brakes, steering and the suspension system.  
Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and approaches problem solving with vigor and determination. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to learn quickly and to strive for perfection within a fast-paced environment.

**The Role:**

* Application of concepts in control theory to a variety of domains like vehicle longitudinal dynamics, handling dynamics, ride dynamics and NVH to achieve desired vehicle attributes

* Application of digital signal processing, digital controls and communication protocols to arrive at the best possible controls architecture on hardware and in software

* Employ linear analysis techniques and frequency domain analysis

* Perform system analysis of the controls architecture to identify noise factors and potential failure modes

* Develop requirements and related test cases for features modeled in Matlab/Simulink

* Assist integration of features into the controller code base

* Occasional travel for vehicle testing
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Minimum 4 years of experience with control systems

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automotive systems, or other related technical fields is required

* Good knowledge of model-based design using Matlab/Simulink/Stateflow

* Good understanding of vehicle handling and ride dynamics

* Good understanding of state estimation and sensor fusion techniques

* Expertise in control theory concepts like classical control theory, modern control theory, MRAC, non-linear control theory, robust control

* Working knowledge of powertrain hardware such as motors, gear reductions, shafts, etc.

* Working knowledge of chassis hardware such as dampers, springs, anti-roll bars, brakes, steering etc.
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with Embedded coder in Matlab/Simulink

* Experience with rapid prototyping tools such as dSpace

* Experience in working with cross functional teams

jobs.description:
**Position Description:**
  
We are seeking an experienced Android Full-Stack Engineer to join our platform stability team. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing, debugging, and resolving complex Android stability issues spanning the entire Android stack both above (System Partition) and below (Vendor Partition) the Treble boundary. You will work deep within Android framework internals, reverse-engineering issues from source code, providing technical direction for ambiguous problems, and ensuring overall platform robustness across Android version upgrades. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who thrives on solving the hardest, least-understanding problems in the Android ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop middleware and Android background services for platform-level functionality
* Debug and reverse-engineer complex issues directly from Android Open-Source Project (AOSP) source code Own overall Android platform stability and reliability
* Resolve Android upgrade and integration issues across releases
* Diagnose and fix bugs in system server components (Activity Manager, Window Manager, Package Manager, etc.), Car Service, and Surface Flinger
* Investigate and resolve black screen, boot failure, and ANR (Application Not Responding) issues 6. Resolve and provide technical direction and root-cause analysis for unknown or hard-to-reproduce issues
* Address and resolve compliance test failures across CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS

**Primary Skills Required:** Kotlin, C++ and Java

**Experience Required:**

* 3+ years of hands-on Android platform/framework development experience.
* Proven experience in designing and developing middleware and Android background services (long-running/foreground service) that expose feature-rich interfaces (AIDL/Binder, APIs) to applications.
* Demonstrated track record of resolving complex, low-level Android stability issues.
* Experience contributing to or modifying AOSP source code
* Proven experience working across the full Android stack (framework, native services, vendor layers)

**Additional Experience Preferred:**

* Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and Car Service.
* Familiarity with HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) and vendor integration.
* Experience with CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of Android graphics stack and display subsystems
* Experience with native debugging tools (gdb, lldb, perfetto, systrace, logcat analysis).
* Familiarity with Android build systems (Soong/Make) and partition architecture.
* Experience working with SoC/silicon vendors on platform bring-up

**Additional Context for Suppliers:**

* This role requires a deep-dive, problem-solving mindset and the ability to operate independently on ambiguous, high-impact issues.
* The ideal candidate is comfortable being the technical authority for the most challenging stability problems and can provide direction for other engineers.
* Experience in the automotive or embedded Android domain is a strong plus given to our focus on system server, car service and platform stability.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Systems Engineer** is an entry-level engineering position supporting the development, integration, and validation of automotive 12V electrical systems and components.

In this role, you will work closely with experienced system, component, and validation engineers to set up, coordinate, perform, monitor, and document both vehicle-level and laboratory validation testing. Key responsibilities include preparing engineering work orders, supporting the development of validation test plans and procedures, collecting and analyzing empirical test data, and assisting with the root-cause investigation and resolution of vehicle electrical system issues.

This position covers components and subsystems within the low-voltage power domain, including:

* 12V lead-acid batteries (Flooded and AGM technologies)
* Alternators and intelligent charging systems
* DC/AC power inverters
* Battery Monitoring Sensors (BMS) and smart sensing devices
* Power control relays and related power switching hardware

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

### **Systems Integration & Laboratory Validation**

* **Validation Setup & Testing:** Set up, execute, and monitor laboratory bench tests and vehicle-level validation procedures for 12V power components and systems.
* **Documentation & Work Orders:** Prepare engineering work orders (EWOs), author test reports, and document detailed validation results against technical performance specifications.
* **Data Collection & Analysis:** Collect, process, and analyze electrical measurement data (voltage, current, thermal, network signal logs) to verify functional compliance.

### **Root-Cause Analysis & Issue Resolution**

* **Troubleshooting:** Assist lead engineers with identifying, logging, and resolving electrical system anomalies, parasitic draws, and communication errors during vehicle testing.
* **Requirements & Test Plan Support:** Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously refine test procedures, acceptance criteria, and environmental test profiles.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited university.
* **Experience Level:** 0–2 years of engineering experience (entry-level or applicable engineering internship/co-op experience).
* **Technical Fundamentals:**

  + Fundamental understanding of electrical circuits, Ohm's law, DC power distribution, and component-level electronics.
  + Hands-on experience with standard electrical measurement equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, current clamps, data acquisition systems).
  + Interest or background in automotive 12V power management, battery technology, and charging logic.
* **Core Skills:**

  + Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  + Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documenting technical reports.
  + High accountability and eager to learn in a hands-on, fast-paced vehicle testing environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with automotive vehicle testing, bench testing, or vehicle electrical troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with automotive vehicle communication networks (CAN, LIN).
* Knowledge of lead-acid battery chemistries (Flooded/AGM), charging strategies, or DC/AC power conversion.
* Experience writing or executing test plans and validation scripts.
* Background in MATLAB, Python, CANoe/CANalyzer, or similar data analysis and signal-logging tools.

jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

Lead the design, development, board layout, testing, and system integration of complex printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) and custom hardware components.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Hardware Architecture & Circuit Design: Design digital, analog, mixed-signal, and power distribution hardware architectures. Select components, perform worst-case analyses, use design tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad.

· System Design and Integration: Inform design and product management using application requirements for target markets, competing and complimentary power electronics products, and downstream system standards and requirements.

· PCB Layout & Routing: Perform or directly supervise multi-layer PCB layouts, taking into account signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), thermal management, and strict Design for Manufacturing/Assembly (DFM/DFA) guidelines.

· Prototyping & Board Bring-Up: Lead hands-on assembly, testing, debugging, and verification of initial hardware prototypes using laboratory equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, dynamic loads).

· Firmware & Software Collaboration: Partner closely with embedded firmware, software, and mechanical engineering teams to define interface protocols, pinouts, mechanical enclosures, and system test points.

· Regulatory & Compliance: Design for Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC/EMI), ESD protection, and environmental compliance (UL, CE, FCC, RoHS). Prepare and support hardware for third-party compliance testing.

· Manufacturing & Supply Chain Support: Generate comprehensive manufacturing documentation (Gerber files, drill charts, BOMs, schematic PDF packages, assembly drawings). Collaborate with vendors and contract manufacturers (CMs) to resolve component obsolescence or DFM issues.

· Collaboration & Quality Standards: Establish and promote internal hardware design standards, review peer schematics and PCB layouts, work with support teams to perform analysis and troubleshooting on products in the field, and mentor junior engineers.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE), Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

· 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in electronics engineering and hardware development.

· Proven track record of designing, layout routing, and releasing multi-layer PCBs (4+ layers, high-speed routing, controlled impedance, thermal management, and/or rigid-flex experience preferred).

· Proficiency in industry-standard schematic capture and PCB layout tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, KiCAD, PADS).

· Advanced proficiency with bench tools including digital storage oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and precision multimeters.

· Solid understanding of common hardware protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet, USB, PCIe) and power supply architectures (buck/boost regulators, LDOs, battery management).

· Demonstrated understanding of IPC standards (IPC-2221, IPC-A-610), manufacturing processes, component sourcing, and Gerber generation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

● Experience with wireless standard implementations (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, LoRa, or Cellular hardware integration).

● Knowledge of signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) simulation tools (e.g., Ansys, HyperLynx).

● Scripting capability (Python, C/C++) for laboratory test automation and hardware validation.

● Prior experience working in regulated industries (automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or energy storage).

Pay: $115,000.00 - $175,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Robotics Engineer**

*Robotic Manipulation and Embodied AI*

Richtech Robotics is seeking a Robotics Engineer to develop and deploy autonomous robotic systems. This role combines strong robotics fundamentals with hands-on experience in vision-guided manipulation, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and world models. You will own complete workflows, from perception and motion planning to execution on real hardware, and improve their accuracy, reliability, and ability to handle changing conditions.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop manipulation workflows for grasping, pick-and-place, assembly, and interaction with equipment.
* Implement and optimize forward and inverse kinematics (IK), coordinate transforms, motion planning, collision avoidance, and trajectory execution; resolve reachability, singularity, and joint-limit issues.
* Build vision-guided robotics pipelines using RGB or depth cameras, object detection, segmentation, 6D pose estimation, camera calibration, hand-eye calibration, and tool center point (TCP) calibration.
* Integrate robot arms, grippers, cameras, sensors, and device APIs into reliable systems with feedback, fault handling, and recovery.
* Collect and prepare robot demonstration data; train or fine-tune VLA policies and evaluate their performance in simulation and on physical robots.
* Develop and evaluate world models or learned dynamics models for predicting action outcomes, planning, or improving robot learning.
* Measure task success, positioning error, cycle time, and robustness; diagnose failures across perception, calibration, control, and learned policies, and support deployment.

**Required qualifications**

* Master's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field
* Demonstrated ownership of working robotic manipulation systems deployed and tested on physical hardware.
* Strong understanding of kinematics, rigid-body transformations, robot control, motion planning, and the relationship between perception accuracy and manipulation performance.
* Hands-on experience with vision-guided robotics, including calibration and converting camera observations into executable robot motions.
* Practical VLA experience covering dataset preparation, model training or fine-tuning, inference integration, and evaluation beyond a pretrained demo.
* Hands-on experience implementing or adapting world models or learned dynamics models, with experiments that assess their usefulness for robotics tasks.
* Strong Python and C++ skills, experience with ROS 2 and Linux, and proficiency with PyTorch or an equivalent learning framework.
* Ability to turn research into tested implementations, debug across software and hardware, and document results clearly.

**Preferred experience**

Experience with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or equivalent simulators; simulation-to-real transfer; imitation or reinforcement learning; force or impedance control; and mobile or dual-arm manipulation.

**Application materials:** Please include project examples, videos, code, or publications that show your individual contribution, the hardware used, measured results, and how you resolved failures.

jobs.title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer

Install, commission, service, and troubleshoot advanced industrial X-ray inspection systems — in-house and at customer sites worldwide. You'll be the primary technical contact for customers, working with a cross-disciplinary engineering team (mechanical, electrical, software, imaging) to keep high-voltage systems running safely and reliably.

**What You'll Do**

* Install and commission industrial X-ray systems: setup, beam alignment, geometric calibration, detector integration
* Commission microfocus open-tube systems — tube conditioning, vacuum validation — plus imaging software and CT acquisition setup
* Run Factory and Site Acceptance Testing (FAT/SAT)
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on microfocus X-ray sources, high-voltage generators (90kV–450kV), and LINAC systems, plus HV power supplies, cooling, vacuum, and motion subsystems
* Diagnose arcing, beam instability, focal spot drift, vacuum failures, and HV breakdown; perform root cause analysis and corrective action
* Troubleshoot HV, control, and electromechanical subsystems using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and diagnostic software
* Handle radiation safety: surveys, leakage testing, interlock verification, regulatory inspection support
* Train customer operators and maintenance staff; provide phone/email/remote support; maintain service documentation
Support system upgrades and retrofits  

**Must-Haves**

* Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or related field
* 5+ years servicing industrial X-ray systems, high-voltage systems, and/or vacuum technology
* Hands-on experience with at least one of: microfocus X-ray sources, HV generators (90kV–450kV), or LINAC systems
* Ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings
* Diagnostic tool experience (oscilloscopes, digital multimeters)
* Working knowledge of radiation safety practices and regulatory compliance
* U.S. citizen, able to pass background/security checks for government and military site clearance
* Clean, valid driver's license; able to pass a drug test
* Comfortable lifting/installing components of 55+ lbs and working around high-voltage and radiation-generating equipment
  

  

**Nice-to-Haves**

* NDT, DR, or CT inspection system service experience
* Vacuum systems (turbo/roughing pumps), motion control, or industrial automation
* CE/UL regulatory compliance; LINAC RF/accelerator systems

jobs.description:
### **Position Snapshot**

* **Job Title:** Senior Ecommerce Systems Engineer
* **Department:** Ecommerce Technology / Business Systems
* **Location:** On-site in Inwood, NY, directly across the Queens border from Far Rockaway and minutes from the Far Rockaway-Mott Avenue A train terminal
* **Schedule:** Full-time, Monday-Friday, onsite 5 days per week
* **Compensation:** Proposed $115,000-$145,000 per year, based on directly relevant experience and technical expertise
* **Role Type:** Senior-level technical individual contributor focused on ecommerce systems engineering, integrations, AI enablement, automation, and operational efficiency

Rockville is seeking a **Senior Ecommerce Systems Engineer** to optimize, integrate, and automate the technology powering our growing multichannel ecommerce business.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role for someone with deep **Descartes Sellercloud expertise**, strong software development and API integration capabilities, and demonstrated success implementing AI-powered solutions in real business environments.

The right person understands both the technology and the business processes behind ecommerce operations. We need someone who can investigate complex system issues, write and debug code, build integrations, automate workflows, and independently deliver solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity.

Rockville is a growing consumer electronics and audio equipment brand specializing in pro audio, car audio, marine audio, DJ equipment, lighting, recording equipment, speakers, amplifiers, subwoofers, studio monitors, accessories, and related products. Our business manages thousands of SKUs across our ecommerce websites and major online marketplaces.

Our technology ecosystem includes Sellercloud, Skustack, Shipbridge, Shopify, Salsify, Zendesk, Klaviyo, and other integrated business applications. We are looking for someone who can help us maximize the value of these systems while introducing new capabilities through engineering, automation, and AI.

### **What Makes This Role Stand Out**

* **Sellercloud expertise:** Become a key technical authority for Descartes Sellercloud, Skustack, Shipbridge, and the integrations supporting our multichannel ecommerce operations.
* **Hands-on systems engineering:** Personally develop, troubleshoot, deploy, and maintain APIs, integrations, scripts, automations, and internal technical solutions.
* **AI-forward engineering:** Identify and implement practical uses of AI, AI agents, and intelligent automation to improve business processes, eliminate repetitive work, and increase productivity.
* **Cross-functional impact:** Work directly with Ecommerce, Warehouse Operations, Marketing, Customer Experience, Finance, Purchasing, and leadership to solve meaningful business problems.
* **Measurable ROI:** Deliver improvements that reduce operational costs, eliminate errors, improve throughput, strengthen system reliability, and maximize existing technology investments.
* **Technical ownership and autonomy:** Take projects from problem identification through solution design, implementation, testing, and ongoing support without depending on outside developers for routine engineering work.

### **What You'll Own**

* Serve as an internal technical expert for Sellercloud and its connected applications, including Skustack and Shipbridge, supporting system configurations, business rules, integrations, reporting, and operational workflows.

* Develop and maintain custom solutions using REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, SQL, scripts, middleware, and backend programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, C#, or similar technologies.
* Investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving inventory synchronization, order processing, marketplace connections, product data, shipping workflows, and intersystem data exchange.
* Build and implement AI-powered workflows and agents that improve reporting, data processing, customer support, exception management, and administrative efficiency.
* Evaluate opportunities to use platform-native automation, AI tools, third-party integrations, or custom development, selecting the most effective and maintainable solution.
* Partner with Warehouse Operations to improve technical workflows involving Skustack, Shipbridge, inventory movements, picking, packing, shipping, and related warehouse systems.
* Support integrations and automation across Shopify, Salsify, Zendesk, Klaviyo, and other business applications, working alongside the internal teams responsible for those platforms.
* Develop monitoring, alerts, error handling, and exception reporting to proactively identify integration failures, data discrepancies, and operational issues.
* Analyze existing systems and workflows to identify inefficiencies, unnecessary manual processes, duplicated functionality, and opportunities for consolidation or automation.
* Build technical tools, reports, and dashboards that provide visibility into system performance, operational exceptions, workflow efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.
* Maintain documentation of system architecture, APIs, data mappings, integrations, configurations, technical procedures, and troubleshooting processes.
* Apply sound engineering practices for testing, deployment, version control, access management, security, and reliability.
* Collaborate with internal technical resources, software vendors, and external development partners when necessary while maintaining strong internal ownership of delivered solutions.
* Work with leadership to prioritize technical improvements based on business impact, implementation effort, operating costs, and expected return on investment.

jobs.description:
As a member of this world class team, the Lead Controls Engineer will lead and execute the protection and control aspects of Flexible AC (Alternating Current) Transmission System (FACTS) projects. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, testing, start-up and commissioning of the protection and control aspects of Fixed Series Capacitors(FSC) and Synchronous Condenser (SC) solutions within GE Vernova’s Flexible AC Transmission Systems(FACTS) portfolio.

**Job Description**
===================

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Lead Controls Software Engineer to join our GSI FACTS Controls Software team in Saratoga Springs, NY. In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced control systems for Synchronous Condensers, which provide inertia, steady state and dynamic support to the power system.

  
  

The Lead Controls Engineer will bring expertise in power system controls, strong experience with simulation and real-time testing in both the lab and field, the ability to lead and mentor a team of engineers, and interface with customers and cross-functional stakeholders.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of control systems for FACTS devices, including power generation, transmission, and distribution.
* Participate in the testing and validation of control systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including electrical engineers, software developers, and project managers, to ensure the successful integration of control systems.
* Prepare technical documentation, including design specifications, test plans, and user manuals.
* Conduct system modeling, simulation, and analysis to optimize control strategies and improve system performance.
* Develop and maintain coding libraries for both system software and HMI.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and support their professional development.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to control systems.
* Stay current with the latest advancements in control systems engineering and power systems technology.
* Support business development activities by providing technical expertise and contributing to proposal development.
* Participate in Lean training and lead Lean initiatives
* Lead problem solving efforts for field issues, using tools such as Root Cause Analysis or Problem Solving Reports.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, control systems engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in control systems engineering, with a focus on power transmission systems.
  

  

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Must be able to work in the FACTS office 4 days per week located in Saratoga Springs, NY. No fully remote options available for this role.
* Ability and willingness to travel 20% of the time, including international, and must comply with all relevant company travel and tax policies.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics:**

* Strong knowledge of control theory, power system dynamics, and real-time control systems.
* Proficient with GE Vernova’s MarkVIe product family including Toolbox ST and Cimplicity software (SCADA)
* Familiar with GE Vernova Excitation systems, such as EX2100E
* Expert in PLC programming
* Experience with industrial/utility-grade protection relays and protective relaying coordination
* Working knowledge of grid interconnection requirements (NERC/FERC)
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think analytically and strategically.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven track record of successfully leading and managing engineering projects.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  

  
  

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $98,400.00 and $164,000.00. The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

jobs.title: Data and Systems Engineer - IndyCar
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

Team Penske is seeking a Data & Systems Engineer to join our IndyCar engineering group, with responsibility for electronic, communications, and data acquisition systems across the race car and engineering operation. The role combines hands-on operation and maintenance with systems integration and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting on-track performance through the development and reliability of vehicle electronics, sensors, telemetry, data systems, and engineering tools. Working closely with race engineers, performance engineers, mechanics, IT, and external suppliers, this individual will contribute to race operations, testing, development programs, and long-term technology initiatives.

This is a hands-on engineering position that combines electrical systems, data acquisition, diagnostics, software tools, and vehicle performance support.

**Primary Responsibilities**
============================

**Data, Vehicle Systems, and Electronics**
------------------------------------------

* Develop, maintain, and support all vehicle data acquisition, telemetry, and engineering systems to ensure accurate, reliable, and actionable performance data throughout race and test operations.
* Support vehicle preparation, sensor calibration, and systems validation throughout assembly & operation
* Specify, evaluate, and integrate sensors, electronic hardware, data systems, and related technologies in collaboration with suppliers and technical partners.
* Develop engineering hardware and software tools including test equipment, fixtures, harnesses, analysis utilities, reporting systems, and automated workflows that improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and data accessibility.
* Design and maintain electrical schematics, wiring standards, communication architectures, validation processes, and engineering documentation.
* Participate in engineering meetings, assembly meetings, technical reviews, and long-term technology planning.

**Race & Test Support**
-----------------------

* Support race and test operations as a member of the traveling engineering group.
* Monitor vehicle systems and diagnose issues during race weekends, tests, simulator sessions, and development activities.
* Analyze system health, communications, and data quality throughout all engineering sessions to identify reliability and data-quality issues.
* Partner with IT to manage, maintain, and continuously improve trackside technology infrastructure, including timing stands, telemetry systems, radio communications, networking hardware, and engineering workstations.
* Conduct field repairs for any vehicle and support equipment electronics and wiring
* Support fuel strategy calculations and race operations through accurate collection and analysis of performance data.
* Contribute to development testing, wind tunnel testing, simulator activities, and special engineering projects.

**Development Projects**
------------------------

* Lead assigned engineering projects from concept through implementation.
* Document testing methodologies, calibration procedures, and engineering standards.
* Work collaboratively across vehicle performance, simulation, software, and systems engineering disciplines.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve vehicle reliability, data quality, operational efficiency, and engineering workflows.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of electrical systems, sensors, data acquisition, vehicle electronics, and communication networks.
* Experience troubleshooting complex systems using a structured, analytical engineering approach.
* Experience working with engineering data and interpreting vehicle and system performance.
* Understanding of CAN networks, communications protocols, and electronic diagnostics.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Ability to travel and support race and testing operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience in professional motorsports (IndyCar, NASCAR, IMSA, Formula One, Formula E, WEC, or equivalent).
* Experience with Cosworth, MoTeC, McLaren, Bosch, or similar motorsport electronics and data systems.
* Practical experience with CAN communication, including CANalyzer, CANoe, or related tools.
* Proficiency with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, LabVIEW, or similar engineering software.
* Experience developing engineering software tools, automation scripts, or data analysis workflows.
* Familiarity with databases, Power BI, engineering dashboards, or data reporting systems.
* Experience with telemetry systems, radio communications, and trackside networking.
* Experience designing circuit boards, test fixtures, and embedded electronic devices.
* Experience with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers, or rapid prototyping platforms.
* CAD experience including Siemens NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar platforms.
* Motorsport wiring and motorsport electrical assembly experience.
