jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Company Description**

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve their most complex challenges and deliver a better world.

**Job Description**

AECOM is seeking a **Senior Industrial Electrical Engineer** to lead power system designs for large-scale manufacturing facilities within our Advanced Manufacturing practice. This role is responsible for the design and coordination of facility electrical infrastructure, including utility interconnections, medium-voltage distribution, process equipment power systems, and reliability planning. Working directly with clients, utilities, equipment vendors, and multidisciplinary teams, you will provide technical leadership from concept development through construction, commissioning, and energization. Our project portfolio includes semiconductor, battery, energy and nuclear fuel, defense, and aerospace sectors.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Design medium- and low-voltage distribution (480 V to 35 kV), including substations, switchgear, unit substations, oil-filled/dry-type transformers, MCCs and busway for high-load manufacturing facilities.
* Lead utility coordination and service planning with providers such as Duke Energy, Dominion Energy and Santee Cooper, including load letters and interconnection studies.
* Perform and manage power system studies: load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash (IEEE 1584) and harmonics (IEEE 519) using ETAP or SKM.
* Design power quality and reliability systems: UPS, voltage-sag ride-through (SEMI F47), standby generation, parallelling generators, BESS and redundant (N+1, 2N) architectures.
* Design process and tool power, DC and formation power for battery lines, VFD and motor systems, and power for automation and robotics.
* Define hazardous area classification (NEC Articles 500/505, NFPA 497) for hydrogen, solvent and electrolyte areas; design grounding and lightning protection (IEEE 80, IEEE 142, NFPA 780).
* Experience with the design of lighting and lighting control systems for commercial, government and industrial facilities in accordance with energy code requirements (ASHRAE 90.1 or IECC).
* Grounding analysis and design.
* Prepare technical specification sections. Support construction: submittals, RFIs, factory witness testing, NETA acceptance testing, commissioning and energization.
* Serve as client-facing technical lead in workshops and pursuits; mentor electrical engineers and coordinate with mechanical, process and controls disciplines.

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of education and/or experience.
* Demonstrated working knowledge of NEC (NFPA 70), NFPA 70E, NFPA 110 and IEEE power system standards.
* PE license, or EIT with ability to obtain PE within 24 months.
* Demonstrated proficiency in ETAP or SKM, and Revit and/or AutoCAD Electrical.
* Due to the nature of the role, United States Citizenship is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **8+ years of experience, including 5+ years designing power systems for industrial or manufacturing facilities.**
* Semiconductor fab, battery gigafactory or data-center-scale power experience, including loads of 50 MW or more.
* Substation design at 69 kV and above; microgrid, on-site generation or BESS integration.
* Nuclear fuel-cycle or DOE facility experience, including Class 1E or safety-related electrical systems.
* Background with an EPC, electric utility or manufacturing owner.
* **U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain a security clearance (required for Federal and defense projects).**

  
**Additional Information**

Relocation assistance may be available.

Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available.

jobs.description:

Our Early Career Programs open up an exciting world of opportunities for you to make a difference on a global scale. Your assignments are more than tasks and busy work; they're your chance to drive innovation in intelligent power management and shape the future of our company. You'll team up with seasoned leaders, gaining diverse experiences that'll drive you forward to define and reach your career goals.

**What sets our Early Career Programs apart:**

* **Personalized Program Experience:** We’re committed to energizing your career and empowering your impact. No two participants share the same experience or set of responsibilities.
* **Global Perspectives:** Diverse work locations and comprehensive customer portfolios are a required part of the adventure, enhancing your learning and maximizing program benefits.
* **Role Exploration:** Gain insight into various careers within Eaton through extensive services that ensure safe, efficient, and reliable power systems at every stage.
* **Strategic Networking:** Benefit from networking and mentorship opportunities within one of North America's largest and most experienced power distribution service organizations.
* **Tangible Learning:** See firsthand how Eaton is powering the future of Power Distribution through real world application and customer service.
* **In a Power System Controls role,** you’ll develop automation and control solutions for systems powering critical infrastructure, from concept through commissioning. You’ll work on complex control architectures and real-world applications, building technical expertise in programming, system design, and implementation.

**It’s time to make connections, get energized, and power ahead.**

Eaton provides a competitive total rewards package commensurate with applicable skills, knowledge, and experience and consistent with internal and external market practices. The annual salary for this role is $82,000 with a one-time $6,000 signing bonus.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Position Overview:**

**Eaton's Electrical Services & Systems** team offers a comprehensive portfolio of services tailored for every stage of a power system’s life cycle—whether it’s design, build, or support. Our services integrate and optimize the elements of a power system to make sure it’s aligned with business goals. We can help keep your power system safe, efficient, reliable, and up-to-date.

This role is designed to prepare you for both technical and future leadership roles at Eaton. As a new engineer, you will be provided with a structured training and development curriculum; a blend of instructor-led, virtual classrooms, eLearning courses, and on-the-job training provided by expert mentors and team members to assist you in developing your career.

**Team Benefits:**

  

* Guaranteed 40-hour base pay, eligible for premium pay and travel premiums

jobs.title: Control Systems Engineer-Factory
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated individual with strong instrumentation and controls experience to join our team as a Control Systems Engineer. The purpose of this position is to identify, recommend, and implement control and instrumentation changes to increase factory throughput and sugar recovery in addition to reducing processing costs. Optimize current automation of factory operations and assist in needs assessment, analysis, recommendation, development, and installation of future factory automation capital projects.

**The principal accountabilities of these positions include, but are not limited to:**

* Lead and promote a positive work culture through Company Values of Safety, Integrity, Quality, Teamwork, and Accountability.
* Designs instrumentation and control systems; develops the electrical design for batch and continuous process controls, specifications for process instrumentation, VFD, and control valves. Develops control systems documentation, including Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), loop wiring diagrams, specifications, manuals, PLC programs, and HMI configuration. This position works with OPC communication between factory and business systems and industrial device networks.
* Researches and recommends methods to enhance the utilization of automation and computer control systems. Consults with the Factory Engineer and/or Process Engineer on capital process improvements and make appropriate recommendations and program changes. Also consults with the Maintenance Engineer and Electrical & Instrumentation Supervisor regarding the maintenance of control systems and Process Engineers to achieve optimum processing efficiency. Provides technical expertise in the maintenance of control systems.
* Oversees the optimization of current controls systems and ensures systems are finely tuned and working at optimum levels. The automation of factory operations involves participation in the needs assessment analysis, recommendation, development, and installation of future factory automation capital projects. These are key responsibilities.
* Oversees the support of PLC and process control systems.
* Works with the factory maintenance and other engineers to analyze, recommend equipment specifications and selection, install new equipment, recommend process improvements, and debug processes. Evaluates projects and equipment to determine life cycle benefits and return-on-investment.
* Provides general control systems and instrumentation training for factory employees to effectively prepare factory personnel to successfully operate electrical, instrumentation, and control equipment.
* Assists with the startup of the factories and often have involvement in numerous projects with multiple contractors and factory labor which finish just before factory startup.
Operates within budget and schedule; completing capital jobs on schedule to allow for factory start-up is critical.  

To be successful in this position requires knowledge of instrumentation and electronic controls typically gained through the completion of a Bachelor’s degree in electrical or control engineering or computer science. Knowledge and prior industrial experience in Delta V, industrial networking and device networks, AutoCAD and other computer drafting and design software, computer programming, process modeling, and control systems programming is desirable. The position requires strong project management skills and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal). The incumbent must be able to prioritize and organize work to control his/her schedule and make necessary decisions or sacrifices to facilitate the startup of factories on time, within his/her reasonable ability to control events.

$109,993.90 - $137,492.38 Annual Salary

We also offer discretionary bonuses, tuition reimbursement, service awards, and a 24/7 employee assistance program with access to eight confidential visits with a licensed counselor at no cost. Some of these benefits are subject to eligibility criteria.

**We are proud to offer such a comprehensive** **package to our employees and believe that it reflects our commitment to their well-being and** **success.**

The systems engineer will be expected to work with internal and external stakeholders to define the modelling approach and create standard work for developing, using, interfacing, and controlling the models.  
  
Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* Understand all digital program requirements and work within a matrix organization to execute on all digital aspects for the program.
* Perform model-based systems design and simulation to evaluate alternate architectures and to automate validation and verification activities

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.*

*We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long-term performance.*

*Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.*

  

**About Fluidstack**
====================

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**

**How We Operate**
==================

* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Production Engineering Team**
===================================

**Examples of key exciting problems the team is working on**

* **Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket:** link diagnostics across router-router and NIC-to-router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows exactly what's broken and why. At this scale, debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.
* **Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself:** from automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host-to-network layers. When a new site comes online every six months, manual repair doesn't keep up.
* **Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing:** define requirements, alerting lifecycle, and health dashboards from scratch, for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s to 100s of GWs ahead. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

**Role Scope**
==============

* **Own network fleet health end to end.** Define the realtime monitoring requirements, build the alerting lifecycle, and ship the dashboards that give every on-call engineer a true picture of network state across all sites.
* **Build active debugging tooling.** Link diagnostics, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization — the tools that turn a network fault from a mystery into a solvable problem, fast.
* **Turn repair into a pipeline, not a procedure.** Build the automation that takes a network failure from detection through parts management and return to service. Ticket integration, repair lifecycle pipelines, transceiver and optics tracking — owned, not improvised.
* **Own network qualification and validation**. Build the frameworks that gate new sites and hardware into production. You define what a healthy network looks like before it carries traffic.
* **Own end-to-end reliability, scalability, and operation of the network at-scale.** Fluidstack is building one of the largest datacenter networks in the world and that can only be accomplished with aggressive automation, tooling, and incident discipline.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.**

* You treat toil as a bug. If diagnosing a link failure requires SSHing into boxes and running commands by hand, you build the tool that does it for you.
* You think in systems. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each propagate differently — and you build tooling that can tell them apart.
* You move toward ambiguity, not away from it. You walk into the fog, build the map, and explain it to everyone else.
* You learn at a steep slope. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar domain fast. We value this over existing expertise.
* You carry a pager without flinching. You run the incident, write the postmortem, fix the systemic cause, and move on.
* You're fluent with AI tooling. LLM APIs, MCP servers

* Collaborate with embedded and robotics engineers to define service interfaces and integration points between edge devices and cloud systems
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for service deployment, testing, and rollout
* Contribute to infrastructure-as-code for provisioning and managing cloud, on-prem, and edge resources
* Debug and resolve issues that span the full stack — from containerized services on a robot in the field to cloud backends

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Strong with a high-level language such as Python, Java, Go, or Rust for building backend services and automation
* Proficient with Kubernetes, including deploying, debugging, and operating containerized workloads
* Familiar with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — provisioning infrastructure, managing services, and working with object storage, messaging, and databases. Some deployments run on-prem in air-gapped environments, so comfort working without cloud dependencies is a plus
* Background in CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building, and deploying services
* Proficient with Linux as a development and deployment environment
* Comfortable with Git and collaborative development workflows

**Bonus Points**

* Exposure to K3s or lightweight Kubernetes on edge — running services on resource-constrained hardware in the field
* Has worked with robotics or IoT systems, particularly bridging edge devices and cloud infrastructure
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools such as OpenTofu, Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible
* Familiarity with message brokers and streaming (MQTT, NATS, Kafka, or similar) for real-time data pipelines
* Experience with observability stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or similar monitoring and alerting tools
* Comfortable with networking fundamentals — DNS, firewalls, VPNs, and debugging connectivity issues between edge and cloud
* Has worked with video streaming or processing pipelines in a production environment
* Comfortable getting hands-on with hardware — you don't need to be an embedded expert, but you should be the kind of person who's built robots in a college club, tinkered with a Raspberry Pi, or isn't afraid to plug into a serial console and debug a device on a bench

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Perry Weather**

Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow.

We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk.

**About the role**

Perry Weather builds field-deployed weather monitoring and outdoor warning hardware —lightning detection, weather sensors, sirens, and strobe warning units. These units run unattended on solar and battery power through extreme weather, and when something fails, it fails at a customer site, not on a bench.

We're hiring an Electrical Engineer to join and contribute to the hardware platform: PCB verification and manufacturing readiness, component sourcing and obsolescence management, power system design, and root-cause investigation when field hardware misbehaves.

**Responsibilities**

* **Schematic capture & PCB layout execution.** Work in Altium Designer on new revisions and design changes under the Staff Engineer's architectural review — not from a blank sheet, but with real ownership of the layout and component placement.
* **Impedance & DFM verification.** Confirm controlled-impedance nets (e.g. USB differential pairs at 90Ω, Ethernet at 100Ω) against fab documentation, and manage the CM / Fab House submission and review process — including catching placement/conversion errors in PnP/CPL files before they become a bad board run.
* **Component sourcing & BOM management.** When parts go obsolete or out of stock, find and validate drop-in or near-equivalent replacements (electrical spec + footprint), and keep the BOM current as revisions ship.
* **Power system design.** Prototype and characterize 12V/24V power architectures, select load-switch/eFuse ICs for new switched rails, and run battery/solar runtime characterization (current draw across operating modes, worst-case load estimation).
* **Protocol-level hardware integration.** Bring new sensors and peripherals onto the Custom PCB Carrier through its approved expansion interfaces — GPIO, Modbus RS-485, I²C, and Ethernet/IP — working within the platform's defined GPIO/bus budget rather than requesting ad hoc hardware revisions.
* **Field hardware RCA.** Reproduce field-reported hardware issues (siren/strobe not clearing, speaker output degradation, sensor readings out of range) on the bench using scopes, DMMs, and electronic loads/shunts, isolate root cause, and drive the fix into the next design or manufacturing revision.
* **Manufacturing process improvement.** Own discrete process problems end-to-end — e.g. grounding/ESD compliance fixes on the line, reducing manual bottlenecks in assembly/configuration steps, and building out the automated manufacturing test fixture (hardware harness + pass/fail criteria) the team doesn't have yet.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* 5-7 years of hands-on electrical/hardware engineering, ideally on field-deployed products.
* Real experience in Altium Designer (or similar) for schematic capture and PCB layout — this should be work you've shipped, not coursework.
* Comfort verifying board designs against fab constraints: controlled impedance, differential pairs, power trace sizing.
* Experience selecting components from datasheets, including sourcing alternates under supply constraints.
* Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals: regulation, load switching, battery/solar-powered system design.
* Practical familiarity with I²C, RS-485/Modbus, and Ethernet/IP at the level of integrating a real device, not just protocol theory.
* Bench instrumentation skills: oscilloscope, DMM, electronic load, and comfort measuring current/voltage under dynamic or switched load.
* Experience with root-cause analysis on returned or field-failed hardware.
* Direct experience working with contract manufacturers or PCB fab houses (DFM/DFT, build readiness, process improvement).

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with embedded C/C++ and embedded Linux (U-Boot, device tree, board bring-up) — useful for reading firmware well enough to help isolate whether a failure is hardware or firmware, not for owning the codebase.
* Exposure to OTA update/bootloader concepts.
* Experience with cellular modems (Quectel or similar).
* Basic scripting (Python) for test automation or tooling.
* Exposure to outdoor/ruggedized enclosure design, solar/battery systems, or safety-critical/regulated hardware.

**Benefits**

* **You'll want to come into the office.** Our Oak Lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. The whole team is here Monday through Friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over Slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days.
* **Your wellbeing is covered.** Competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics.
* **Good people, good times.** Monthly All-Hands, Office Olympics, happy hours, and more. We take the work seriously and the culture seriously too.
* **You're getting in early, and that matters.** We're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. The people joining now will help shape what Perry Weather becomes.

**ABOUT FIREFLY AEROSPACE**
===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.**

Firefly Electrical Engineers in the Interconnect team are responsible for developing the electrical wiring interconnect systems (EWIS) that distribute power and electrical signals within avionics hardware, instrumentation, and payloads. In this role, you will work in small, collaborative groups through all stages of the component and system design, manufacturing, and testing. Additionally, you will take ownership of your projects and collaborate with the team to conduct the design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, and final integration of components on launch vehicles and spacecraft.

* Develop and integrate electrical wiring interconnect system (EWIS) designs on launch vehicles and spacecraft.

* Familiar with the use of test equipment to verify harness design and assembly.

* Experience with selection of connectors, backshells, wires, and other harness components.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Salary:

$116,000.00 - $159,500.00

Location:

Austin,TX, Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Find the test gaps that matter.** Use field failures, factory nonconformances, failure analysis, 8D findings, FMEA/FMECA risks, and test data to identify where existing assurance methods failed to detect risk before shipment.
* **Translate failure mechanisms into testable requirements.** Convert complex failure signatures and real-world operating conditions into specific, measurable, and defensible requirements that engineering teams and suppliers can execute.
* **Engineer system-representative test coverage.** Define the functional, parametric, stress, burn-in, thermal, RF, high-voltage, leak, particle, interlock, and other tests needed to expose targeted failure modes before they reach an Applied factory or customer.
* **Challenge assumptions with evidence.** Question legacy test methods, inherited limits, and accepted practices when they are not supported by data. Use engineering judgment, structured problem solving, and experimentation to determine what the evidence requires.
* **Own the test solution from concept through sustained deployment.** Evaluate feasibility, develop the technical concept, define the specification and statement of work, establish cost and schedule, and lead design, sourcing, build, bring-up, validation, and production implementation.
* **Prove that the test works.** Establish correlation, repeatability, reproducibility, measurement capability, calibration requirements, and acceptance criteria. Demonstrate with objective evidence that the solution detects the intended failure mode under production-representative conditions.
* **Deploy capability where it prevents the greatest risk.** Bring test systems into operation at suppliers and Applied factories. Resolve implementation issues, coordinate engineering changes, and ensure the solution is practical, scalable, and ready for production use.
* **Preserve test effectiveness throughout the lifecycle.** Establish the preventive-maintenance, calibration, out-of-tolerance response, configuration control, data retention, and performance-monitoring requirements necessary to keep deployed test systems reliable and effective.
* **Measure outcomes, not activity.** Monitor detection effectiveness, test-system performance, false failures, escapes, NCs, DMRs, and other relevant quality and operational indicators. Use the results to verify effectiveness and identify the next improvement opportunity.
* **Prevent recurrence at the source.** Apply lessons from escapes to improve supplier test mandates, Functional Requirements Documents, FMEA/FMECA, Design for Testability, and applicable product-lifecycle deliverables so that prevention becomes part of how future products are developed.
* **Lead across organizational boundaries.** Drive multiple complex initiatives across suppliers, factories, Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Supplier Engineering, NPI Quality, Product Quality & Reliability, and business-unit teams. Communicate technical conclusions, risks, decisions, and business impact with clarity.
* **Build scalable Test Excellence capability.** Create reusable requirements, methods, standards, specifications, and validation practices. Mentor other engineers, transfer knowledge, and raise the organization’s ability to find the right problems and solve them permanently.
  

  

You will turn real-world failures and emerging risks into test solutions that prevent defects from reaching our factories and customers. From defining system-representative requirements to developing, validating, and deploying test fixtures, you will own the solution from insight to sustained impact. You will challenge assumptions with evidence, work across suppliers and engineering teams, and help build the methods and standards that define Test Excellence globally.

**Additional Information**

**Time Type:**

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 25% of the Time

Yes

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – LV Power Distribution
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

You will be joining Valar Atomics' Electrical Engineering team, embedded within the broader Fuel Manufacturing engineering group. The team delivers the electrical infrastructure that powers Valar's fuel manufacturing facilities, including process area LV distribution, motor control, and emergency power. You will work alongside I&C, mechanical, and nuclear safety engineers in a collaborative environment that demands technical precision and a strong safety culture. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to some of the most technically interesting power distribution challenges in the advanced nuclear sector.

**The Role**

Valar Atomics is seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the design and delivery of low voltage electrical systems for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role will contribute to LV system design, power system studies, equipment selection, drawings, specifications and field support while working closely with senior electrical engineers and multidisciplinary teams. This is an opportunity to work on first-of-a-kind industrial facilities and develop hands-on experience with complex electrical systems in the nuclear industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain electrical load lists and support power system studies, including load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, motor starting and harmonic analysis, using SKM Power Tools, ETAP, EasyPower or equivalent.
* Support arc flash hazard analysis and labeling in accordance with IEEE 1584 and NFPA 70E.
* Support grounding and bonding design for LV systems in accordance with NEC Article 250 and IEEE 142.
* Assist with sizing and selection of LV switchboards, MCCs, panelboards, dry-type transformers, cables, bus duct, VFDs, UPS systems, batteries and standby generators.
* Develop and update single line diagrams for LV distribution systems, from the secondary of the unit substation through MCCs and final distribution equipment.
* Prepare and maintain electrical equipment layouts, cable schedules, tray routing and duct bank designs.
* Support specifications and data sheets for LV electrical equipment and industrial control panels to UL 508A / IEC 61439.
* Support electrical area classification drawings and selection of equipment for hazardous locations in accordance with NEC Articles 500/505 or IEC 60079.
* Assist with LV protective device coordination studies, time-current curves and breaker trip unit settings.
* Develop and review electrical drawings, including MCC control wiring diagrams, DC control schematics, panel arrangements and distribution details.
* Support technical evaluations of electrical equipment and vendor bids, and review vendor drawings, calculations and technical documentation.
* Support electrical installation specifications and participate in pre-commissioning and commissioning activities, including insulation resistance testing, continuity checks, trip unit testing and equipment energization.
* Coordinate with I&C engineers on motor, VFD and control interfaces, and with civil and structural engineers on equipment foundations, cable routing and penetrations.
* Participate in design reviews, HAZOPs, constructability reviews and other multidisciplinary engineering activities, and support resolution of technical questions from vendors, contractors and field teams.
* Prepare engineering calculations, reports, drawings and specifications under the direction of senior electrical engineers, applying applicable codes and standards.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 1+ years of electrical engineering experience, preferably in industrial, process, power generation or other complex facilities.
* Understanding of LV electrical distribution systems and fundamental electrical engineering principles.
* Familiarity with power system analysis software such as SKM Power Tools, ETAP, EasyPower or equivalent.
* Familiarity with electrical design deliverables, including single line diagrams, load lists, equipment specifications, cable schedules and electrical layouts.
* Working knowledge of the NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, ANSI and NEMA standards.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* EIT designation or active pursuit thereof.
* Experience with LV switchboards, MCCs, VFDs, UPS systems or standby power systems.
* Experience performing or supporting short circuit, arc flash or protective device coordination studies.
* Familiarity with hazardous location classification and static electricity control (NFPA 77).
* Experience with industrial control panel design or review to UL 508A or IEC 61439.
* Experience with DC systems and battery sizing.
* Familiarity with nuclear quality requirements (e.g., ASME NQA-1) or nuclear fuel facility design.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch
* Generous PPE stipend
* High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

* Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering.

* Experience with nuclear facility electrical design and nuclear classification requirements (IEEE 384, CSA N290.7).

* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits

jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable, unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**  
You will be joining Valar Atomics' IC&E Engineering team within the Fuel Manufacturing group. Automation and Controls Engineers own the logic and data layer, PLC and DCS application code, ISA-88 batch sequences, SCADA and HMI applications, historian infrastructure, and enterprise integration. You will work alongside I&C Hardware, process, and nuclear safety engineers in an environment that blends traditional control systems with modern software and data integration practice. The team values operator-focused design, data integrity, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first culture.

**The Role**  
Valar Atomics is seeking a Senior Automation and Controls Engineer to develop, configure, test, and commission the control system software for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role covers PLC and DCS programming, SCADA and HMI application development, ISA-88 batch control, alarm management, safety logic programming, historian configuration, and ISA-95 enterprise integration, supporting both capital projects and ongoing plant operations.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain PLC and DCS application programs using platforms such as Rockwell ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Siemens S7/TIA Portal, Emerson, or equivalent; program in ladder logic, function block, structured text, and sequential function chart per IEC 61131-3.
* Develop and configure SCADA applications on platforms such as Ignition, Rockwell FactoryTalk, AVEVA System Platform, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent; build and maintain tag databases, user-defined types, communication drivers, scripting, templates, and client and redundancy architecture.
* Design HMI displays at both the local panel level (Rockwell PanelView, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent) and the supervisory SCADA level in accordance with ISA-101 and High-Performance HMI (HPHMI) principles, including display hierarchy, navigation, and situational awareness graphics.
* Develop batch control software in accordance with ISA-88 including phase logic, equipment modules, unit procedures, recipe management, equipment arbitration, and material tracking; build the supervisory batch layer for batch execution monitoring, unit status, and recipe progress display and reporting.
* Configure and manage alarm system software to ISA-18.2 including setpoints, priorities, deadbands, shelving and suppression logic, and alarm performance KPI reporting.
* Program, configure, and functionally test safety logic on SIS platforms (Rockwell GuardLogix, Siemens F-CPU, Triconex, or equivalent) in accordance with IEC 61511.
* Configure plant historian systems (OSIsoft PI / AVEVA PI, Ignition Historian, Rockwell FactoryTalk Historian, or equivalent) including tag configuration, compression and exception settings, and asset framework modelling; build process data dashboards and operational reports.
* Implement ISA-95 enterprise-control integration including data exchange interfaces between control systems and MES, ERP, and LIMS; develop and consume REST APIs and database interfaces.
* Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols in software including OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, and DeviceNet; configure server and client endpoints, tag mapping, and interfaces between SCADA and PLC, DCS, SIS, historian, and third-party systems.
* Write SQL queries and stored procedures and Python scripts for data processing, transaction handling, report generation, and control system test automation.
* Apply software configuration management practice including version control, change control, structured code review, controller and SCADA application backup and restore, and disaster recovery testing.
* Define OT network architecture and configure cybersecurity controls in accordance with IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800-82, including zone and conduit design, VLAN and switch configuration, role-based access control, authentication, secure protocol configuration, and coordination of patching and application allow-listing.
* Prepare and execute software FAT, SAT, and commissioning test plans; maintain engineering documentation including functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, tag lists, alarm databases, and as-built software records.
* Diagnose and resolve control system software faults including PLC and SCADA communication failures, logic defects, sequence stalls, historian data gaps, and application performance issues; perform root cause analysis and document corrective actions.
* Coordinate with I&C Hardware Engineers on I/O assignment, tag naming, signal scaling, and loop commissioning to ensure control logic and field hardware are consistent.
* Provide technical direction to contractors and consultants on controls software scope; review and redline control system software deliverables to ensure compliance with project standards and nuclear quality requirements.

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Computer, or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 7 years of controls software, PLC programming, or SCADA development experience in process industries.

* Hands-on experience developing or mai

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts and tools for functional, regression, and performance testing.

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco seeks a Cyber Systems Engineer for its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3.0 program in Hampton, VA. The CAF DMO 3.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world. You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability. The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.

**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer a DoD Secret Security clearance and eligible to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.**

In this role, you will:

* Support simulation system and application integration, evaluation, and interoperability test to support DMON and JSE training operations.
* Use industry-standard tools for simulation test and evaluation to include Wireshark, simulation protocol analysis, and GFE and Commercial Computer Generated Forces (CGFs).
* Assist in detailed analysis of network and computational system performance including latency, bandwidth, jitter, and system occupancy measures.
* Help develop and maintain test plans and procedures to document and drive test activities.
* Draft comprehensive test reports based on completed integration, test, evaluation, and verification tasks performed.
* Assist in the development of CONOPS and multiple COAs for implementation and deployment of the evaluated simulation capabilities.
* Contribute to other areas of the engineering life cycle to include requirements review and assessment, training operations support, and basic system administration functions.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Amazon Special Projects
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Innovators wanted! Are you an entrepreneur? A builder? A dreamer? This role is part of an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company’s Think Big leadership principle to the highest levels. We focus on creating entirely new products and services with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. No industries or subject areas are out of bounds. We launched products such as Comprehend Medical, Echo Frames and Amazon Explore. If you’re interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you.  
As the Sr. Systems Engineer, you will own the agent daemon that runs on compute nodes, the runtime sandbox that isolates workloads, and the local storage and caching layer that determines which assets are resident and ready to serve. You will build the detection logic that manages node availability, and the GPU capability reporting that tells the scheduler exactly what each node can handle. Your work directly determines whether the platform can deliver low-latency ML inference — and whether it can do so reliably at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement the agent daemon on Linux, including GPU discovery, availability detection, and sandboxed container execution for ML inference workloads.
* Architect the local caching system — eviction policies, versioned manifests, disk budget management, and efficient update mechanisms that minimize data transfer for large model files.
* Build VRAM management and graceful workload migration logic.
* Integrate hardware attestation with the security engineer and support diverse hardware configurations and fleet onboarding automation.

  
About the team  
Amazon Special Projects is a small, high-autonomy team building new-to-Amazon infrastructure from scratch. The systems component is where software meets hardware: you will build the on-node runtime — the agent, sandbox, GPU manager, and local storage layer — that makes a compute node reliable, secure, and performant. This is systems engineering at its most tangible — your code runs on real hardware and must be resilient to everything the real world throws at it.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

**The Role**

  

We are seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to join the TeraWave team at Blue Origin. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Broadband CPE
jobs.description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview  
T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.  
  
You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.  
  
Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and maintain one or more microservices within the device management agent, in C and C++ on RDK-B.
* Implement and maintain device data model parameters and USP protocol behavior across supported hardware platforms.
* Interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS to configure them, query state, and report it upstream.
* Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.
* Write unit tests for new and changed code and extend our automated test coverage.
* Debug across the device software stack, from log analysis and root cause investigation through to fix verification.
* Support device maintenance releases, including test support, firmware validation, and release verification.
* Work with OEM partners on defect triage and reproduction.
* Improve how we collect data and logs from the field so issues can be triaged and resolved faster.
* Contribute ideas that improve how we build, test, and deliver device software.
* Document your code, the data model and device behavior.

**Job Summary**

This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The LatticeOS Team builds the foundational software-defined operating system that powers our family of autonomous systems, sensors, and third-party integrations. Our work spans edge devices, robotic platforms, and cloud infrastructure, creating a unified operating environment for system orchestration, secure data distribution, and real-time execution. As a core engineering capability, LatticeOS directly enables mission-critical operations across all domains, powering both internal products and external developer partners integrating through the Lattice SDK. Our solutions are designed for real-world deployment in the most demanding operational environments, where reliable middleware, high availability, and seamless hardware-software integration make the difference between mission success and failure.

#### 

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Senior Software Engineer working in the ProtoKV domain you will design and build the core distributed key-value infrastructure that underpins state sharing across Lattice OS, focusing on performance, reliability, and consistency guarantees at the edge. They'll own the protobuf schema evolution strategy and API surface, ensuring that services across the mesh can safely publish and consume typed state without breaking contracts. A significant portion of the role involves optimizing for the unique constraints of tactical environments — low-bandwidth links, intermittent connectivity, and strict latency requirements — where traditional distributed systems assumptions don't hold. You'll also collaborate closely with teams across Lattice to understand consumption patterns, debug cross-service state issues, and evolve ProtoKV's replication and conflict-resolution mechanisms as the platform scales to new mission sets.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field, or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on distributed systems or data/databases
* Deep experience with Python, Go lang, C++, Rust, or similar systems programming languages
* Solid distributed-systems fundamentals. You can reason about replication, consistency, partition behavior, and failure modes, and explain why a given design does or doesn't converge.
* Production experience building or operating storage engines, databases, or large-scale data infrastructure.
* Comfort in a systems language. Depth matters more than the specific language you've used.
* A bias toward shipping and owning your work. The team is small and what you build is load-bearing

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers.   + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
  
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
  
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Jose, CA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience programming in C++.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* 3 years of experience with Android OS Internals.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 3 years of experience with performance, large-scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, or debugging.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

  
The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

-----------------

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Jax Training Experience team works on making Distributed LLM training on GCP easy, scalable and performant. We are responsible for MaxText, Google's open-source library providing performant JAX implementations of LLM models such as Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, etc. We're collaborating with other teams to optimize these workloads on GCP, on TPUs, GPUs, and CPUs. We are part of the ML@Scale team in the CBS/CoreML organization.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

* Help make MaxText the best pre and post training solution for TPUs on GCP.

* Build and support JAX and its ecosystem to benefit GCP customers.

jobs.description:
### **Job Title**

Systems Engineer - Ultrasound (Cambridge, MA or Bothell, WA)

### **Job Description**

The Systems Engineer – Ultrasound is responsible for delivering outstanding image quality, clinical performance and workflow efficiency by driving the development and integration of next-generation ultrasound imaging systems. The role handles internal investigations into technical complaints regarding development and system integration issues, driving resolution, and implementing preventive measures to mitigate future issues.

Your role:

* Apply principles of acoustic wave propagation and signal processing theory to design, implement and test new ultrasound imaging algorithms, system architectures, and imaging subsystems.
* Lead the development and implementation of new ultrasound system capabilities, including project planning, algorithm and hardware design, integration strategy, and software implementation.
* Lead internal investigations into technical complaints regarding development and system integration issues, driving resolution and implementing preventive measures to mitigate future issues.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D team members, Marketing, Product Management, and internal/external stakeholders to support new feature requirements for specific clinical applications and market needs, and translate marketing/customer requirements into engineering specifications.
Engage with experts in electrical engineering, biomedical engineering, physics, software development, clinical science, and product management to deliver innovative solutions that meet complex clinical and technical requirements.  

**You're the right fit if:**

* You have a Master’s Degree in in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or equivalent disciplines. PHD, preferred.
* You’ve acquired 2+ years of experience in systems engineering, signal processing or equivalent. Imaging experience strongly, preferred.
* Your skills include strong software skills in C/C++, GPU programming with CUDA or OpenCL, OpenCV, MATLAB and Python.
You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position .
